tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// zab mo nang gi don gsal bar ston pa'i gzhung bde blag tu rtogs par byed pa'i mchan 'grel rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal lung nor bu rnam par snang ba dri ma med pa'i 'od ces bya ba bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// na mo ut+ta ra bh+yaḥ /khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi bdag /dang po'i sangs rgyas bde ba che// sku bzhi'i dbang phyug rdo rje can// dpal ldan bla mar phyag bgyi nas// bla med rgyud sde'i rdo rje'i gnas// phyi nang gzhan gsum de kho na// mnyam sbyor de nyid ston pa'i gzhung*// snang byed nor bu'i 'od phreng spel// 'di la gnyis/ mtshan bstan pa dang*/ gzhung mthar chags su bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa'i gsang ba gzhan gyi tshig gi blos ngag rgyun gyis rtogs dka' bas zab mo lus nang gi bdag nyid rdo rje'i lus kyi mtshan nyid gtan la phab nas/ sems nang gi bdag nyid lhan skyes ye shes rtogs pa'i phyir ram/ lus nang gi bdag nyid rtsa rlung thig le'i gnas tshul gyi don dang*/ sems nang gi bdag nyid gzhi bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes kyi don phyin ci ma log par mthar thug zab mo'i don mngon sum du ston pas na/ zab mo nang gi don zhes bya ba'i gzhung bzhugs/ zhes so// gnyis pa gzhung dngos mthar chags su bshad pa la gsum/ mchod par brjod cing bshad par dam bca' ba/ gzhung don dngos/ mjug bsdu ba bsngo ba dang bcas pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ dkyil 'khor gyi khyab bdag bla ma la/ rnam pa dang bcas pa'i sku la/ bde ba chen po'i sku la phyag 'tshal ba// bshad par dam bca' ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ yi ge pa'i ngor dang*/ rtsom pa po'i mchod brjod do// dang po ni/ snang stong thabs shes sku ye gnyis su mi phyed pa/ dpal rdo rje 'chang de la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa ni/ ji snyed shes bya'i gnas thams cad mkhyen par mdzad cing*/ ji lta ba'i 'khor 'das rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyi dbye ba thams cad ma 'dres par so so gzigs pas na/ phyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ nang rdo rje'i lus/ gzhan dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gsum gyi de kho na nyid kyi tshul mngon sum du ston cing*/

sad rmi gnyid dang snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs bzhi yi 'khrul pa sel zhing*/ 'bras bu sku bzhi thob par mdzad pa'i dpal ldan bla ma la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa ni/ gzhi yi ye shes lhan skyes gcig dngos/ lam dri ma sbyangs nas/ 'bras bu gsang chen rigs gcig gi sku dang*/ gzhi snang stong zung 'jug /lam thabs shes zung 'jug gis/ 'bras bu lhan cig skyes pa'i chos kyi sku dang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku gnyis kyi bdag /sku gsum rtsa rlung thig le can ste/ gzhi dus kyi rtsa thig rlung gsum mam/ lam bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug gsum gyis/ 'bras bu chos sku longs sku sprul sku gsum mo// gzhi gnas skabs bzhi po/ lam ye shes bzhis sbyangs pa'i sbyangs 'bras sku bzhi nyid dang*/ gzhi lnga chos rnams lam rigs lnga'i bskyed rdzogs kyis sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sku lnga'i bdag nyid la/ rdo rje sems dpa'i rigs brgya'i bdag nyid bde chen rnam pa thams cad pa'i skur snang ba de la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum pa ni/ stong pa nyid kyi dngos po gcig 'di 'khor 'das rten 'byung gi chos kun gyi rang bzhin can/ spros mtha' dang bral ba'i dbu ma chen po ni/ dbu ma'i rang bzhin bde chen spros bral gyi ye shes gcig pu de nyid/ gang sgrib pa spangs rim gyi mthar skyes pa'am/ rtog pa'i rang bzhin can gyi/ rnam med shes rab kyi phar phyin yum rdo rje btsun mo'am/ ye shes kyi lha mo de la phyag 'tshal lo// bzhi pa ni/ rgyud 'og ma rnams kun tu gsang ba gang yin pa de// rgyal bas bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams su legs par phye bar mdzad pa'i zab mo'i don de/ mthar drug gis bcings nang gi don gang yin pa de ni/ phyi nang nyan thos spyod yul min// dbang po dman pa nyan thos pa dang*/ 'bring pha rol phyin par ste/ blo chung theg pa dman pa rnams la rab tu gsang ba/ lus nang gi bdag nyid rtsa rlung thig le ji ltar gnas pa'i tshul dang*/

sems nang gi bdag nyid lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dam pa bshad par bya'o// gnyis pa gzhung don dngos la gnyis/ lus rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ yan lag rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dgos pa dang bcas pa'i don gyi lus sam ngo bo rnam par bzhag pa dang*/ dum bu bcu gcig gi nges pa mdor bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dri med rgyal pa'i snying po ni/ ma dag ma dag dag pa dang*// shin tu rnam dag go rim bzhin// sems can lam la gnas pa dang*// de bzhin gshegs rnams rim pa bzhin// gsungs phyir de don rtogs par bya// gnyis pa ni/ thog mar 'khor 'das kyi rgyu rkyen bstan pa'i dum bu dang*/ mngal skyes lus ni 'grub pa'i tshul gyi le'u dang*/ lus de nyid la gnas pa'i rtsa yi rnam bshad dang*/ rtsa de nyid la rgyu ba'i rlung ni gnas dang rgyu ba'i tshul dang*/ de la rgyu ba'i thig le ji ltar rgyu ba dang*/ rnam shes dang*/ ye shes/ gnas skabs bzhi dang*/ phyag rgya bzhi la sogs par 'gre ba'i don bshad pa dang*/ nang gi don de dag phyi snod la sbyar ba dang*/ gzhan kun btags kyis bskyed pa'i lha rnams bskyed pa'i rim pa bstan pa gang yin pa dang*/ chos thams cad kyi sbyang gzhir/ sbyong byed kyi tshul bstan pa dang*/ sa dang lam gyi gnas rnams su rim par bgrod pa'i tshul bstan pa dang*/ de mthar rtsa rlung thig le bskyed rim dang bcas pa rnams 'jig cing bsdud pa'i tshul rnams/ rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis bstan pa bzhin bshad bya/ gnyis pa yan lag rgyas bar bshad pa la dum bu bcu gcig yod pa las/ dang po rgyu rkyen spyir bstan pa'i dum bu la/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ le'u'i mtshan bstan ba gnyis// dang po la bzhi ste/ dag ma dag gi sems kyi ngo bo/ ji ltar 'khrul pa'i tshul/ rgyu rkyen dbye ba/ gnas skabs gsum gyi dbye ba'o// dang po la gnyis/sems kyi ngo bo dang*/ sems kyi rnam par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/

'khor 'das kyi rgyu ni sems nyid rang byung gi ye shes thog ma med la/ sangs rgyas dang sems can gcig dang tha dad du brjod pa med pas rgyar chad pa dang*/ 'khor 'das spang gnyen gyi phyogs lhung ma mchis kyang*/ gnyis pa ni/ gshis rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa'i bde ba chen po gsal stong ma 'gags pa'i rol pa cir yang 'char ba de nyid ma 'gags rol pa las/ ngo bo stong la rang bzhin gsal// rnam pa 'gag med cir yang 'char// gnyis pa ji ltar 'khrul pa'i tshul la gnyis/ kun gzhi dang de la brten pa'i yid nyon mongs pa can dang bcas pa dang*/ tshogs drug dang phung po lnga'i rim pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de lta bu'i sems de nyid rang gis rang mdangs bde chen ye shes kyi rol ba/ gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngo bo de ma rig ste/ sems rang gi ngo bo stong gsal zung 'jug gi tshul ma rig ste/ de'i ngo bo spros bral gyi stong pa'i cha la bdag dang*/ snang ba 'gag med kyi cha la gzhan du 'dzin pa'i gzhan rtog zhugs pas ma rig tshul ji ltar na/ kun gzhi'i ye shes de nyid sems can dang 'brel ba'i dus/ rten 'byung bas dbang byas te/ 'gyu byed kyi rlung gis/ bdun pa nyon mongs pa'i yid bskyod nas/ des bdag gzhan du 'dzin pa zhugs nas/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes de bskyod pa las/ med bzhin tu 'dzin pa'i gnyis snang dbang gis 'khor ro// rjes yul la 'du byed pa'i bdun yid kyis kun gzhi bskyod cing*/ kun gzhi dang*/ yid gnyis phan tshun gnyis 'dzin gyis g.yo ba ni/ chu rlabs lta bur g.yos pa las/ gnyis pa tshogs drug dang phung po lnga'i rim pa bstan pa la gnyis/ tshogs drug yul la 'khrul ba'i tshul dang*/ phung po lnga'i rim pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ don gzhan dang*/ 'dzin pa bdag gnyis su snang ba des/ rang gis rang la bdag gzhan gnyis su ched du gtad cing gzung ste/ yid de phyir 'gyus sems rang gi snang ngo la/

'gag med kyi cha las shar ba'i/ yul drug la don gzhan tu gzung ba'i gzung yul dang*/ der 'dzin pa'i rnam shes kyi phung po byung*/ gnyis pa ni/ rnam shes des yul yid du 'ong mi 'ong la/ blang dor byed pa de las tshor ba'i phung po skye/ tshor ba des yul de la bde sdug btang snyoms gsum la mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i 'du shes kyi phung po te/ de ltar blos 'dus byas pa'i yul snang sna tshogs par bdag las gzhan du btags nas 'du byed grub/ 'du byed des yul la mngon par zhen pas gzugs kyi phung po grub pa yin no// gsum pa rgyu rkyen kyi dbye ba bstan pa la gnyis/ rgyu drug tu bstan pa/ rkyen bzhir bstan pa'o/ dang po ni/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i khams lnga/ rnam par shes pa'i khams dang drug go /phyi nang 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad kyi rgyu yin zhes rnam par rtog pas tha snyad byas te ming btags so// gnyis pa la bzhi/ rgyu'i rkyen/ bdag rkyen/ dmigs rkyen/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen no// dang po ni/ 'khor 'das su 'khrul pa de yi bag chags sam/ sa bon kun gzhi la/ bsags pa de ni 'khrul pa'i rgyu yi rkyen zhes bya/ gnyis pa ni/ bdag po'i rkyen yul shes kyi bar du snang ba yi/ mig la sogs ba dbang po lnga yin no// gsum pa ni/ dmigs pa'i rkyen ni gzugs la sogs pa'i chos rnams// rnam shes rang rang gi yul du snang ba'i rig bya ste/ bzhi pa ni/ de ma thag pa'i rkyen zhes pa/ tshogs drug gang gar 'gags pa de ma thag par/ rnam shes phyi ma skye bar byed pa yin te/ drug pa'i yid dang bcas pa'i tshogs drug gi snga ma 'gags pa na/ phyi ma skyes pa'i de ma thag pa'i rkyen yin no// bzhi pa gnas skabs gsum gyi dbye ba bshad pa la gsum/ ma dag pa'i gnas skabs/ gnyis ldan gyi gnas skabs/ shin tu rnam dag gi gnas skabs so// dang po la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o/

dang po ni/ de ltar rgyu drug dang*/ rkyen bzhis bskyed nas/ rten 'brel las/ yan lag bcu gnyis lugs 'byung ldog gi dbye ba gnyis gnyis kyis/ 'khor 'das chos kun snang bar gyur ste/ ma rig pa dang*/ 'du byed/ rnam par shes pa gsum gyis 'phen byed/ des 'phangs pas/ ming gzugs skye mched/ reg pa/ tshor ba bzhi'o/ gnyis pa la gsum/ srid pa 'grub tshul thun mong du bstan pa/ khams gsum/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes/ mchan gyi 'du shes gya byad par/ khams gsum gyi rgyu 'bras sbyar nas bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ des bskyed pa'i sred pa dang*/ len pas mtshams sbyar ste/ srid pa 'grub pa ste/ de gsum ni grub pa'i yan lag yin/ de ltar grub pa la skye ba dang*/ rga 'chi gnyis ni grub pa'i 'bras bu ste/ de lta bu'i ma rig pa la brten nas/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi 'khor lo grub bo// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i srid pa ni/ khams gsum kyi ma bsdus te/ gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi/ gzugs khams gnas ris bcu drug /'dod pa'i khams srid pa bcu gcig rnams ni/ rim bzhin yul la mtshan 'dzin pa// chung ba yin te/ 'dod gzugs kyi snang ba dang thogs pa med phyir dang*/ 'bring tsam yin te/ 'dod chags bral zhing*/ bsam gtan bzhi'i ting nge 'dzin gyis bskyed cing*/ gzugs snang dang bcas pa'i phyir dang*/ chen po yin ste/ 'dod yon la chags shing*/ rtog pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i phyir ro// gsum pa ni/ khams gsum po thams cad kyang blang dor rtog pa yis/ bskyed pa'i dge dang mi dge lung ma bstan gyi las/ rnam pa gsum 'du byed pa'i rkyen las ni/ 'bras bu mtho ris bde ba ngan song sdug bsngal/ gzugs med kyi rten la snyoms par 'jug pa dang bcas pa yi// 'bras bu skye ba yin pas na nyon mongs can no// gsum pa ni/ de ltar rgyu rkyen rten 'brel gyis bskyed pa'i las gsum/ 'bras bu gsum bcas pa ni/

sems nyid glo bur gyi dri ma ma dag gnas skabs yin no// gnyis pa gnyis ldan gyi gnas skabs ni/ de ltar ma rig pa'i dri ma de nyid glo bur bar/ shes nas sbyong byed kyi thabs rnams dang bcas rim par sbyong ba ni// lam pa zhes bya rgyal bas gsungs la/ gsum pa shin tu rnam dag gi gnas skabs ni/ dri med dag pas sangs rgyas te/ rgyu mtshan de phyir 'gro kun kyang dri bcas kyi sangs rgyas nyid do// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyu rkyen spyir bstan pa ste dang po'o// de ltar sems dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la phab zin nas/ lus dngos po'i gnas lugs shes dgos pa'i phyir/ lus 'grub tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ le'u'i mtshan no// dang po la gsum ste/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ de'ang sems de nyid dkar dam rlung gsum gyi gzhan dbang dang 'grogs pa de la phra ba'i lus zhes brjod cing*/ de la brten pa'i rags pa'i lus 'grub tshul ni/ lus ni 'grub pa'i tshul bshad pa// kun gzhi srog rlung dang bcas pa/ khams gsum gyi skye bar sbyor ba la brten nas lus 'grub pa yin na/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ khams gsum gyi skye ba len tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ mi'i skye ba len tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ gzugs med/ gzugs khams/ 'dod khams pa'i skye ba len tshul lo// dang po ni/ des bskyed pa'i las kyi 'phen 'grub kyis kun gzhi'i 'du byed bcas pa'i rnam shes kyis// nam mkha' mtha' yas la sogs bzhi'o// gang rung yid yul du byas nas der skye ba/ gzugs med ces bya ngar 'dzin gyi yid lus so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ zhar la khams gong ma gnyis kyi 'dzag pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bsam gtan bzhi yi snyoms 'jug zag bcas bzhi gang rung la brten nas khams gong ma gang dag tu skye ba ni/

gzugs khams yin te 'dod sred ni/ rags pa bcom pa ni lus gos dang bcas brdzus skyes so// gnyis pa ni/ nam mkha' rlung me chu dang sa// 'byung chung rnam par phye ba yis/ gnas gzhan nyi shur gang skyes pa/ de yis 'dzag pa go rim bzhin// khams gcig nas ni lnga yi bar// ldan pas ma rig skye dang bcas// dran pa nyer bzhag tu bstan to// gsum pa 'dod khams kyi skye ba len tshul la gnyis te/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ rdo rje theg pa'i rten gyi gang zag ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ 'dod khams rigs drug thams cad kyang*/ khams drug dang ldan pa ste/ phra ba srin bu dang*/ rags pa gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bar thams cad mtshungs shing*/ 'dod khams pa rnams ni skye gnas bzhi ldan yin kyang*/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rdo rje theg pa'i rten du dman pa dang*/ mchog go /dang po ni/ gzhan dag rnams ni/ ngan song gsum ni mi khom gnas// lha dang lha min sgra mi snyan// 'bras bu spyod pa rgyud min te// gnyis pa rdo rje theg pa'i rten mchog ni/ shar lho nub kyi gling gsum skyes pa'i khams drug ldan pa'i mi rnams/ rdo rje theg pa'i lam sgrub pa'i rten gyi mchog yin cing*/ de'i nang nas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling du legs par bskyed pa ni/ las kyi sa par rab tu grags/ gnyis pa mi'i skye ba len tshul bye brag tu bshad pa la gnyis/ bskal pa dang po'i skye ba len tshul dang*/ mngal skyes kyi skye ba len tshul lo// dang po ni/ yul 'dir skye ba 'grub tshul ni/ dang por brdzus skyes gzugs khams bzhin// de nas rim gyis srid dbang gis// dri dang ro la chags pa las/ yul du snang ba'i rnam shes gzugs sgra dri ro sogs la/ blang dor byas pas lus khams de ni/ rang snang pho mo snang mun dang*/ bde sdug 'dod sred brtas par 'gyur// gnyis pa mngal skyes kyi skye ba len tshul la gsum/ khams drug gi rgyu rkyen la brten nas 'byung pa'i rim pa dang bcas pa dang*/

mngal du ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul/ skye ba'i rim pa bstan pa'o/ dang po la gnyis/ khams drug gi rgyu dang rang bzhin/ khams kyi rgyu sems kyi rten 'brel bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de nas mngal skyes grub pa na// lus 'di la ni rus pa dang*/ dwangs snyigs sogs khams kyi tshogs sum bcu so drug yod pa de rnams/ ma lus bskyed byed kyi ma des/ ro drug gi bza' btung spyad pa las 'byung ste/ lus kyi 'byung bzhi 'grub cing rgyas pa'i rkyen byed do// ro drug 'byung ba lnga las te/ kha ba rlung*/ tsha ba me/ mngar ba chu/ lan tshwa sa yi khams/ ska ba dang*/ skyur ba mkha' dang bde ba ye shes kyi khams/ thabs shes zung 'jug gi sbyor bas brten nas/ rdo rje'i lus brtan par bskyed cing 'grub pa yin no// mngal 'dzin pa'i khams ni// pad+mar chud pa'i sa bon ni// 'dzin pa sa khams rang bzhin te// chus bskyed me yis smin par byed// rlung gis 'phel byed nam mkha' yis// go skabs 'byed par byed pa yin// gnyis pa ni/ de nyid skye bar byed pa yang*/ bo la ka k+ko la sbyor bas// reg pa sra ba'i bag chags nyid// bdag tu bzung ba las/ sa ni de las skye bar 'gyur// byang sems khu ba'i rang bzhin bdag tu gzung ba las// chu yi khams ni 'byung ba ste// bskyod pa la bdag tu bzung ba las ni drod skye ste// g.yo ba'i cha la bdag tu bzung ba de la rlung gi khams du rab tu grags/ de gnyis kyi bde ba la bdag tu bzung ba las nam mkha' nyid kyi khams te/ de ltar bdag 'dzin lnga pos rnam par shes pa bskor ste/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis kyi tshul/ ma rig pa la sogs pas bskyed nas srid pa'i 'khor ba 'grub bo/ gnyis pa mngal du ji ltar 'jug pa'i tshul ni/ mngal du 'jug pa'i rgyu ni bar do'i rnam shes/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes te/ bag chags sna tshogs pa can/ nyon mong can gyi yid dang bcas pa/ de yang phra ba'i rlung gi ngo bos/

'od zer lnga ldan ces kyang grags pa des gzugs gzhan pho mo 'du 'phrod sbyor ba mthong zhing*/ rten bzang ngan gyi don ni nges par mi shes shing*/ srog chen po'i rlung tsam gcig pu gtso bor gyur bas/ rmong pa'i rang bzhin can de yul la 'du byed pa'i nyon yid kyi/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes bkug nas ni/ mngal du 'jug pa'i bag chags rnam par spyod/ bag chags nyid kyis mngal du rnam shes gzung ngo*// de tshe khu phrag rnam shes bcas chags pa'i mes zhu thig las/ khu phrag rnam shes bcas/ 'dres pa ru ni gyur pa dang*/ kun gzhi rnam shes rgyu bcas pa/ ji ltar chang dos myos pa bzhin// gsum pa skye ba'i rim pa bstan pa la gsum/ srog chen po'i rlung ji ltar 'byung ba/ zla ba bcur ji ltar 'phel ba'i rim pa rgyas bar bshad pa/ rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs shing skye ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ nyon mongs can yid srog rlung nyid/ mngal du zhugs pa nas/ skad cig la yang je rags su yang dag 'gro zhing*/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsa ma chags pa'i gnas skabs dang*/ rtsa chags nas rlung bcus ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ nur nur mer mer ltar ltar po// gor gor po de bdun phrag bzhi rnams su// las rlung bzhi dag gis dkrugs shing*// sdud par byed pas dbyibs bzhir 'gyur// gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i rlung lngas 'phel ba'i tshul dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lngas 'phel ba'i tshul lo// dang po la lnga/ srog /thur sel/ gyen rgyu/ khyab byed/ mnyam gnas kyis 'phel tshul lo// dang po ni/ mkhrang 'gyur zhag ni bdun chags pa'i dang po nas// rang sor phyed dang bcu gsum gyi// tshad ldan dbu ma srog rlung bcas// bskyed nas snying dang lte ba yi// 'khor lo rlung bcu'i rten chags nas// nya yi rnam pa lta bur 'gyur// lte bar ma yi rtsar 'brel bas// mngal gnas de'i rlung khrag rgyas par byed par 'gyur// de nas zla ba gnyis pa nas// zhag re rtsa ni nyis brgya chags// gnyis pa ni/

srog las thur sel 'phros nas ni// gsum pa ni/ rus sbal rnam pa lta bur byed// zla ba gsum par gyen rgyu yis// rlung gis stod rnams sgrub par byed// 'di yan gyi rlung gsum kyi nus pas/ rnam shes dang*/ 'du byed kyi phung po grub bo// bzhi pa ni/ bzhi pa khyab byed rlung gis ni// yan lag rtsa rnams snang bar byed/ lnga pa ni/ lnga par mnyam gnas rlung 'phros nas// nang gi gnas gzhan glo snying sogs rnams sgrub par byed// phag rgod seng ge'i gnas skabs yin// mnyam gnas dang*/ khyab byed kyi rlung gnyis stobs rdzogs/ 'di bar rlung gnyis kyi stobs kyis 'du shes dang*/ tshor ba'i phung po rdzogs nas/ lus ni 'gul dang 'dar bar 'gyur// de dus rus tshigs dum bu ni// sum brgya drug cu chags par 'gyur// gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung lngas ji ltar 'phel ba'i tshul la gnyis/ mtshams sbyar ba dang*/ don dngos so// dang po ni/ de nas gzugs kyi phung po'ang grub ste// de ltar phung po lnga rdzogs nas/ gnyis pa ni/ zla ba drug par phyin pa na// klu'i rlung gis stobs bskyed nas// sa khams cha las mig gnyis bskyed// de las bdun par rus sbal rlung*// spros nas chu khams rna bug dod// brgyad par me khams sna bug byed// de tshe rtsangs pa'i rlung spro'o// dgu par lha sbyin rlung 'byung ste// ro can lce ni bskyed par byed// bcu par nor las rgyal gyi rlung*// bskyed nas rlung bcu'i nus pa rdzogs// gsum pa rtsa rlung thig le rdzogs shing skye ba'i tshul la gnyis/ rtsa rlung thig le sogs rdzogs pa'i tshul dang*/ skye ba'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar khams dang skye mched rdzogs// zla re drug stong rtsa chags pas// mngal du stong phrag lnga bcu bzhi// skyes nas kyang zla ba gsum pa ma rdzogs kyi bar na/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis rdzogs// mngal zla dgu pa nas ni mi gtsang za// de nas snyigs ma'i khams 'byung ngo*// bkres skom rlung gis tshor ba yis// sdug bsngal drag po myong bar 'gyur// gnyis pa ni/

de tshe 'byin pa'i rlung gis ni// bsgyur nas skye bar byed pa yin// mi yi seng ge'i gnas skabs so// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar phung po khams skye mched// rtsa rlung thig le las grub pa// dri mar bcas pa'i sems nyid las// byung ste dri bcas sprul skur gsungs// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni// zab mo nang gi don rgyas par bshad pa las// mngal du lus grub pa'i tshul te gnyis pa'o/// /de ltar rags pa'i lus grub tshul song nas/ lus der brtan pa 'phra ba'i lus rtsa yi rnam bzhag bshad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ le'u'i mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ de nas rtsa rnams gnas tshul bshad// dbu ma ro rkyang gtso mo gsum dang*/ gzhan rtsa yi 'khor lo rnams dang*// nad bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa bcas dang*// stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis dang*// de bas phra ba'ang bshad par bya// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bdun/ rtsa dbu ma bshad pa/ ro rkyang gnyis/ rtsa'i gtso mo rnams/ rtsa'i 'khor lo/ nad bskyed pa'i rtsa/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rgyas bshad/ rtsa phra mo dang khams gang gis skyed bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ bshad pa dngos dang*/ de shes byed kyi lung dang sbyar ba/ mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ thog mar lus bskyed gzhir gyur pa// dbu ma srog rlung bcas pa ste// 'khor lo drug gi dbus na ni// bar thag rang sor bcu gnyis dang*// phyed bcas gsang ba spyi gtsug bar// yar sna ham̐ gi rang bzhin gyis// dkar cha'i dwangs mas bkag pa'i tshul// lte bar ma las thob pa yi// dmar cha khrag ste a thung brjod// de gnyis bar na kun gzhi'i rten// srog rlung gnas te nam mkha' 'dra// lte 'og man chad dung can zhes// dkar cha 'bab par byed pa yin// gnyis pa ni// 'di ni bde mchog sdom pa 'byung ba dang*/ sam+bu ṭi dang*/ nag po'i dpyid thig rnams nas// snying ga'i chu skyes dbus son pa// chu shing me tog ltar stong pa// ham̐ ni 'phyang zhing 'og tu blta// mar sna mar me lta bus brgyan// de 'og byang sems mnyam 'bab pa// a ba dhu tīr shes bya ste// lhan cig skyes ster byed pa'o// zhes gsungs so// gsum pa ni/

mdor na lus can rnams kyi srog rtsa dang dbyer mi phyed pa yin/ gnyis pa ro rkyang gnyis bshad pa la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ nges shes kyi lung dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ g.yas g.yon ro rkyang gnyis po ni// lte ba nas gyes mkhal mar 'brel// de nas snying gar cung zad 'dul// mchan 'og brgyud nas mgrin par ste// rtse chung nas ni spyi bor 'brel// sna bug gnyis su yar sna 'byung*// 'og tu gsum 'dus nas gyes te// bud med kyi khrag dang*/ gnyis ka'i dri chen 'byin sdom gyi// las ni g.yas pa ro mas byed// g.yon nas rkyang mas dri chu yi// 'byin sdom byed par bshad pa yin// lte steng yan chad g.yas par nyi ma dang*// g.yon par zla ba'i rlung rgyu ste// lte bar rtsa ni drug cu bzhi// rtsa gsum gcig tu gyur pa na// dus sbyor gyi rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi'am phung po sum cu rtsa drug dang khams sum cu rtsa drug pa gnyis kyis dus sbyor gyi rtsa don gnyis su gyes shing*/ rlung rgyu bas phyi rol dang*/ steng 'og gi sgo sogs dang*/ nang srog gi rlung sogs kun gso zhing bskyed par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ 'di ni dang po'i sangs rgyas las// de ni thur du rtse gsum ste// de bzhin gyen du'ang rtse gsum mo// sgra gcan rtse mo'i dbus na gnas// nyi ma'i rtse mo g.yas pa'o// zla ba'i rtse mo g.yon pa'o// chu dang me dang nam mkha' yi rlung rgyu// g.yas g.yon dbu ma'i mar sna nas// g.yas gshang ba/ g.yon gci ba/ dbu ma khu ba rgyu// 'khor lo so so'i lte bar rtsa rnams mdud pas// lcags sgrog bcings pa lta bu'i rtsa/ ro rkyang dbu gsum gyi lte ba zla nyi sgra gcan gyi srog gsum gyi rlung gi lam dang*/ lte 'og man gshang gci/ khu ba/ thur sel gsum gyi lam yin pas// srog gsum dang thur sel lam gsum nyid// gsum pa rtsa'i gtso mo bshad pa la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/

rtsa nyer bzhi po ngos bzung ba/ sbas pa'i rtsa lnga bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa yi gtso mo 'di gsum las gyes pa'i rtsa chen po/ nyi shu bzhi dang ste snying ga yi/ yan lag gi rlung ni brten pa'i rtsa// lnga dang rtsa yi gtso mo gsum bcas pa bsdoms pas/ rtsa sum bcu so gnyis te/ de yi steng du rtsa ba yis// rlung brten rtsa lnga bcas bsdoms pa rtsa sum cu bdun yin/ gnyis pa rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi po ngos bzung ba la gsum/ rkyang ma las skyes pa'i rtsa bcu bzhi/ ro ma las skyes pa bcu bshad/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ rtsa gsum po 'di yi g.yon pa'i char rkyang ma las skyes pa yi rtsa bcu bzhi ni/ mi phyed ma ni 'tshogs mar gnas// phra gzugs ma ni spyi gtsug 'brel// rtse ba ma ni rna g.yas te// g.yon pa ma ni ltag rtsa'o// thung ngu zhes bya rna ba g.yon// rus sbal skyes ma smin dbus te/ mig gi phyi rol sgom pa mo// dbang ma phrag pa gnyis kyi rtsa// skyon ma mchan khung rtsa yin te// mjug ma zhes bya nu ma'i rtsa// ma mo lte ba'i rtsa yin te// sna rtser zug pa mtshan mo'o// kha la gnas pa'i bsil sbyin ma// mgrin dbus tsha ba ma gnas so// rkyang ma de dag kun brten pa'o// 'di rnams kyi rang bzhin zla ba'i khams 'bab par byed pa'o// shes rab rang bzhin no// bsam pa'i shes rab dang*/ lus kyi sgo nas thabs kyi cha zla ba yar ngo dag pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ ro ma la brten thabs kyi cha shas su gyur pa'i rtsa bcu bzhi ni/ gzhol ma srang gi gzhung du gnas// rangs ma lgang par 'brel pa ste// shin tu gzugs can mtshan mar gnas// spyi ma 'og sgor 'brel pa ste// rgyu sbyin brla yi rtsa chen yin// sbyor bral ma ni byin par gnas// sdu gu rkang pa'i sor mor 'brel// grub ma bol gong rtsa yin te// 'tshed ma rkang mtheb spu 'khyil rtsa// yid bzang pus mo'i gnya' gong gnas// 'di rnams bsam pa'i sgo nas thabs dang*/

lus kyi sgo nas shes rab ste/ zla ba mar gyi rnam par dag pa'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar ro rkyang la brten pa'i rtsa nyer bzhi po/ phyi rol yul nyer bzhi rnams/ rdo rje'i lus kyi nang gi gnas su rdzogs par 'dod pa mtshon no// gsum pa sbas pa'i rtsa lnga ni// sum skor 'dod ma khyim ma dang*// gtum mo zhes bya rtsa bzhi ni// mig dang rna ba sna dang lcer// snying dbus nas mig sogs bzhi 'brel zhing*/ rtsa der rlung rgyu nas/ mig la gzugs 'bab par byed pa la sogs pa'i yon tan skye ba'i rtsa/ rtsa bdud bral a'i rtse mo gcig lce'u chung gi dbus su zug nas/ khams dkar cha gyen du 'dren par byed la/ de yi rtse mo gzhan yang yod pa/ de rnams kyis ni lus kyi stod smad kun tu khyab cing*/ de rnams kyi byed las reg bya 'bab par byed do// 'dir ni lus kyi snying dbus su// rtsa lnga po ni yang dag gnas// srog chen po'i rlung ni rtsa a ba dhu tī'i yar snar rgyu ste/ de las gzhan ni/ dung can ma nas thur sel gyi rlung dang*/ gyen rgyu'i rlung rtsa glang po che'i lce dang*/ khyab byed kyi gnas ser skya dang*/ mi mnyam gyi gnas snar ma ste/ de rnams rtsa ba'i rlung rgyu'i gnas te/ rtsa ba'i rtsa lnga yin no// bzhi pa rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ de nas rtsa 'khor lo bzhi dang drug /bco brgyad la sogs dbye ba ni// gnyis pa la gsum/ rtsa ba'i 'khor lo bzhi bshad pa/ drug bshad pa/ tshigs kyi 'khor lo bshad pa'o// dang po la lnga/ lte ba/ snying ga /mgrin pa/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo bshad pa/ thun mong gi don bsdu ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa/ rtsa 'dab kyi ming rdo rje phreng ba'i lung dang sbyar nas mjug bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo ni// dbu ma las gyi rtsa 'dab bzhi la ni// stong pa ye shes kyi khams kyi rtsa zhes bshad// rtsa bzhi po de las gsum tshan du gyes pa'i rtsa bcu gnyis ni/

'pho ba bcu gnyis brten pa'i rtsa de rnams// nang sems kyi rim par phye ba yis// 'pho chen re re la'ang 'pho chung lnga lngar dbye bas/ lnga tshan bcu gnyis su gyes pas rtsa drug cu ste/ g.yas pa'i rtsa sum cu ni ro mar 'brel ba/ glang sogs mnyam pa'i dus sbyor gyi 'pho ba drug brten pa dang*/ de bzhin g.yon pa'i rtsa sum cu ni g.yon rkyang ma dang 'brel ba/ lug sogs mi mnyam pa'i dus sbyor drug gi 'pho ba brten zhing*/ ye shes kyi khams kyi rtsa bzhi po ni dbu ma'i 'pho ba brten pa yin no/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa drug cu rtsa bzhi po rnams kyi ming ni rdo rje phreng ba las/ yang dag shugs dang shin tu shugs// shin tu bzang dang bzang por 'gro// rtsa bzhi po de ni snga ma gnyis rlung dbu mar 'jug pa dang*/ phyi ma gnyis srog dbu mar 'dzin pa'i don gyis na ro rkyang las rlung dbu mar 'pho ba'i rtsa bzhi 'o// stobs chen dang ni mi bzad che// mdzes chen mdun du skyes pa che// rgyags pa'i rtags 'di lnga ni lug gi dus sbyor brten pa'i rtsa lnga yin pa dang*/ rgyags pa'i cha// rgyags pa'i chu dang rgyags smyo byed// rgyags dang rgyags pa'i rgyu mthun dang*// 'di rnams ni glang gi dus sbyor gyi rtsa'o// rgyags pa'i rlan dang rgyags la 'chang*// rtsub dang kha chu glang po 'di rnams 'khrig pa'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa lnga dang*// dbugs mi bde dang g.ya' kha 'gro/ 'dab chags yan lag khra yi gdong*/ za phod 'di rnams ni karka ṭa'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa lnga'o// mi bzad sgra sgrogs dang*/ dri ldan brdegs dad brtul ba dang lnga ni seng ge'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa dang*/ dbyangs dang dbyangs skyes dang ni sprin/ chub ma tho dang rgya ltar sngo// 'di rnams bu mo'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa lnga'o// yud tsam gtso bo yud tsam skyes// rgyab tu kha bltas dbyug pa dang*// dbyug snyoms 'di lnga srang gi dus sbyor gyi rtsa dang ni/

rnying pa dang*/ tshigs kyi lha dang tshigs kyi tshigs/ tshigs kyi tshad dang brtul ba lnga ni sdig pa'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa dang*// tshigs kyi gnas dang tshigs kyi gdong*// tshigs 'od tshigs kyi lu gu brgyud// ngal byed lnga ni gzhu yi dus sbyor gyi rtsa yin/ dul 'gro gzi brjid dang*/ dri med dul ba bsnyems ma dang*// chun 'phyang lto lnga ni chu srin dus sbyor gyi rtsa'i ming dang*/ chags pa chags// chun 'phyang chun 'phyang phyed sbrang bu// phru gu phru gu ster lnga ni bum pa'i dus sbyor gyi rtsa lnga yi ming yin/ 'gro ba/ lo ma lo ma'i mgrin pa dang*// rab mchog ma dang ra za gsal lnga ni nya yi dus sbyor gyi rtsa ste// de ltar drug cu rtsa bzhi 'o// gnyis pa snying ga'i 'khor lo bshad pa la'ang gnyis/ spyir bstan/ lung sbyar/ mjug bsdu'o// dang po ni/ snying ga'i yid kyi rnam shes chos rnams la skye zhing mched ba'i gnas kyi rtsa yi 'khor lo'i rtsa brgyad ming*/ gnyis pa ni/ rin chen cod pan pad+ma che// rdo rje chen po stobs po che// de dag gi dbang byed pa'i thabs kyi cha dang*/ de'i shes rab kyi cha 'dzin pas gzugs snang mthong bas/ mgon po che dang*/ sgra 'dzin pas na sgra chen dang*/ dri la nye bar 'dzin pas na nyer dga' chen po dang*/ ro 'dzin pas ro des myos pa che ste/ rtsa 'dab brgyad po 'di rnams kyi 'khor lo'i yar mar gyi rtser lus kun khyab// gsum pa mgrin pa'i 'khor lo bshad pa la'ang gnyis/ spyir bstan/ lung sbyar mjug bsdu'o// dang po ni/ mgrin par zas skom la longs spyod pa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug ni/ gnyis pa ni/ longs spyod longs spyod ster dang gsang*// nyi 'gro gsal dang skal ba dang*// sgom pa dang ni thal ba'i gdong*// bza' ster zla dang dkres pa dang*// bcud len rol ni bkur ba dang*// ro 'jig pa dang ro dang ni// khrung khrung longs spyod 'khor lor gnas// bzhi pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo bshad pa la'ang gnyis/

spyir bstan/ lung sbyar mjug bsdu'o/ dang po ni/ spyi bo na gnas shing bde chen gyi rten dkar cha/ brten pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi 'khor lo na// rtsa 'dab snga gyi gnyis la brgyad brgyad dbye bas/ bcu drug la thig le dkar cha brten pa thabs dang*/ de'i phyi rol na phrag rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab shes rab kyi rang bzhin bcu drug yod pas/ sum cu rtsa gnyis su ni thabs shes kyi dbye bas 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ rim rig dang ni 'dod pa can// 'dod can ma dang srog gi lus// zla thung zla ster mdzes pa ni// 'dod can mi smra ku sha dang*// shi ba spong dang dag pa dang*// me dang me ri ne tso dang*// gang ba nyid dang ro ldan dang*// kos ring chang ster bdud rtsi dang*// dung can dang ni dung sna dang*// dung gi mig dang dung gi rna// rgyas dang dbang rgyags brkam pa dang*// rgyags pas rgyal dang ngo mtshar rgyags// snyoms pa dang ni tshigs kyi brten// sum cu rtsa gnyis zhes ni bshad// lnga pa thun mong gi don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar rtsa 'khor lnga'i 'dab ma bsdom pas brgya dang nyi shu ni/ lus kyi rtsa yi gtso bo zhes ni rgyud rdo rje phreng ba nas bshad pa yin/ gnyis pa 'khor lo drug bshad pa la gnyis/ rdo rje phreng ba las gsung tshul dang*/ rgyud phan tshun gyi dgongs pa bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ spyi bstan pa dang*/ rtsa 'dab kyi ming lung dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ gtsug tor rlung gi 'khor lo dang*/ gtsug gtor gyi mgrin pa me yi 'khor lo/ de la gnas pa'i rtsa ni dgu yod de/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshe gtsug tor bskyed pa'i rgyu yin cing*/ da lta bshad don ltar na/ dbu ma'i rtse mo spyi bo nas mdun thur du gug nas smin mtshams su yod cing*/ 'di skabs kyi dbu ma 'di lta bu yin cing*/ tshangs bug smin mtshams su yod/ mchan/ de rtse mo'i 'khor lo ni smin mtshams na rtsa 'dab drug pa gcig de'i mgrin pa ste/

skra mtshams su gtsug gtor gyi mgrin pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dabs dgu yod pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ smin ma'i dbus na rlung 'khor lo// rtsa 'dab drug gi ming ni// dbye ba 'khyil pa mi zad pa// mi bzad brtan dang mtshan nyid can// 'dzin pa rtog med gang ba ni// rtsa gsum 'dzin pa sogs gsum ni me yi 'khor lo dang ldan pa'o// gnyis pa rgyud phan tshun gyi dgongs pa bshad pa la gnyis/ rgyud phan tshun dgongs pa mthun par bstan pa dang*/ dgongs gzhi gzhan bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dus kyi 'khor lor gang gsungs pa ni/ gtsug gtor gyi rtsa 'di bdun gsang ba'i gnas su yod par gsungs te gzhan yang spyi bo rtsa so gnyis dang mtshungs gsang ba'i 'khor lo ru yang*/ rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis 'dab ma yod pa yin/ zhes dus 'khor nas gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa 'khor de dag gi dbus na gnas pa ni/ rtsa bye ba smin dbus/ spyi bor 'khyil ba/ mgrin par mi zad pa/ snying dbus ming bzang*/ lte dbus brtan pa/ gsang bar mtshan nyid can gnas pa ste/ dus 'khor las/ stong pa drug gi rtsa yin no// zhes gsungs so// 'di rnams 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhi'i dag pa dang sbyar bas/ gsung gi sgo zhes bya/ gsum pa tshigs kyi 'khor lo bshad pa la gsum/ lag pa g.yas pa'i tshigs chen gyi 'khor lo gsum/ tshig phran gyi 'khor lo bco lnga/ lag pa g.yon pa sogs de dang 'dra bar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ tshigs khams kyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis las// lag pa g.yas pa'i tshigs gsum la// rlung gi khams kyis bskyed pa yis/ rtsa 'khor gsum gyi rtsa 'dab rnams kyi rtsa 'dab ni sum cu sum cu gnas pa bsdoms pas rtsa 'dab dgu bcur yod do// gnyis pa ni/ lag pa'i tshigs phran g.yas pa'i sor mo'i tshigs ni re re la// rtsa ni drug drug tu yod par 'gyur ste/ bsdoms pa'i rtsa 'dab kyi grangs ni gong dang mtshungs pa ste/ dgu bcu yod pa'o// gsum pa la gnyis/

tshigs chen gyi 'khor lo dang*/ tshigs phran gyi 'khor lo'o// dang po ni/ de bzhin lag g.yon me yi khams// rkang pa g.yas pa chu khams te// g.yon pa sa khams snga ma bzhin// de ltar tshigs chen kyi 'khor lo bcu gnyis la/ rer rer rtsa 'dab sum cu re yod pa bsdams pas// rtsa ni sum brgya drug cu'o// gnyis pa ni/ sor tshigs tshigs phran gyi 'khor lo drug po re rer rtsa drug re yod pa rnams bsdoms pas/ rtsa grangs tshigs chen gyi de dang mnyam par sum brgya drug cu yod/ lnga pa nad bskyed pa'i rtsa bshad pa la gnyis/ bshad pa dngos dang*/ dogs gcod do/ dang po ni/ nad ni bskyed par byed pa'i rtsa/ gtsug gtor 'khor lo'i phyir rtsa bzhi dang*// dpral ba'i 'khor lo'i phyi yi/ rtsa bcu drug gis bad kan skyed par byed/ mgrin par rtsa ni sum cu gnyis// snying ga'i brgyad rnams mkhris pa bskyed// lte ba'i drug cu rtsa bzhi dang*// gsang ba'i gnas kyi 'khor lo'i phyi rol rtsa bcu drug gis// rlung gi khams 'khrugs gsang ba yi// nad rim bcu drug 'dus pa bskyed// de ltar na bskyed pa'i rtsa yi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu drug go /gnyis pa ni/ 'di rnams 'khor lo so so'i phyi rim na yod ste/ gzhan mi shes pa dag gis ni 'khor lo nyid du 'dod par byed de/ de ni ma yin no// drug pa rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi dbye ba la gnyis/ mdor bstan rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi// rnam dbye rgyas par rdo rje phreng ba las gsungs pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ khams rang gi ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba dang*/ byed las kyi sgo nas dbye ba'o/ dang po ni/ de ltar rtsa de rnams las rtsa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ zla ba'i rlung dang dkar cha 'bab pa rkyang ma'i rigs/ stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/ nyi ma'i rlung dang dmar cha 'bab pa ro ma'i rigs/ stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni/

rlung kho na rgyu bas dbu ma'i rigs su brjod do// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis po de yang dbye gzhi lus la gnas las na/ mi phyed ma sogs rtsa ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi pa re re bzhin/ mi phyed ma nas yid bzang par/ lus kyi gnas su rlung thig gnyis kyi bya ba byas zin pas ni thim dang*/ longs spyod byed bzhin pa dang*/ bdag po yi ma 'ongs par bya ba 'byed par 'gyur bas na/ ngo bo'i sgo nas rlung rgyu ba thim/ thig le 'bab pa longs spyod/ khrag 'bab pa bdag po yin par 'dod do// nyer bzhi po re re la dbye bas gsum gsum ste bsdoms pas bdun cu gnyis/ re re'ang phung khams sogs kyi dbye bas brgya brgya/ de rlung bcus bsgyur bas stong stong sogs kyis rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod pa rnams 'khor ni stong stong ngo*// dper na shing sdong po gcig la ni/ yal ga lo 'dab gyes pa bzhin no// bdun pa rtsa phra mo dang khams gang gis bskyed pa la gnyis/ rtsa phra mor bshad pa dang*/ khams gang gis bskyed bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ de las kyang phra ba'i rtsa rnams ni/ bye ba phrag ni phyed dang bzhi rnams kyis/ lus kyi ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi skyed par byed pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa 'khor rtsa phran bcas pa 'di rnams khams kyi rim pa ni/ lte ba sa ste snying ga rlung*// mgrin pa me la spyi bo chu// gtsug tor nam mkha' gsang ba ni/ ye shes bde ba'i rigs su gsungs// de bzhin ba spu'i mthar thug par// gnas pa'i rtsa rnams kyang*/ khams drug gis ni rim par bskyed// de bzhin g.yas phyogs kyi rtsa rnams ro ma dang*/ g.yon phyogs rnams rkyang ma/ dbus phyogs rnams dbu ma ste/ de rnams kyi dag pa brjod pa'i dbye ba las/ sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum yin/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar rtsa yi mtshan nyid shes na/ lus kyi gnas lugs rtogs par 'gyur ro// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/

zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las/ lus kyi rtsa rgyas par bstan pa ste gsum pa'o// de ltar lus la gnas pa'i rtsa'i tshul bshad zin nas rtsa de'ang rlung gis sgrub cing rtsa'i nang rlung rgyu ba'i phyir rlung gi rnam bzhag 'chad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung*/ le'u'i mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas rlung gi ngo bo ni/ rlung gi gnas dang*/ rlung de'i byed las/ rlung de ji ltar rgyu ba'i tshul dang*/ rlung de'i stobs dang stobs med rim pa dang*/ rlung gi 'jug pa dang*/ rlung de bzung thabs de'i skyon yon rnams/ rim pa bzhin du 'dir bshad bya// gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi ngo bo// gnas byed las dang bcas pa/ phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rim pa byed las dang bcas pa/ 'jug sgo phan yon dang bcas pa/ 'khor 'das thams cad rlung gi rang bzhin du bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bstan pa dang bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rlung de la brten nas ni brjod pa ngag dang dus sbyor rnams te/ dbyangs gsal gyi yi ge thams cad kyang rlung 'di las skyes so// gnyis pa la gsum/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga'i ngo bo/ yan lag gi rlung lnga'i ngo bo/ bskyed bya skyed byed kyi tshul lo// dang po ni/ de yang thog mar lus chags pa'i tshe/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes la brten pa 'du byed yid kyi g.yo ba srog chen po'i rlung ste lus dang rnam shes kyi rten byed pa de grub pa yin/ de yang thog mar kun gzhi'i rnam shes la srog rlung brten pa yin cing*/ srog rlung de yi ge a yi rnam pa can/ nam mkha'i khams kyi rang bzhin yin la/ de las 'phros pa'i rlung thur sel sa khams l̥ yig ste/ gyen rgyu me khams ṛ yin no// mi mnyam rlung khams i zhes brjod/ khyam byed chu yi khams de yi ge u ru 'gyur/ gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung lnga'i ngo bo ni/

de nas yan lag rlung lnga las ni/ klu ni sas bskyed pas/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir/ yi ge nam mkha' yi rang bzhin ā'o// de bzhin du/ rus sbal rlung ste e ru bshad// rtsangs pa me ste ār nyid yin// lha sbyin chu khams o ru 'gyur// āl ni sa khams nor las rgyal// gsum pa bskyed sdud kyi tshul la gnyis te/ dngos dang*/ de ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i lung dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ rlung de rnams ma yi mngal du grub pa'i tshe/ thog mar zla ba dang por srog rlung grub pa/ de bzhin tu/ zla ba re re ste/ zla ba bcur rim par grub la/ rim bskyed da lta rtsa ba'i rlung lngas phung po lnga dang*/ yan lag gi rlung lngas dbang po'i rten byed pa sogs lus ngag gi rnam 'gyur ste/ las kun byed cing*/ mthar bsdud pa ni/ skyes nas lo bcu lon tshe/ nor las rgyal gyi rlung gi nus pa lhas byin gyi rlung la sdud pa sogs kyi 'gres/ lo brgya nas rlung bcu'i nus pa thams cad bsdu'o// lo ni bcu bcur bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ 'di ni ye shes rdo rje kun btus kyi rgyud las// sems nyid 'od gsal ni ye shes rlung ngo*// kun gzhi yi rnam shes bdun pa nyon yid dang bcas pa ni mkha' yi rlung ste nyon yid bcas/ nyon yid de las yul 'du byed bcas langs pa ni rlung gi rlung yin ste/ tshor ba ni rgyud sred par byed pas me yi rlung dang*/ 'du shes ni yul mtshan mar 'dzin cing bsdud pas chu yi rlung yin la gzugs ni sra zhing brtan pa'i khams yin pas sa yi rlung zhes// rim pas bskyed bya phung po lnga/ skyed byed khams lngar gsungs so// gnyis pa gnas byed las dang bcas pa bshad pa la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de ltar rlung de rnams lus gnas smra brjod la sogs pa'i las kun byed pa yin/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang*/

yan lag gi rlung lnga'i gnas byed las dang bcas pa'o// dang po la lnga/ srog rlung gi thur sel gyi/ me mnyam gyi/ gyen rgyu'i/ khyab byed kyi rlung gi gnas byed las dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ spyir srog rlung ni lus rnams khyab kyang*/ rtsa thams cad kyi rtsa ba dbu ma der/ srog chen po'i rlung de ni/ rtsa dbu ma'i dbus gnas shing kun gzhi brten par byed la/ cha shas dus sbyor gyi rlung dang 'dres par rgyu zhing*/ gtso bor ni srog rlung de'i ming nam mkha'i mgon po zhes bya ba/ 'chi ba'i tshe na yang dag rgyu'o// da lta ni lus 'tsho ba'i tshe byed las bdag tu 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog gi dran pa 'di bskyed do// gnas dbu ma de las gzhan tu log na brgya la smyo 'chi bar byed la/ las rlung 'di dang ye shes kyi rlung ni gsal la mi rtog par 'dres par gnas shing*/ de'i kha dog ni kha dog med pa'i kha dog can nam mkha' lta bu cir yang ma grub par bshad do// gnyis pa ni/ thur sel gyi rlung lte ba'i 'og tu rtsa gsum 'dus pa nas// 'og 'gro dwangs snyigs 'byin sdom byed/ rtsa ba'i rtsa dbu ma'i mar sne dung can na gnas la ngo bo ni bde ba'i ye shes kyi khams so/ rtsa de las log na smad kyi nad skyed byed/ gsum pa ni/ me mnyam gyi rlung ni snying ga'i mdun phyogs rtsa snar ma las byung zhing*/ rtse mo gcig pho bar zug ste/ zas kyi dwangs snyigs 'byed cing*/ dwangs ma lus kun tu khyer bar byed la log gyur na/ sbo 'khrog 'khru dang ma rungs byed/ bzhi pa ni/ gyen rgyu yi rlung snying ga'i me mtshams kyi rtsa glang chen lce las byung zhing*/ mgrin pa'i gnas su zas skom mid pa sogs las kun byed cing*/ lus ngag gi glu gar la sogs pa rnams kyang bskyed pa yin cing*/ de log na stod nad phal cher byed/ lnga pa ni/ khyab byed g.yas phyogs ro ma dang*/ 'brel nas rtsa chen gyi nang nas byung zhing*/

lus tshigs kun la gnas la/ byed las ni lus kyi stobs bskyed par byed de log pas/ yan lag zha rengs nad kun byed// gnyis pa yan lag gi rlung lnga'i gnas byed las dang bcas pa ni/ lho nub bden bral dang*/ rgyab phyogs dang*/ rlung mtshams dang*/ g.yon phyogs dang*/ dbang ldan rnams su rim pa ltar/ klu sogs yan lag rlung lnga gnas ste/ klu yis sogs g.yas thad kyi rtsa 'dab rgyal nas/ rtse mo mig la zug nas byed las gzugs 'dzin/ rtse mo gzhan lus la khyab pas lus sgeg byed/ rus sbal snying ga'i rgyab kyi rtsa rgyal ba las rgyus nas/ rna bas sgra 'dzin/ rtse mo gzhan gyis rkang lag bskyod/ rtsangs pa sogs g.yon thad kyi rtsa a bu ṣa nas rgyus nas snas dri 'dzin cing*/ phyogs gzhan gyi khong khro 'khrug par byed/ lha sbyin g.yon phyogs kyi rtsa iḍa nas rgyus nas/ rtse mo gcig lcer zug pas ro 'dzin cing*/ phyogs gcig gis glal ba byed/ nor rgyal gyi rlung ni/ nu g.yon thad kyi rtsa ku hā la rgyus nas/ lce'u chung brgyud cing*/ dkar cha gyen du 'dren la/ phyogs gcig gis reg 'dzin lus 'di la shi nas ma 'thor bar du gnas shing*/ lus kyi sra ba'i khams 'dzin no// gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ rlung bcu po rnams da lta nyin mtshan gyi thun brgyad rang bzhin te/ 'di rnams kyi rgyu tshul dang*/ zangs la brten nas gtso bor thun brgyad dang*/ dus sbyor sogs bstan pa yin no// gsum pa phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rim pa byed las dang bcas pa bshad pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ rlung de nyid rgyu tshul phyir rgyu ba dang*/ nang du rgyu ba gnyis yin te/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ nang du rgyu ba dang*/ phyir rgyu ba dang*/ ji ltar rgyu ba'i rim pa kha dog dang stobs dang yon tan bshad pa dang*/ rgyud phan tshun dgongs pa mi 'gal bar bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bshad pa dang*/

bsdu ba'o// dang po la lnga/ rtsa 'khor lo bzhir rgyu tshul dang*/ spyi'i khams bshad pa/ tshigs kyi 'khor lor rgyu ba'i tshul/ rtsa thams cad kyi rgyu lugs/ zhar la 'gag pa'i nges pa bstan pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ snying ga'i 'khor lo dang*/ spyi bo/ mgrin pa/ lte ba'i 'khor lor rgyu tshul lo// dang po ni/ srog rlung sgra gcan gyi rang bzhin can ni/ mngal du chags pa nas ma shi'i bar/ dbu mar rgyal po lta bur gnas shing*/ de las 'phros pa'i rlung ni rtsa ba dang*/ yan lag gi bdag nyid can bcu po ni/ lus kyi stod smad/ phyi nang kun tu las byed pas blon po lta bu'o// zhes zhar byung du bshad pa'o// ji ltar snying ga'i 'khor lo ru rlung sde tshan brgyad rgyu ba ltar/ lte mgrin gyi 'khor lo gzhan rnams la yang de bzhin te/ sde tshan brgyad brgyad rgyu bar shes par bya'o// gnyis pa spyi bo'i 'khor lo la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ dus 'khor ba'i lugs/ bde dgyes sogs kyi lugs so// dang po ni/ spyi bo'i 'khor lo yi rtsa 'dab sum cu gnyis ni/ gong du thabs shes kyi dbye bas de ltar bstan cing*/ 'dir ni zung 'jug tu bshad cing*/ de yang lus kyi spyi bor gnas pa'i rtsa nang ma bcu drug ni dkar cha 'phel zhing*/ phyi rol gyi rtsa rnams ni khrag rgyu ba ste/ de ltar zla rkang 'phel 'grib kyi cha dang mtshungs pa'i rlung yon tan lnga ldan nas/ gcig ldan par rgyu bar dus 'khor du gsungs pa ltar/ rtsa bcu drug tu bshad do// zla ba'i rkang pa 'phel 'grib dang mtshungs pa'i/ rlung byang chub sems kyi yon tan lnga ldan sogs rgyu ba de'i phyir thabs shes zung 'jug gi rtsa bcu drug bshad/ gnyis pa ni/ snga rkang dang*/ phyi rkang bdun bdun gyi rdzogs mtshams stong mtshams kyi rtsa dpral ba dang*/ ltag par re re ste gnyis po ni ye shes kyi cha rgyu ba las 'byung ba'i yon tan med pa de gnyis ni stong pa'i rang bzhin te/

de las gzhan rnams rim bzhin g.yas bskor gyis/ dag rtsa bcu bzhi rnams la rim pa ltar/ rdul mun snying stobs gsum gyi rang bzhin pa'i rlung gzugs sgra sogs yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ rgyu ba'i rtsa gsum dang*/ de rjes rtsa gcig la chu yi rlung dri ma gtogs pa'i yon tan bzhi dang ldan pa gcig de nas rtsa gcig la me'i rlung gzugs dri gnyis ma gtogs pa'i yon tan gsum ldan gcig de rjes rtsa gcig la rlung gi rlung sgra reg gi yon tan gnyis dang ldan pa gcig de rjes rtsa gcig la nam mkha' rlung sgra yi yon tan gcig pu dang ldan pa ste/ rlung de rnams ni rim bzhin rgyu// phyi ma'i rtsa bdun rim pa bzlog pa ste/ dang por rtsa gcig la rlung yon tan gcig ldan nas/ gnyis ldan gcig gsum ldan gcig bzhi ldan gcig lnga ldan gsum bcas snga ma las lugs bzlog gis brtsi dgos/ rlung de dag ni rgyu ba mang nyung gis yon tan rim pa bzhin che 'bring chung ngu yi sa yin no// gsum pa bde dgyes sogs kyi lugs ni/ yang na bde dgyes sogs nas bstan pa'i rtsa 'dab so gnyis kyi dbang du byas na/ der rgyu ba'i rlung ni dbyug gu nyer brgyad kyi rang bzhin dang*/ stong pa gnyis thabs shes kyis dbye bas bzhir phyes pas bzhi ste/ so gnyis kyi rlung rgyu'o// spyir ni zhag gcig gi chu tshod gnyis gnyis la yud tsam re rer bgrangs pas/ yud tsam sum cu gnyis te// yud tsam sum cu gnyis kyi bdag nyid yin par brjod pa yang rgyud rnams nas gsungs so// gsum pa mgrin par rlung rgyu tshul gsum/ rtsa 'dab kyi dbye ba spyi bstan pa/ dus 'khor nas bshad pa'i rlung rgyu tshul/ rgyud gzhan las bshad pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ mgrin par rtsa ni bcu drug po las/ dus 'khor ltar na rtse de rnams thabs shes kyi dbye bas sum cu rtsa gnyis su 'gyur ro// gnyis pa ni/ 'dab ma so gnyis po de la mtshams kyi bzhir ni stong pa ye shes kyi rlung gi khams rgyu la/

gzhan lhag ma dag phyogs bzhir bdun bdun du gnas pa'i rtsa nyer brgyad la/ rgyu skar nyer brgyad kyi longs spyod dang mtshungs par rgyu ba yin/ gsum pa ni/ gzhan bde dgyes 'dus pa sogs nas rtsa ba'i rtsa bcu drug 'pho ba bcu drug gis rlung rgyu bar bshad// bzhi pa lte ba'i 'khor lo'i rgyu tshul la gnyis/ rtsa 'dab kyi dbye ba spyir bstan pa dang*/ rtsa rgyu tshul dus 'khor dang mthun par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ lte bar rtsa ni drug cu rtsa bzhi po de la/ dbu ma las gyis pa'i rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi las gsum gsum phye bas dus sbyor ram/ khyim bcu gnyis kyi grangs la nang gses kyi dbye bas phye bas na/ lnga tshan bcu gnyis gyes pa rnams bsdoms pa drug cu yod pa ste/ gnyis pa ni/ rtsa 'dab bcu drug po der dbyu gu drug cu'i bdag nyid kyi rlung de snyed rgyu ba nyid do// rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi po dar ni stong pa ye shes kyi rlung dbu mar rgyu ba yin no// gnyis pa rtsa spyi'i khams bshad pa ni/ gong du bstan pa'i lus kyi stod smad kun tu gnas pa'i rtsa de kun kyang khams dang sbyar na/ mdun phyogs thams cad rlung khams/ g.yas me g.yon chu rgyab phyogs sa// shar lho me mtshams sa rnams rlung*// bden bral me/ rlung mtshams sa/ dbang ldan chu khams te/ mtshams dang bcas pa 'dir ni rtsa rnams khams sogs dang sbyor tshul rags pa tsam bstan pa yin no// gsum pa tshigs kyi 'khor lor rlung rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ 'khor lo bzhir rlung rgyu ba de bzhin tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi// 'khor lo re re rtsa sum cur re yod// de rnams su rgyu ba sum cu re yod ste// rtsa kun la rlung gi rgyu ba bsdoms pa las sum brgya drug cu'i srog dang ldan la/ nying lag gi rtsa 'khor rnams kyi rtsa dang rlung rgyu ba'i tshul gyi grangs bsdoms pas/ tshigs chen rnams kyi rtsa rlung gi grangs dang mnyam pa'i sum brgya drug cu yod pa/

de dang mtshungs pa yin/ bzhi pa rtsa thams cad rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ de ltar bshad pa'i rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis po de las/ de nas thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi rtsa stong phrag nyi shu bzhir ni/ 'gro ba ste rgyu ba'i sgra gcan gyi rlung ni dbu ma'i bdag nyid de/ dbu mar 'gro bar gsungs/ dkar chas sku rdo rje/ dmar chas gsung rdo rje gyis rigs gnyis kyi char rtsa stong phrag nyi shu rtsa bzhi gnyis las/ sku'i rtsa rnams la zla ba'i khams kyis bskyed pa'i rlung dang*/ gsung gi rtsa rnams la nyi ma'i khams kyis bskyed pa'i rlung rnams rgyu ste/ so sor phye ba de dang grangs stong phrag nyer bzhir mnyam ste/ de ltar rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su// nyi khri chig stong drug brgya'i rlung rnams rgyu zhing*/ tshul de ltar rnams kyi nang na rlung rnams ba spu'i mthar thug pa'i rtsa rnams su rgyu bar 'gyur ro// lnga pa zhar la 'gag pa'i nges pa ni/ gang tshe lug sogs rtsa gcig tu// rlung rgyu ba 'gags pa de tshe lus kyi phyogs kun gyi rtsa rnams kyang cha shas de tsam re 'gag par 'gyur bas phyogs kun 'dra/ gnyis pa rtsis kun bsdus par kha 'phangs pas mjug bsdu ba ni/ nang du rlung rgyu ba'i tshul 'di la brten pa'i rten 'brel sna tshogs 'char ba'i dbye ba dpag tu med pa de rnams kyang*/ phyi rol rtsis dang mtshungs pa yin no// gnyis pa phyir rgyu ba'i tshul la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ dus sbyor rgyas bshad/ dbu ma'i cha bshad pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ 'jug sgo bstan pa/ nyi zla'i rlung rgyu tshul/ sgra gcan gyi rlung rgyu tshul/ dus sbyor gyi rlung rgyu tshul thog ma ngos bzung ba'o// dang po ni/ nang du rgyu tshul bshad zin pa de nas phyi rol rgyu ba'i tshul bshad na/ rlung rnams spyir ba spu dbang po'i sgo kun nas/ rgyu yang khyad par 'jug pa'i sgo/ ro rkyang gi rtsa chen gnyis brgyud sna bug tu rgyu ste/

gnyis pa ni/ de yang g.yas pa nyi ma dug gi rlung ste/ rlung gi nus pa zad par 'gyur/ g.yon pa zla ba'i rlung de ni 'byung ba 'phel rim gyis rgyu bas bdud rtsi ste/ de gnyis g.yas pa de bsam pa'i sgo nas thabs kyi rang bzhin yin kyang*/ lus kyi sgo nas shes rab yin pa dang*/ g.yon pa'i rlung ni bsam pa'i sgo nas shes rab yin kyang*/ lus kyi sgo nas thabs kyi rang bzhin no// zhag re bzhin tu g.yas g.yon de gnyis su rgyu ba yi rlung gi grangs ni/ khri dang bzhi brgya drug cu gnyis/ phyed bcas de g.yas g.yon gnyis bsdoms pas/ nyi khri dgu brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yod pas// de rnams la nyi zla'i rlung du brjod/ gsum pa ni/ de gnyis dbus nas mnyam du rgyu ba'i rlung grangs ni/ drug brgya bdun cu rtsa lnga yod pa ni/ sgra gcan dang*/ mkha' dang ye shes kyi/ rlung zhes bya ste gnyis su med pa thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin no// ye shes rlung de la yang ngo bo'i sgo nas dbye ba yis/ sa sogs lnga yi bdag nyid do// bzhi pa dus sbyor gyi rlung rgyu ba'i thog ma ngos bzung ba ni/ dus sbyor gyi rlung de rnams thog mar gang du rgyu na/ skye dus ma dang 'brel ba'i rtsal ma'i rlung gi rgyu ba/ chad cing de nas snar rgyu bas/ dang po de ni karka ṭa yi khyim du bshad de/ de yang phyi rol gyi nyi ma nub so'i bzhi gsum karka ṭa'i khyim du thog mar bshad pa dang chos mtshungs pa yin// gnyis pa dus sbyor rgyas bshad la gnyis/ thun mong du bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de ltar dus sbyor gyi thog ma ngos bzung nas da ni dus sbyor gyi rlung rgyu tshul bshad par bya ste/ rtsa ba yan lag gi rlung bcu dang*/ gzhan yang rtsa rnams la gnas pa'i rlung rnams dang*/ bcas pa'i rlung nas 'dus te/ tshigs chen tshigs phran dang*/ lus kun rtsa yi 'khor lo drug rnams rim par brgyud de// lte ba'i 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi brgyud nas dbu mar srog gi nus pa bskyed cing*/

de yang rlung rnams lte ba'i khyim bcu gnyis brgyud/ dbu mar srog rlung gi nus pa bskyed la/ ro rkyang gnyis brgyud sna bug gnyis nas/ mnyam dang mi mnyam khyim bcu gnyis las rgyu ba'i rlung ni/ g.yas g.yon re mos kyis g.yas dang g.yon 'byung bas na/ nang gi 'pho chen bcu gnyis dang*/ phyi'i dus sbyor bcu gnyis mtshungs so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'pho ba so so'i grangs dang*/ 'pho ba kun bsdoms pa'i grangs so// dang po la gnyis/ g.yas pa'i 'pho ba dang*/ g.yon pa'i 'pho ba'o// dang po ni/ de'i tshul rgyas bar bshad na/ nyi ma lhor bgrod pa dang mtshungs pa sna g.yas nas 'byung ba sdud pa'i rim pa dang mtshungs pa/ 'byung lnga'i rlung rim pa bzhin rgyu ba'i dang po la/ sna bug g.yas nas 'byung ba'i rlung*// sa chu me rlung mkha' rim bzhin// re rer grangs sum brgya drug cu re la 'pho chung re ste drug cu ste/ de ltar 'pho chung lnga yi rlung kun bsdoms pa la stong dang brgyad brgya ste/ de rnams kyi nus pa ni snod bcud bsdu ba'i rim pa dang mthun par rgyu'o// de rnams la 'pho chen gcig go /gnyis pa ni/ 'pho chen gcig g.yas nas rgyus ba de'i 'og g.yon nas zla ba'i rlung rgyu ba'i tshul ni/ dang por nam mkha' dang*/ rlung dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ sa yis/ rim par grangs ni so sor sum brgya drug cu re la 'pho chung re brtsis pa'i 'pho chung lnga gong ltar rdzogs pa'i grangs stong dang brgyad brgya la 'pho chen gcig tu brtsi ba sogs gong dang mtshungs/ gnyis pa 'pho ba kun bsdoms pa'i grangs ni/ de ltar 'pho ba bcu gnyis la/ 'pho chen rer rlung stong dang brgyad brgya re rgyu bas/ 'pho chen bcu gnyis bsdoms pa la ni/ nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yi rlung rgyu ste// gsum pa dbu ma'i cha bshad pa la bzhi/ spyir bstan pa/ dus sbyor la rgyu ba'i cha shas ngos bzung ba/ de'i byed las/ lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi nges pa bshad pa'o// dang po ni/

de'i nang de la ye shes kyi rlung ji tsam rgyu ba bshad pa ni/ ye shes kyi rlung drug brgya dang bdun cu rtsa lnga yin no// gnyis pa ni/ 'pho chen gcig la rlung stong dang brgyad brgya rgyu ba las ye shes kyi rlung ni lnga bcu nga drug dang bzhi cha gcig rgyu'o// de bzhin dbyu gur ram/ 'pho chung gcig rlung sum brgya dang drug cu rgyu ba las ye shes kyi rlung ni bcu gcig dang*/ bzhi cha rgyu ste/ mdor na dbugs gcig la cha shas so gnyis phye na/ de'i cha gcig ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba'i de'i cha shas rnams/ bsags pas 'pho ba che chung las ye shes kyi rlung gi grangs ni gong du bshad pa de ltar gyur pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ ye shes kyi rlung de yang phyed ni phyir rgyu bas srog zad par byed la/ phyed ni nang du rtsa dbu mar rgyu bas srog dang ye shes 'phel/ ye shes kyi rlung 'di yi byed las kyi rtsa ba ni nang gi gza' kun gyi rkang pa byed pa ste/ rlung 'di phyi 'gro ba 'phel bas 'chi ltas yin la/ rnal 'byor pas nang du ye rlung 'pho med du zin na 'chi med 'grub pa yin no// bzhi pa ni/ lo brgya'i bar du ye shes kyi rlung gi rgyu ba bsdoms pas na// lo gsum zla ba phyed dang gnyis 'byung zhing*/ zhib par brtsi na zhag sogs shol dang 'phel 'grib rnams las/ rlung gcig ni cha sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi cha gcig ye shes kyi rlung du dag pa'i cha de las rlung chad pa'i cha bsags pa las/ zhag gi chad dang*/ ye shes kyi rlung gi 'pho ba che chung bsdoms pas/ zhag dang zla ba 'phel ba sogs rlung rgyu tshul 'di don rtogs pas ma nor 'char ste shes so// gsum pa ji ltar rgyu ba'i rim pa kha dog dang stobs dang yon tan bshad pa la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ rtsis kun bsdus pa'i lung dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ rlung sna phyogs nas rgyu ba'i rim pa dang*/ kha dog dang*/

stobs dang*/ yon tan ni/ gnyis pa la lnga/ sna'i phyogs gang du 'byung ba/ kha dog gang yin pa/ phyi rol gza' skar rnams dang sbyar ba/ las gang 'grub pa/ phyir 'gro ba'i ring thung ngo*// dang po ni/ dang po sna yi ka pa ni/ phyogs gnyis ka'i byang ste gnyis ka'i chu yi rlung yin la/ de bzhin tu/ phyi rol gnyis ni me ru 'dod/ steng gnyis rlung ste 'og gnyis sa/ dbus ni nam mkha'i ye shes kyi rlung rgyu ba yin no// gnyis pa ni/ de rnams kyi kha dog sa chu me rlung mkha' rnams/ rim pa bzhin ser dkar dmar nag sngo bar 'dod gsum pa ni/ 'di dag gza' yi stobs dang sbyar na ni g.yas pa rnams// spen phur bkra shis te mig dmar/ nyi ma dang dus me rnams/ sa sogs khams rnams rim pas sbyar zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams/ sgra gcan zla ba gza' lhag dang*// pa sangs mjug ring mkha' gong ltar rlung gza' khams rnams rim bzhin sbyor ro// bzhi pa ni/ phung po khams sogs phyi nang gi chos rnams bya byed de mthun pa'i phyir na/ nam mkha' yi rlung gis bsad gso'i las kun 'grub// rlung gi rlung gis bskrad dang bsad pa ste// dbang dang dgug pa me yi rlung gis byed/ de bzhin chus ni zhi dang rgyas pa'o// rengs dang rmongs pa sa yi las// ye shes las ni thams cad pa 'grub cing*/ rgyu dus 'pho chen gnyis kyi thun mtshams su sna gnyis nas mnyam du rgyu ba'i dus so// lnga pa ni/ rlung de rnams phyi rol du 'gro ba na sa yi rlung ni sor bcu gnyis/ chu me rlung mkha' rnams rim bzhin bcu drug bar/ yon tan rim par chung ba'i dbang gis rim bzhin sor mo res ring ngo*// gsum pa rtsis kun bsdus pa'i lung dang sbyar ba ni/ rgyas pa rten 'brel rtsis dang dbyangs sbyar ba yi tshul sogs ni/ kho bos rtsis kun bsdus par bshad/ bzhi brgyud phan tshun dgongs pa mi 'gal bar bstan pa la gsum/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rgyud bkod pa/

de'i don bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rlung lnga steng du rgyu ba'i tshul 'di ni rdo rje phreng ba las/ gnyis pa la gsum/ bsgrub bya rdo rje'i bzlas pa bshad pa/ dgag bya mun pa chen po'i rlung bshad pa/ bzlas pa bya ba'i tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ sna yi bu ga las byung zhing*/ sa chu me rlung nam mkha' lnga yi rlung gi dkyil 'khor lnga steng du yang dag rgyu bar gsungs shing*/ de yang sna bug g.yon pa nas rgyu ba dang*/ de bzhin g.yas dang*/ gnyis ka cha snyoms pa nas rtag tu rgyu ba dang*/ gnyis ka nas dal bar rgyu ba rnam pa bzhi yin no// gnyis pa ni// g.yas pa na sa ni rgyu ba'i rlung 'byung chung gi dkyil 'khor lnga ldan 'di ni/ gtso bor nyi ma'i rlung ste/ 'byung ba'i khams/ me yi dkyil 'khor nyid yin te/ de'i kha dog dmar po bzang po 'di/ pad+ma'i mgon po la sogs pa gsung rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha yi ngo bor gyur pa'i rlung rgyu ba'o// g.yon pa nas ni rgyu ba'i rlung 'byung chung gi dkyil 'khor lnga ldan ni/ gtso bor zla ba'i rlung ste/ 'byung ba'i khams/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang 'dres pa/ ljang ser dag tu snang ba ste/ zhi sogs sgrub par byed pas sku rdo rje dang*/ las kyi mgon po la sogs pa 'dres pa'i tshul gyi lha yi ngo bo'i rlung rgyu ba'o/ gnyis ka nas ni drag tu rgyu ba'i rlung 'byung chung gi dkyil 'khor lnga ldan ni/ gtso bor 'byung ba'i khams/ gser mdog dbang chen dkyil 'khor nyid/ rin chen mgon po la sogs pa'i lha'i ngo bo'i rlung rgyu ba'o/ dal zhing phyogs gcig tu yon bor rgyu ba med pa'i khams/ dag pa'i shel ltar dri ltar dri med 'od gsal du snang ba ni/ yid rlung 'byung chung gi dkyil 'khor lnga ldan 'di ni/ gtso bor chu yi khams kyi dkyil 'khor yin te/ rdo rje'i mgon po la sogs thugs rdo rje'i rigs kyi lha'i ngo bo'i rlung rgyu ba'o// gnyis pa dgag bya mun pa chen pa'i rlung bshad pa ni/

sa sogs khams kun las ni yang dag 'byung*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes dang*/ rten dang brten pas gzung ba nyon mongs can yid ni mun pa'i rlung ngam/ srog rlung ni/ rnam par snang mdzad rang bzhin te/ 'chi ba'i mthar ni sna sgo las 'byung bar 'gyur ro// gsum pa bzlas pa bya ba'i tshul ni/ dkyil 'khor so sor 'byung rgyud lnga dang ldan pa'i sa la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor rlung rin chen mgon po nas/ rdo rje mgon po'i bar gyi lha yi ngo bor dag pa'am gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi po de dag gi rlung ni/ rnal 'byor pas lha de'i ngo bor mnyam par bzhag pas/ 'byung 'jug gnas gsum rdo rje'i sngags kyi bzlas par sbyar nas rtag tu zlos shig /gsum pa de'i don bshad pa ni/ zhes gsungs pa'i don ni rdo rje'i bzlas pa yi/ dag pa bstan pas yin te/ gong ma 'pho chen rer nam mkha'i rlung 'pho chung re rgyu ba dang*/ 'dir nam mkha'i rlung la nam mkha'i mgon po grags pa 'chi tshe kho na las mi rgyu bar bshad pa ni/ 'gal ba'i the tshom bskyed mi bya/ de dag gi rlung so sor rgyu ba'i skabs so rdo rje'i bzlas ba ji ltar bya zhe na/ spyi mgrin snying lter rtsa 'dab gyi lte bar/ khams so sor dkyil 'khor kha dog lnga par bsgoms shing*/ lha de dang de yi ngo bor dmigs pa dang*/ rlung ni sna rtser 'phro ba rnams kyang ni/ lha de dag gi ngo bo kha dog lnga pa rnam par bsgoms nas/ lha de rnams kyi sngags rnams dang sbyar ba'i rdo rje'i bzlas pa yi grangs kyis ni/ nyin mtshan rtag tu zlos shig shes bshad do/ bzhi pa 'jug sgo phan yon dang bcas pa bshad pa la gsum/ 'jug sgo/ bzung thabs/ phan yon no// dang po ni/ rlung 'jug sgo ni me dang*/ rlung gi rlung ni steng nas sna yi bu ga gnyis/ chu rlung kha dang*/ sa rlung 'og tu thur sel gyi lam gnyis te/ steng 'og gi sgo gsum dang*/ ma ning rlung ni lus kyi ba spu'i sgo kun nas 'jug pa yin te sgo rnam pa bzhi/

gnyis pa ni/ gzung thabs dbyung rngub gnas gsum dang*/ de dag gi tshul sems kyi ngo bo lta ba'i sgo nas sems kyi 'gro ldog dang*/ bsgyur ba dang*/ yongs su dag pa yi tshul de dag rim par bgrang zhing brtsi ba ste/ mi rtog pa'i man ngag gis rlung rgya yan tu bcing ba de ni/ zhi gnas bskyed par gsungs pa yin/ rlung lnga'i kha dog dbyibs 'byung ldog gnas pa la sogs par rnam par sbyangs bas/ mngon shes lnga dang*/ zad par gyi ting 'dzin gyi cho 'phrul lnga la sogs pa 'byung ba'i rgyu byed do// bum can ni steng 'og bar gsum gyi rlung 'chings ba'i gnas lte 'og tu 'ching ba dang*/ seng ge rnam grol bcas pa rnams la gom pa mthar phyin pa na rlung gi las kun rung par byed do// gsum pa phan yon la gnyis/ gzung 'dzin brgyad dag pa dang*/ 'byung ba lnga 'phel ba'i phan yon no// dang po ni/ rlung zin pa'i phan yon rnam pa brgyad yin te// nyi zla sgra gcan gyi rlung ste/ rlung gi gtso bo gsum bzung ba'i phan yon ni/ nyi zla'i rlung gi yon tan brgyad yod de/ nyi zla sgra gcan rlung gsum steng du rgyu ba bzung ba'i yon tan ni/ dug gsum rnam rtog 'joms pa dang*/ sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje rnam gsum thob byed yin// de ni nyi ma'i yon tan gsum du gsungs shing*/ zla ba'i rlung thur sel bzung ba'i yon tan gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya yi/ yul lnga po de la dbang byed cing*/ ye shes lnga thob pa de ni zla ba'i rlung ste/ de ltar steng rlung nyi ma me yi rang bzhin can/ 'og tu gnas kyang gyen du rgyu ba'i steng rlung dang*/ zla ba chu yi rang bzhin can/ steng du gnas kyang mthur du 'bab pa'i 'og rlung*/ de gnyis kha sbyor du bzung bas/ steng rlung gis gzung ba'i rnam rtog gsum dang*/ 'og rlung gis 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog lnga rnams/ de yis ni mthar thug gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog brgyad dag par byed la/

gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gnas skabs kyang sa rlung zin pas lus brtan dang*/ de bzhin chu rlung gis lus snum dang*/ me rlung gis mdangs gsal ba dang*/ rlung gi rlung gis mgyogs pa dang*/ nam mkha'i rlung zin pa sa lus dag cing shes rab che ldan pa ste/ sa sogs kyi rlung zin pas de rnams kyis lus la yon tan 'byung bar bshad/ lnga pa 'khor 'das thams cad rlung gi rang bzhin tu bstan pa la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ mdor na rnam shes kyi rlung ni rnam par rtog pa dang gcig ste/ g.yo dang phra dang gzhan bskyod par byed pa'i mtshan nyid can no// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor 'das kun gyi gzhi sems nyid gsal la mi rtog pa/ de'i ngo bo ni ye shes kyi rlung chen po yin ste/ de nyid sbyang gzhi ye shes kyi rlung dang*/ de'i lam gyi gnyen po yang dag pa'i kun rtog dang ldan pa ni sbyor byed ye shes kyi rlung chen po de ni/ byang chub kyi sems dang rjes su mthun pa yang dag rtog pa'i 'du byed kyi rlung ni sbyong byed du bshad/ kun gzhi la gnas pa'i bdun pa nyon yid kyi rlung ni/ yang dag min rtog gis kun 'khrul byed pas gti mug bskyed pa'i rlung du bshad/ tshogs drug dang 'brel ba'i 'du byed rnams ni ye shes kyi snang cha las gzhan du med kyang*/ de la gzhan du bzung ste/ chags sdang gi gzhan rtog chags pa'i rlung ste/ 'dod chags kyi rlung zhes bya/ rnam shes tshogs drug gi yul la blang dor dpyod pa'i rlung ni/ yul yid du mi 'ong bar khong khro bar byed pas na zhe sdang rlung ste/ rlung de gsum gyis bskyed nas khams gsum du 'khrul zhing 'khor ba yin no// gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de ltar na khams gsum po rnams kyang rlung gis 'du byed pa yin no ces/ gsungs pas skyon dang yon tan kun gyi rgyu ni/ rlung la brten pas de ltar na skyon yon rtogs byas nas/

rlung gi sbyor ba shes na pha rol ste/ sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro zhing*/ rlung de la gnad du ma bsnun na/ tha mal gyi rlung gis 'khor bar yang yang 'khor ba'i rgyu rlung 'dis byed la/ las rlung ye shes su bcing na 'khor ba'i rgyun de gcod par byed pa yi gnyen po'ang rlung 'dis 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsum pa spyi'i mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar phyi nang du rgyu ba'i rlung ming dang*/ byed las kun ni/ rgyal bas mdo rgyud du ma las gsungs pa'i don rnams/ 'dir ni bsdus te bstan pa yin// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las/ rlung gi rgyu tshul bstan pa ste bzhi pa'o/// /de ltar rlung bshad zin nas/ rtsa rnams kyi gnas su dwangs snyigs kyi thig le'i rnam bzhag 'chad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas lus la brten pa'i rtsa dang*/ rtsa la rlung brten pa'i tshul bshad zin nas/ rlung der rgyu ba'i thig le ji ltar gnas dang rgyu tshul bshad pa ni/ rtsa ba spros bral thig le sems nyid dang*/ de ma rtog pa'i 'khrul pa ma rig thig le dang*/ ma rig pa'i thig le de 'ching byed de yi gnyan po rdzas sngags rlung gi thig le gsum mo// gnyis pa la lnga/ rtsa ba spros bral gyi thig le/ 'khrul pa ma rig pa'i thig le mdor bstan pa rdzas kyi thig le rgyas par bshad pa/ gnyen po'i thig le 'ching ba'i rim pa/ zhar la skyon bsal ba bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ dang por rtsa ba spros bral gyi thig le ni rang sems lhan cig skyes/ ngo bo stong pa spros bral te// rang bzhin gsal ba longs spyod rdzogs// 'gag med thugs rje cir yang grub pa/ sku gsum gyi rang bzhin can yin la/ de gsum sems can gyi rgyud la bzhugs pa'i rtags ni da lta 'khrul pa'i dus su yang*/ bsgoms stobs kyis shes pa 'gyur te/

chos sku'i rtags chos thams cad kyi ngo bo stong par snang ba dang*/ longs sku'i rtags dbyings rig gi rtags bcu 'char ba dang*/ sprul sku'i rtags tshogs drug gi yul snang la bya byed kyi nus pa 'byin pa ste/ rtags gsum po 'di bsgom pa'i dus na bslu med mngon sum gyi yul du snang ba'i rtags yin te/ yul can gyi ye shes ni yul der 'brel ba'i rnam par shes pa'o// zhes yul yul can dbyer med pa de ni rnam rtog bral zhing ma 'khrul ba de ni/ rtsa ba spros bral thig le yin/ de'i tshul rgyas par mdo rgyud kun las gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ 'khrul ba ma rig thig le de la ni/ sbyong gzhi sngags rlung rdzas kyi thig le gsum la/ sbyong byed sngags rlung rdzas kyi thig le bcas drug tu yod pa las/ gnyis med kyi don la/ gzung 'dzin gnyis su 'dzin pas don gyi gnas lugs ma rig pa dang*/ des bskyed pa'i 'du byed pa dang*/ rnam shes las/ kun tu brtags pa tshor 'du 'du byed rnam shes te/ ming bzhi las bsgyur ba/ ming don gnyis su 'dzin pa ni sbyang gzhi sngags kyi thig le/ de'i gnyen po lha sngags kyi ting nge 'dzin ni rnam rtog de sbyong ba'i tshul rnams ni kun btags pa yi sngags kyi thig le dang*/ rkyen gsum gyi gzhan dbang gis bskyod pa yid kyi nus pa ni rlung gis bskyed pa de la ni/ sbyang gzhi rlung gi thig le/ de 'ching ba'i thabs la sbyong byed rlung gi thig le zhes su bshad/ dbang zhes kyi yul du snang ba'i don lnga gzugs kyi phung po la/ khams lnga rdzas kyi thig le zhes sbyang gzhir bshad cing*/ de sbyong byed dwangs snyigs kyi thig le 'chings pa'i rim par zhi sbyong byed rdzas kyi thig le zhes/ de rnams kyi tshul rgyas par ni/ rgyal bas rnal 'byor bla med kyi rdo rje phreng ba'i rgyud du gsungs so// gsum pa rdzas kyi thig le rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/

bar do'i rkyen nye bar sbyor ba dang*/ dwangs ma gnyis ldan bstan pa/ snyigs ma ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul/ khams sum cu so drug gi rgyas bshad/ dkar cha'i 'pho ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ da lam rdzas kyi thig le bshad pa ste/ de la rdzas kyi thig le la yang*/ phyi nang gnyis yod de/ nang gi don tu gyur pa'i thig le ni/ dang po mngal du skye ba sbyor ba'i tshe// bar do'i shes pa'i ngo bo de// pha ma'i 'du 'phrod dkar dmar la bdag tu bzung pa'i rkyen las chags sdang gi zhen pa yis mngal bzung nas/ mer mer nur nur sogs khams rim par 'gyur nas bskyed tshul gong du bstan pa bzhin no// gnyis pa la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ dkar dmar gyi dwangs ma so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ da lta rdo rje'i lus la gnas tshe dwangs snyigs gnyis/ rlung sems dwangs ma sngar ltar la/ thig le'i dwangs ma ni dkar dmar gnyis so// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dkar cha'i dwangs ma dang*/ dmar cha'i dwangs ma bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dkar cha dbu ma'i yar sna na// ham̐ mgo mthur du lta ba'i rang bzhin can// yab he ru ka'i ngo bo/ thabs bde ba chen po mchog gi rang bzhin yungs dkar tsam// dkar la snum pa shel dang mtshungs/ pha las thob pa thig le dkar cha kun gyi mchog gnyis pa ni/ dmar cha rtsa gsum 'dus sa na// dmar gsal shin tu dmar zhing tsha ba/ rgod ma'i me 'dra ba/ a thung ste a shad kyi dbyibs/ shes rab yum phag mo'i rang bzhin te/ gsum pa ni/ dwangs ma de gnyis las bde ba 'jo bas dpyid dang*/ bde ba brtan pas thig le zhes kyang bshad/ de gnyis kyi bar du kun gzhi srog gi rlung brten cing*/ dkar dmar 'di gnyis nang gi byang chub snying po mngon tu byed pa'i rgyu yi ngo bo yin zhes/ sdom 'byung rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsungs/ gsum pa snyigs ma ji ltar 'byung ba'i tshul la bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ dwangs ma de la brten pa'i snyigs ma'i khams kyang dwangs snyigs gnyis te/

thig le dmar cha mes bskyed ro ma la brgyud gyen 'gro la/ dkar cha spyi bo nas rkyang ma brgyud 'og 'gro ste/ gnyis pa rgyas bshad la bzhi/ zas skom las dwangs ma ji ltar 'gyur ba'i tshul/ dwangs ma sogs nang gi skye ba bdun pa'i 'gyur tshul/ snyigs ma'i snyigs ma ji ltar 'dor tshul/ khu ba'i dwangs snyigs kyi 'gyur tshul lo// dang po ni/ de la skye ba bdun pa'i dwangs ma zhes brjod pa'i tshul ni/ dang po sbyin sreg rgyus bskyed pa ste// phyi rol zas kyi dngos po rnams sreg rdzas lag pa dgang blugs te// khar ni phung po'i lha la mchod// pho bar las byed lha gsum ste/ me mnyam rlung dang bad kan ni// myags byed mkhris pa 'gyur byed gsum gyis// bsregs bzhus sbyangs nas/ gnyis pa ni/ pho bar dwangs snyigs phye nas zas skom de yi dwangs ma rnams// mchin par rtsa chen bzhi dag la brgyud de/ khrag chen gyur nas rtsa kun 'gro/ khrag gis khrag de zhag gcig la dwangs snyigs bye ba'i dwangs ma des sha bskyed/ de zhag gcig la dwangs snyigs phye ba'i dwangs ma de las tshil/ de gong bzhin phye ba'i dwangs kyis rus pa dang*/ de'i dwangs kyis rkang dang*/ rkang de zhag gcig tu dwangs snyigs bye ba'i dwangs kyis khu ba ste/ 'di la lus zung dwangs ma skye ba bdun pa zhes bya'o// gsum pa ni/ zas skam zhag gcig tu sbyangs pa'i pho bar yod pa'i snyigs ma las ska sla gnyis/ ska ba rgyu mar brgyud nas 'gro/ sla ba rgyu grogs nas song nas/ lgang pa nas ni 'bab par byed/ de bzhin zhag re rer dwangs ma re re 'phel ba'i snyigs ma rnams kyang rim bzhin/ khrag snyigs kyis mchin pa'i gnas las mkhris pa ni/ bskyed nas de mkhris pa'i dwangs mas lus kyi chu ser dang*/ snyigs ma 'og tu 'gro ste// mkhris pa'i snyigs dri chu'i ku ya dang*// dri chen dri dang ser por byed// sha yi snyigs ma pags dri ma// tshil snyigs rmen bur 'gyur ba ste/

rus snyigs so dang sen mo yin/ rkang snyigs sbubs kyi mchil snabs bshad// bzhi pa ni/ khu ba de'ang zhag gcig dwangs snyigs phye ba'i khu ba'i snyigs ma 'og tu dung can ma nas 'bab cing*/ ba spu dang*/ dbang po'i sgo nas phyer 'dor zhing*/ de'i dwangs ma yis lus kyi stobs dang kha dog byed/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni// de ni spyi tsam bshad pa yin gyis/ bzhi pa khams sum cu so drug gi rgyas bshad la gnyis/ dwangs ma bcu gnyis ji ltar rgyu ba dang*/ snyigs ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgyas bshad do// dang po la gnyis/ bshad pa dngos dang*/ shes byed kyi lung smos pa'o// dang po ni/ rdzas kyi thig le rgyas par bshad na dwangs snyigs kyi khams ni sum cu rtsa drug yan lag gi rtsa bzhi po ni mig sogs lus ma gtogs pa'i dbang po bzhi yi rnam par shes pa dang*/ 'brel nas yul gzugs sogs 'dzin pa'i bdag rkyen byed pas/ yul bzhi po des yul can rnams la mchod pa bzhi zhes bya'o// yan lag gi rtsa bdud bral nas byung khams dkar cha de ni/ steng 'gro lce chung dbus su zug pas/ khams lugs ldog gis dkar cha 'grib par byed pa'i rgyu des nag phyogs dang mthun par bshad cing*/ rtsa 'di yang lus kyi reg bya'i khams kyi phyogs gcig 'byung gyur gyi cha 'dzin par byed pas/ lus la reg bya'i mchod par bshad kyang rung*/ zhes 'byung ngo*// rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang 'brel ba yi/ dwangs ma lnga yi byed las ni/ sngar lus dang*/ rtsa rlung gi dus su bshad zin pa sa rtogs par 'gyur zhing*/ dwangs ma bcu gnyis bshad ba'i skabs 'dir yang dbu ma'i cha gnyis su phye ste/ steng du nyi zla sgra gcan gyi rlung gsum 'og phyogs su/ dri chen dang dri chu khu ba rnam gsum brten/ khyad par dbu ma'i mar sna dung can ma la ni/ zla ba bzhin bco lnga cha yi thig le dkar cha ni/ yongs su gang ba de ni lhan skyes kyi bde ba skye ba'i rtsa de nyid ni/

skyes par rdo rje'i rtsa dang 'brel zhing*/ bud med la ro ma dang 'brel ste/ ro mas mar snas khrag gi khams 'dzin par byed/ des skyes pa bud med khyad par byed cing*/lus kyi dbang po'i mchog skyed par byed pa'o// gnyis pa ni/ dwangs ma bcu gnyis kyi rgyu tshul 'di ni kha sbyor thig le las/ snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad las phyogs bzhi ru 'dab ma'i rtsa bzhi gnas pa ni/ 'byung ba che rnams mar me'i dngos po ni/ yan lag gi rtsa bzhi mkha' 'gro ma bzhi yi ngo bo yin la/ zhes yan lag gi rtsa bzhis gzugs sgra dri ro bzhi yi mchod par 'bul ba zhes dngos bstan dang*/ shugs kyis bdud bral mas lce chung rgyud dkar chas phyes la 'dren pa dang*/ lus kyi reg bya'i phyogs gcig 'dzin pas/ reg bya'i mchod pa 'bul bar bshad pa yin/ zhes rang 'grel tu gsal/ mtshams gyi rtsa bzhir bdud rtsi lnga 'bab gnas zhes pa ni/ rtsa ba'i rlung dang*/ byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa rnams yin la/ de rnams ni der dkyil 'khor gyi mtshams bzhir bum par brten pa'i thod pa bzhi ste/ mchod pa bzhi zhes bshad/ dwangs ma bcu gnyis rgyu tshul bshad pa'i skabs 'dir ni/ bye brag tu lus kyi snying dbus su/ rtsa lnga po ni yang dag gnas/ zhes bshad pa ni sum skor ma sogs yin no// gnyis pa snyigs ma nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rgyas bshad la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rten rtsa chen nyer bzhir snyigs ma'i khams rnams brten pas/ de rnams kyi rten dang*/ brten pa rnams bshad na/ mkha' spyod/ sa spyod/ sa 'og spyod de/ sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i bye brag gis phye ba'i yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi nang lus kyi dag par sbyang ba'i dbang gis nye bar brjod na/ nang du thig le dang*/ phyir mkha' 'gro ma rnams rtag tu rgyu zhing gnas pa dang*/ res 'ga' rgyu zhing gnas pa'i dbang gis gnas sogs bye brag la brten nas/

gnas dang*/ nye ba'i gnas sogs su ni nye bar brjod pa yin no// de nas phyi'i gnas su yul nyer bzhi dang*/ nang gi gnas su rtsa nyer bzhi po de rnams las byung ba ste/ der gnas pa'i snyigs ma'i khams ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi po rnams dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nyer bzhi po dang sbyar nas bshad par bya ste/ sngar bshad rtsa nyer bzhi po dang sbyar nas/ phyi nang gi rten brten pa'i tshul dang bcas pa bshad pa ni/ gnyis pa la lnga/ gnas dang nye gnas/ zhing dang nye zhing*/ tshan+dho nye tshan/ 'du ba nye 'du/ dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod do// dang po la gnyis/ gnas bshad pa dang*/ nye ba'i gnas bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ rtsa mi phyed ma nang gi gnas mgo bo dang*/ phyi'i yul pul+li ra yin te/ dpa' bo thod pa'i dum bu dang*/ rab gtum ma yab yum bzhugs pa bzhin rlung sems thig le mkha' 'gro yab yum du bzhugs shing*/ snyigs ma'i khams kyis so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ de bzhin phra mo/ gnas spyi bo dang*/ yul dzā lan+dha ra ste/ der rlung sems dang*/ thig le rnams kyi dwangs ma mkha' 'gro/ snyigs mas ni de bzhin skra dang kha spu 'bab/ rtsa rtse ba ma ni nang gnas rna ba g.yas dang*/ phyi'i yul auḍ+yan te// rna g.yas brten te/ dwangs ma'i thig rlung dpa' bo yab yum bzhugs shing*/ snyigs mas ni pags pa 'bab/ rtsa g.yon pa ma ni/ nang gnas ltag pa dang*/ phyi'i yul arbu ta/ dwangs ma dpa' bo yab yum dang*/ snyigs mas rgyab sogs sha rnams 'bab pa'o// rtsa de rnams la dkar cha rtag tu gnas shing*/ yul de rnams su mkha' 'gro rtag tu gnas pas gnas zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ni/ phyi'i yul gau da wa rī'am/ ba lang gi mchog can/ nang gi gnas rtsa thung ngu ma ste/ rna ba g.yon phyogs/ dwangs ma mkha' 'gro/ snyigs ma ni rus pa bskyed pa'i khams rnams 'bab/ phyi'i yul rā me shwa ra'am/ dga' ba'i dbang phyug /nang gi rtsa rus sbal skyes ste/ smin phrag tu dwangs ma mkha' 'gro/

snyigs ma ni rus pa'i phreng ba 'bab ba yin/ phyi'i yul de wī ko ṭi'am lha mo'i rdzong*/ nang gnas rtsa sgom pa mo/ gnas mig gi phyi rol/ dwangs ma mkha' 'gro dang*/ snyigs ma ni mchin pa'i sha kun bskyed pa yin/ nang rtsa dbang bskur ma dpung pa nas phrag par 'brel ba/ phyi'i yul mā la wa'am/ phreng can ma zhes bya/ dwangs ma mkha' 'gro/ snyigs mas snying gi sha bskyed par byed pa ste/ de rnams su nang du thig le res rgyu/ phyir mkha' 'gro res tshogs pas rtag tu nye ba'i gnas zhes brjod/ de bzhin tu phyi'i yul so so dang*/ nang gi gnas so sor sbyar/ phyi'i yul gyi dpa' bo yab yum dang*/ nang gi thig rlung gi dwangs ma dpa' mo yab yum tu bzhugs shing*/ snyigs mas khams so sor bskyed pa rnams sbyor ro// gnyis pa zhing dang nye zhing bshad pa ni/ rtsa skyon ma zhes bya mchan 'og gnyis su yod pa nas mig 'bras dang 'brel/ kaṃ ru ste/ 'dod pa'i gzugs/ mig 'bras sha rnams 'bab pa yin/ rtsa mjug ma ni nu bar na yod/ o ṭi ya yin te/ nu mtshams nas brgyud mkhris pa bskyed/ rtsa ma mo ni lte ba na'o/ tri sha ku na ste/ dge mtshan gsum/ glo ba bskyed par byed pa'o// rtsa mtshan mo zhes bya rgyu ma nas sna rtser 'brel ba yod/ ko sha la'am dge ba can/ rgyu ma'i phreng ba 'bab par byed/ rtsa gnas snga ma gnyis nas khams dang*/ tshogs la longs spyod cing*/ phyi ma gnyis res spyod pas longs spyod zhing dang nye zhing brjod/ gsum pa tshan+dho dang nye tshan bshad pa ni/ rtsa bsil sbyin ka liṅka yin te/ kha dang 'gram pa sta zur sogs nas 'brel zhing grod pa bskyed/ rtsa tsha ba ma ni mgrin pa nas lte bar gnas/ lam+bā ka'am 'phyang ba can/ rtsa 'di yan bcu bzhi po ni/ g.yon rkyang ma'i char skyes pa'i shes rab rang bzhin dang*/ 'di man g.yas ro ma las skyes pa'i thabs kyi rang bzhin gyi rtsa bcu po rnams yin/ lto ba gnyer ma bskyed pa yin/

rtsa gzhol ma snying ga nas bshang lam du 'gro ba/ kāñtsir bshad pa ste/ bshang ba 'bab pa'i bdag rkyen byed/ rtsa rangs ma tshogs ma dang lgang par 'brel/ hi mā la ya'am gangs can ste/ mtshams dbus 'gengs pa'i rgyungs pa 'bab/ dwangs snyigs 'dres par gnas pas na/ gnas rtsa snga ma gnyis na lha dang dwangs snyigs kyi rgyun rtag par 'bab pas na ts+tshan+dho dang*/ nye ba'i ts+tshan+dhor bshad/ bzhi pa 'du ba dang nye 'du bshad pa ni/ pre ta pu ra tsa gzugs can ma mtshan mar gnas// rtag tu rnag ni 'bab pa yin// gṛ ha de wa'am khyim gyi lha/ rtsa thun mong ma bshang lam du gnas/ bad kan 'bab par byed pa'o// rtsa rgyu skyin brla zur sau raṣ+ṭa'am/ yul 'khor bzang po ste/ zhag gi nus pa bskyed par byed// swar+kha dwī pa'am gser gling*/ rtsa sbyor bral ma byin pa la gnas// rtag tu rdul ni 'bab bar byed/ gnas dang*/ rtsa snga ma gnyis la tshogs dang*/ dwangs snyigs rtag tu 'du zhing*/ phyi ma gnyis la res 'du bas 'du dang*/ nye 'dur gsungs/ lnga pa dur khrod dang nye khrod bshad pa ni/ rtsa sdu gu zhes bya rkang pa'i sor mor gnas/ nā ga ra/ tshil ni 'bab par byed pa yin// rtsa grub ma zhes bya rkang bol/ sin dhur brjod/ mchi ma skyed par byed pa yin// ma ru'am mya ngam gyi yul gru zhes bya/ rtsa 'tshed ma ste rkang pa'i mthe bong la// lud pa mchil ma bskyed cing 'bab/ ku lu ta'am rigs nyid ni/ rtsa yid bzang ste pus mo'i ga nya 'god na// rtag tu sna chu 'bab pa yin/ gnas dang*/ rtsa snga ma gnyis la mkha' 'gro rtag tu 'du zhing*/ snyigs ma 'i khams rtag tu 'dor zhing rnam rtog gcod pa dang*/ bde ba med cing*/ phyi ma gnyis res 'du zhing gcod pas na// bde med dur khrod de nye ba'o// lnga pa dkar cha'i 'pho ba'i rim pa dang bcas pa bshad pa la gnyis/ khams bdun cu rtsa gnyis pa'i 'byung tshul spyir bstan pa dang*/ thig le dwangs ma'i 'pho ba khyad par du bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/
