khams bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi 'gyur tshul/ khams bdun khri nyis stong da lta gnas pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar rtsa nyer bzhir 'bab ba'i khams ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi po/ re re la yang thim pa ni bya ba rdzogs pa'i snyigs mar gyur pa ste 'das pa dang*/ longs spyod dwangs ma dkar cha las byed bzhin pa yin pas da lta ba dang*/ ma 'ongs pa na de skyed par byed pas bdag po ni/ dwangs snyigs gnyis ka'i rtsa ba rlung khrag 'dres pa'i rang bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ rtsa nyer bzhi po re re'ang stong phrag gsum gsum du phye bas bdun khri nyis stong yod ste/ der yang thim pa rlung dang*/ longs spyod pa dkar cha dang*/ bdag por gyur pa dmar cha dang*/ gsum gsum rer yang rtse stong phrag nyer bzhi re yod pa/ bsdoms pas rtsa bdun khri nyis stong gi bdag nyid can/ de rnams ba spu bye ba phrag brgya'i mthar thug kun tu khyab par bshad do// gnyis pa thig le'i dwangs ma'i 'pho ba khyad par bshad pa la gnyis/ 'pho ba'i rim pa dang*/ 'phos pa'i byed las so// dang po ni/ khams bdun khri nyis stong las khyad par dkar cha'i dwangs ma zla ba lta bu de ni/ spyi bo nas ni bcu drug rtsa/ re rer 'byung chung gis dbye bas sa yi sa/ chu yi chu sogs yon tan gyi khams bzhi dang ldan pa yi rtsa 'dabs thabs shes gcig tu bsdoms par bcu drug yod pa las/ thig le yang cha bcu drug mgrin par 'bab// bcu drug rim par bde ba smin pas/ mgrin par de'i phyed brgyad/ snying gar de'i phyed bzhi/ lte bar gnyis dbang ste/ de na cha gcig la thig le can ste/ cha gcig pu de a shad kyi me la gcig tu 'bab pas na/ dung can mar gnas pa'i bar du bde ba bskyed cing*/ mthar ni phyir 'dzag par byed/ gnyis pa ni/ lus can kun gyi snying dga' bas na ste/ khams 'pho khar lus la 'phel bas/ snying dga' bar byed la/ de'i phyir 'dod chags bskyed cing*/ chags pa'i dbang gis ye shes ngo ma shes te/

shin tu rmongs par byas te gti mug bskyed/ 'dzag nas chags pa dang bral te/ sdang sems skye ste/ dug gsum ni 'khor ba bskyed byed gzhir gyur to// bzhi pa gnyen po'i thig le 'ching ba'i rim pa la gsum/ gang gis 'ching ba/ 'ching ba'i rim pa/ bcings pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po ni/ de lta bas na rgyal bas gsungs bzhin 'pho med bcings pa'i thabs la 'bad pa dang ldan pas/ 'bad na khams 'dzag bral dngul chu lta bur ni 'chings nus pa/ dper na/ dngul chu btso bkru dang ldan pa'i mes bcings na/ legs par 'chings nus pa bzhin/ las chos ye shes kyi phyag rgya gsum gyi mes khams 'pho med du bcings na/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ mthong lam thob byed kyi rim pa dang*/ sgom lam bgrod byed kyi rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyal mtshan ste/ nor bu'i rtsa bzhi 'pho med kyi rten du dag pa ru gyur ste/ khams bcings pas dus sbyor gcig gi rlung 'gags pas bden pa mthong zhing don la mngon du sbyor zhing*/ sa dang po mthong lam thob par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ de'i rjes su rjes dran bcu drug dang ldan pas/ thig le 'pho med du brtan par byas bas rang bzhin gyi khams de gyen la 'gro ba yin ste/ de ltar song bas nor bu nas gtsug tor bar/ las rlung rim par 'gags shing*// sa ni bcu gnyis rim pa ltar/ thob par byed la/ gsum pa 'bras bu la gnyis/ gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu dang*/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu'o// dang po ni// mas brtan gyi dga' ba bcu drug ni/ mthar gtsug tor gyi rtser son nas khams dang lhan cig dug gsum gyi rnam rtog kyang 'ching zhing*/ ye shes su dag nas// rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu 'gags shing dag nas/ gnyis pa ni/ gzhi dus kyi khams dkar dmar dag pas 'bras dus/ lus kun mtshan dpe'i me tog rgyas shing*// skad cig gcig gis mngon par byang chub bo ces// bcom ldan de nyid gzigs pas gsungs// lnga pa zhar la skyon bsal ba bstan pa la gsum/

skyon gyi gzhi ngos bzung ba/ des skyon byed pa'i rgyu mtshan/ skyon de bsal ba'i thabs so// dang po la gsum/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ khams kyi snyigs ma phal cher nad bskyed pa/ gnyis pa ni/ klad pa dkar cha'i snyigs mas bad kan bskyed pa yin te/ de ni steng du gnas kyang sa dang chu yi// rang bzhin thur la 'byung ba smad nad bskyed ste/ sgra gcan gyi snyigs mas bskyed pa'i rlung nad ni lte ba/ gsang ba sogs su gnas kyang rlung rang bzhin/ 'og tu gnas kyang gyen la 'gro zhing stod nad bskyed la/ dmar chas bskyed ba'i snyigs ma'i mkhris khrag mchin pa rten bar gnas kyang*/ grogs rlung dang ldan na me bzhin gyen du 'bar zhing stong nad bskyed la/ grogs bar ldan chu bzhin 'og tu 'gro zhing smad nad bskyed do// nad de dug gsum gyi rtsa ba can yin ste/ bad kan gti mug gi rang bzhin dang ldan pa yi nad ste/ mkhris pa zhe sdang lhan cig pa nyid kyis bskyed/ rlung dang 'dod chags ldan pas rlung nad bskyed de/ des ni kun gyi grogs byed do// gsum pa ni/ chu me rlung gsum gyis nad bskyed par byed cing*/ lus 'jig par byed pa'i rgyu yin te// gnyis pa des skyon byed por rgyu mtshan ni/ lus la nad byed pa tsam du ma zad/ sems la yang dga' ba dang*/ bde dang rtog dpyod de rtog pa g.yo ba/ gsum gyis bsam gtan skyon yin la/ de lta bu yi rgyu skyon gsum po de yis/ bsam gtan gsum pa man gyi 'jig rten 'jig go /gsum pa skyon de bsal ba'i thabs ni/ phyi rol mkha' yis go 'byed pa dang sa yis ni rten byed pa de gnyis kyi/ phyi nang gi snod bcud gnyis gnyis kyi rten byed cing skyon ni med pa yin pas/ de phyir mkhas pas nang gi nam mkha'i khams dang*/ sa khams de gnyis kyi/ gnang shes par byas nas/ rlung me chu gsum po'i skyon gzhom par bya'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba la gnyis le'u 'di nyid kyi don bsdu ba dang*/

le'u gsum gyi thun mong ba'i don bsdu'o// dang po la gnyis/ skyon yon bstan pas don bsdu ba dang*/ dgos pa bstan pas don bsdu ba'o/ dang po ni/ de ltar rdzas sngags rlung gsum gyi/ thig le ma rig dang 'brel bas na/ 'dzag pa dang bcas pas 'khor ba nyon mongs pa bskyed par byed pa'i gzhir gsungs pa yin ste/ de 'pho med du 'chings pa'i thabs kyis gdams ngag gis zin pas na/ 'khor ba 'joms pa'i gnyen por bshad do// gnyis pa la gnyis/ mtshams sbyar ba/ rdzas sngags rlung gi thig le bsgom pa'i dgos pa'o// dang po ni/ 'ching byed rdzas sngags rlung gi thig le gsum po sbyang gzhi gsum dang sbyar nas/ sgom par byed pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*// bcom ldan rdo rje sems dpa' yis// gnyis pa ni/ mi gang yun ring chags chen dbang song bas/ 'dod khams kyi srid pa dang*/ gzugs dang*/ gzugs med kyi srid pa gsum du skyes pa rnams/ de dag grol ba'i don du ni/ dkar dmar rdzas kyi thig le sgom par gsungs pa yin/ gang zhig zhe sdang chen po'i dbang song bas/ mi gang mi srun pa yi lus can/ sha za srin po sogs su skye ba de rnams myur dgrol don du/ kun brtags bskyed rim sngags kyi thig le gsungs pa yin/ gang zhig gti mug chen pos kun nas 'khrul par gyur pa rnams grol don du/ srid pa gsum las skyob cing*/ ril bu sogs dngos grub 'bras bu brgyad/ thob phyir dang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan ye shes 'bras bu ni mngon tu snang ba'i phyir// rlung gi thig le gsungs pa yin// gnyis pa le'u gsum gyi thun mong ba'i don bsdu ni/ de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum snga ma las phyi ma/ gcig la gcig rten cing 'brel bar snang ba ni/ lhan skyes ye shes kyi rten gyur rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul lo// zhes gsungs so/ gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don gsal bar byed pa las/

thig le gsum bstan pa ste lnga pa'o/// /de ltar rtsa rlung thig gsum gyi rgyu ba la brten nas/ gnas skabs bzhi 'byung ba yin la de bzhir brten pa'i rnam shes dang*/ ye shes kyi 'brel tshul 'chad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang*/ gnas skabs bzhi/ ye shes bzhi sogs 'brel ba yi tshul/ mdor bsdus rigs pa bshad par bya/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la lnga/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ gnyid 'thug po'i gnas skabs/ rmi lam gyi/ chags pa'i/ tha mal gyi gnas skabs rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ thog mar lus bskyed tshul gong du bshad cing*/ skyes nas da lta lus gnas dus gnas skabs bzhi yin te/ gnyid dang rmi lam snyoms 'jug dang*/ tha mal sad pa'i dus dang rnam pa bzhi po de/ dri mas ma dag sku bzhi'i gnas skabs yin la/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ dag ma dag gi ngo bo dang*/ dri ma ji ltar sbyong ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ de yang gzhi lam 'bras bur sbyar tshul gyi dbye ba rnam pa mang bshad kyang*/ gnyid dus tshogs brgyad las kun gzhi gtso bo ste/ gnas yul snying ga chos kyi 'khor lor gnas/ tshogs drug gi rgyu ba mi gsal ba kun gzhi la gcig tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyi gnas shing*/ gnyid mthug gi 'khrul pa de dag na 'od gsal ba'i 'bras bu ni mngon du byed la/ me long lta bu'i ye shes zhes kyang bya ste// chos sku spros bral ngo bo nyid chos dbyings ye shes kyang mngon tu 'gyur ro// gnyis pa dri ma ji ltar sbyang ba'i rim pa la gnyis/ sbyang bya dang*/ sbyong byed do// dang po ni/ de'i gnas skabs su kun gzhi la bag chags ma lus pa brten kyang*/ de nyid rang gi rang mi rig ste/ dmigs chos rnams mngon tu mi gsal zhing*/ bdun pa'i yid kyis 'du byed g.yo ba'i rkyen kun gzhi la yod pa'i phyir/

gnas skabs de ni rang gis rang ma rig dri ma can zhes bya/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'o// dang po ni/ dri ma de'i gnyen po ni gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ chos la bdag med pa ste/ bdag med gcig nyan thos kyi rgyun mtha' dang*/ de'i steng bzung ba'i chos la bdag med ste/ chos bdag med pa'i phyed rtogs pa rang rgyal gyi sgom lam mthar thug pa'i rgyun mtha' dang gnyis dang*/ bdag med gnyis ka rtogs pa theg chen rigs kyi sgom lam gyi rgyun mtha' ste/ rim par gnyen po 'phags pa gsum gyi so so'i lam gyi shes pa ste/ gnyen po des sbyangs theg gsum so so yi/ rgyun mtha' rdo rje lta bu yis/ ma rig pa'i dri bcom nas so so'i lam gyi mthar thug pa'i dag pa gsum dus ring pos rim par thob gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de phyir tshe gcig la sangs rgyas thob par 'dod pas ni gsal la mi rtog pa'i mtshan nyid can gyis/ nyin mtshan gnyis kyi 'od gsal bsgom par bya ste/ 'od gsal de gnyis kyang*/ rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid/ bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i dbyings zung 'jug phyag rgya che la rol zhing spyod par bya'o// gsum pa rmi lam gyi gnas skabs rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ dag ma dag gi ngo bo/ rmi lam gyi snang ba rgyas par bshad pa/ gnad 'ching ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ gnas skabs gnyis pa rmi lam shes pa ni/ gnyid mthug gi dus kun gzhi'i rnam shes kyi steng na/ tshogs bdun 'khor bcas bsdus pa/ de las drug pa yid shes pa bag chags dang bcas pa'i nyon mongs can gyi yid/ srog rlung gis bskyod nas 'du byed pa dang bcas te langs pa/ rtsa yi gnas rnams nas brgyud de bzung dang 'dzin/ gnyis snang gi rmi lam gyi 'khrul pa bskyed par byed pa yin cing*/ 'khrul pa de dag na longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku yin ste/ yul snang sems gsum gsal la ma 'dres par snang stong dbyer med de'i ngo bo drug pa yid kyi shes pas kha nang lta'i cha dag pa sor rtog ye shes dang*/

bdun yid dag pa mnyam nyid ye shes kyi rang bzhin tu rnam par gnas/ gnyis pa rmi lam gyi snang ba rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ spyir bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ ye shes su ma dag par 'khrul bar gnas pa'i skabs kyi rmi lam gyi snang ba ji ltar 'khrul pa'i tshul yang*/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ gnas kyi rkyen gyis rmi lam 'char tshul dang*/ khams kyi rkyen gyis 'char ba'i tshul lo/ dang po ni/ rmi lam shar ba na/ rtsa dang*/ gnas kyi khams kyis rmi lam du mar 'char ste/ de yang drug yid srog rlung bcas rtsa gnas steng du song nas spyi bor rmi lam shar na lha yul dang*/ mkha' snang zhing ri mthor gyen du 'gro ba sogs dang*/ gzugs sgra la sogs ma 'dres 'char/ yid rlung de rtsa gnas 'og tu 'gro na dmyal sogs snang ba dang*/ thur 'gro brag rong thibs po dang*/ mun khung sogs 'char snang ba 'byung*/ yid rlung bcas par du yod pa'i rtsa gnas su song na gling bzhi sa steng ste/ de yang rtsa gnas mdun g.yas rgyab dang g.yon phyogs su// shar lho nub byang snang ba 'byung*// rtsa gnas yangs la yangs par snang*// dog la dog snang ba/ gnyis pa khams kyi rkyen gyis rmi lam 'char tshul la/ bstan/ bshad/ bsdu gsum las/ dang po ni/ de bzhin du/ khams kyi rkyen gyis rmi lam gyi yul snang der yang mi 'dra bar 'byung ste/ gnyis pa ni/ rlung khams kyi gnas su zhugs pa la rdzas dang gos sngo nag bya nag 'phur dang rta zhon dang*// nor bu sngo dang rig pa dwangs// yang na mi brtan du mar 'char// rtsa mkhris khrag rgyu ba'i gnas song me dang ni// gos dmar sa dang gser snang dang*// btsun pa de bzhin sna tshogs snang*// bad kan dkar cha'i gnas kyi rtsa la reg na/ chu dang kha ba mu tig dang*/ gos dkar bud med glang po dang*// dngul sogs du ma snang ba ste// gsum pa ni/ de'i tshul ji ltar rtsa rlung khams kyi rim pa dang*/

des bskyed pa'i khams kyi bag chags la brten nas rmi lam snang ba sna tshogs 'byung tshul rgyas par ni/ rgyal bas 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud du gsungs/ gsum pa gnad 'ching ba 'bras bu dang bcas pa la bzhi/ rmi lam la gnad du bsnun pa'i dgos pa/ nad 'ching thabs dngos/ dag pa'i rmi lam yod par bstan pa/ sangs rgyas la rmi lam med par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ bag chags kyi dbang gi rmi lam snang ba de phyir rnal 'byor rtsa rlung byang sems kyi lam bsgom pa na/ gang dang gang gi rtsa dang khams kyi bag chags rnams// dag pa na rmi lam sgyu ma ltar rtogs pa dang*/ ma dag pa na de nyid 'khrul par 'char nas ma dag pa'i dbye ba ni/ rmi lam gyi gnas skabs 'dis shes shing*/ rmi lam dang*/ bar do tshul mtshungs pas bar do'i gdams pa'i tshod 'dzin dang*/ 'jig rten phyi ma'i gnas su 'pho ba yi/ snang ba 'byung tshe lam gang du 'gro ba'i tshod 'dzin kyang byed pas na/ rmi lam la gnad du bsnun par byed dgos pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de phyir 'khrul pa'i rmi lam gyi dus snang ba lha sku sgyu ma/ grags pa sngags sogs shes shing*/ de 'ang de kho na nyid sgyu ma lta bur bsgom pa ye shes kyi phyag rgyas bcing dgos te/ rmi lam gyi snang ba de sbyong byed kyi thabs sogs rmi lam gyi rgyu 'bras du ma mdo rgyud las gsungs pa rnams/ 'dir ni rgyas par ma bstan to// 'khrul pa'i rmi lam ni yang 'khrul ste/ 'khor ba 'ba' zhig bskyed pa yin pas/ de spang bar bya ste/ gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs bag chags kyis ma 'khrul ba'i rmi lam ni 'khrul pa'i rmi lam gyi gnyen po yin/ 'khrul pa'i rmi lam gyi gnyen po ma 'khrul pa'i rmi lam yod pa de phyir rgyal sras sa bcu la bzhugs pa rnams la yang*/ rmi lam bstan pa mdo las gsungs/ de na sa la bzhugs pa rnams nyon mongs med phyir rmi lam 'byung mi rigs snyam na mi lam gyi rkyen yod de/

rmi lam gyi rgyu zag med khams gzugs nas/ zag pa med pa'i lus bzung nas/ khams gsum du spyod pa'i phyir ro// bzhi pa ni/ bcom ldan rmi lam bral ba ste/ zag med dang*/ zag bcas kyi 'du byed kyi rkyen thams cad dang bral ba'i phyir ro// bzhi pa snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs bshad pa la bzhi ste/ dag ma dag gi ngo bo/ 'khor ba bskyed pa'i tshul/ mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i go rim/gnang 'ching ba dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs chags bcas 'gyur bde myong ba de tshe ni/ rnam par shes pa ni dga' bzhi go rim ltar myong ba'i rnam shes ldan pa yin ste/ 'dod sred kyis dang po spyi bo ru dga' ba dang po 'byong ste/ dga' ba gnyis pa ru mgrin par dga' ba/ dga' ba gsum pa snying ga na myong zhing*/ lte bar babs pas rnam shes 'dus pa yis/ a shad kyi me dang*/ thig le zla ba gnyis dbu ma'i mar snar 'dres tshe/ dung can nang du dga' ba bzhi pa lhan skyes myong bar 'gyur ro// lhan skyes ye shes de ni skad cig ma gcig pa'i shes pa ste/ de'i ngo bo tshogs brgyad ma 'gags so sor gsal/ nyams bde ba ngo bo mi rtog ba ste/ de'i ngo bo ni nyon mongs pa'i dri can min pa/ de phyir de ni gzhi dus kyi ye shes sku zhes brjod/ de ltar dga' ba gsum rnam rtog gi cha dang*/ lhan skyes ye shes kyi char shar ba/ de ltar mi shes pa rnams/ de'i don ma rtogs pas phyir 'dzag pas dga' bral gyi nyams skye'o// de ltar snyoms 'jug gi gnas skabs rmongs sgrib de gnyen pos bcom pas dag na/ snang srid thams cad lhan skyes ye shes de nyid kyi rang rtsal yin pa'i phyir/ tshogs drug gi ngo bo gsal la 'gag med ru 'cha' ba sprul sku/ 'dzag bral bde chen gyi ngo bo longs sku/ stong nyid 'od gsal dang ldan pa chos sku ste/ sku gsum lhan skyes kyi ye shes 'di ni chos kun la khyab byed du 'gro zhing*/

kun kyang lhan skyes kyi bdag nyid yin pas/ de'i tshul la gnad du bsnun nas bsgom par bya'o// gnyis pa 'khor ba bskyed pa'i tshul ni/ ma dag 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams ni/ lhan skyes ye shes skad cig ma'i bde chen de'i ngo mi shes pas/ gnyis 'dzin gyis rang la gnas pa gzhan du bzung phyir 'dzag pas/ lhan skyes kyi bde ba nyams nas dug gsum bskyed byed cing*// mi 'dod bzhin du 'khor ba de'i tshul la dug gsum ji ltar bskyed na/ 'dod sred kyis dang po dga' ba dang ldan pas 'dod chags bskyed pa yin/ bar ma ru lhan skyes ye shes ma rtogs gti mug ste/ phyir 'dzag ba'i rjes la 'dod chags de dang bral zhing zhe sdang gi sems 'byung ngo*/ de nas slar yang rang bde 'dod kyis rang la chags shing*/ ser sna dang*/ gzhan la sdang bas phrag dog sogs nyon mongs pa kun bskyed cing mi dge spyod/ de yis ngan 'gro kun bskyed byed/ gsum pa mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba'i go rim la gnyis te/ rgyu'i theg pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang*/ 'bras bu'i theg pa'o// dang po la gsum/ skyes bu chung ngu dang*/ 'bring dang*/ chen po'i lam rim mo// dang po ni/ mi dge spyod pa de las cung zad log byas nas/ rang bde ba dang*/ gzhan dga' ba'i phan 'dod kyi blos ser sna dang*/ phra dog chags pa dor byas nas/ sbyin dang ldan zhing khro ba dor ba sogs/ dge ba bcu'i tshul khrims ldan pa sogs kyi rang gnas skabs kyi bde ba 'dod pa'i don des mtho ris kyi bde ba thob pa ni/ skyes bu chung ngu'i lam yin ste/ gnas skabs mtho ris kyi 'dod sred bcad nas bsam gtan gyi/ bde ba tshol zhing gzugs dang gzugs med kyi gnas su skye ba len cing*/ mthar de yang sngar ltar gnas skabs bsam gtan bzhi'i bde ba'i ro myong nas/ slar yang nyon mongs chags sogs ldan pas dug gsum dbang gis 'khor bar 'gyur ste/ de dag ni skyes bu chung ngu'i chen po yin/

gnyis pa ni/ de ltar khams gsum ni sems 'khrul pa'i mdangs su shes nas khams gsum gyi/ chags sogs chos dang*/ gang zag gi bdag med gcig dang phyed rtogs pa'i rang rang gi mthong sgom gyis bcom nas/ rang rang gi mya ngan 'das ba'i zhi ba der sred de thob pa nas/ rang gcig por zhi bde der gnas pa ni nyan rang ste/ skyes bu chen po'i chung ngu yin zhes brjod do// gsum pa ni/ srid dang zhi ba mtha' gnyis ka la/ sred spangs te/ srid zhi mnyam nyid kyi sbyor bas nyams su len pa ni skyes bu chen po ste/ byang chub sems dpa'i lam yin no// gnyis pa 'bras bu'i theg ba ni/ de rnams las khyad par 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa'i nye lam/ thig le 'dzag med du bcings bas/ 'bras bu mthar phyin sangs rgyas kyi sar tshe gcig la dbang thob pa'i las rmad du byung ba ni/ rdo rje theg pa'i rgyud sde rnams nas sangs rgyas kyis rgyas par gsungs pa yin/ bzhi pa gnad 'ching pa dngos ni/ thig le 'pho med du ji ltar bcings pa'i tshul ni dga' bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ go rim dang*/ 'pho bcas 'pho med kyi dbye ba 'dzag pa'i skyon 'pho med du bcing ba'i thabs dang*/ de'i phan yon dang*/ thig le rnam par dag pa'i tshul dang*/ thig le de'i rgyu 'bras lugs 'byung lugs ldog gi dga' ba bcu drug la sogs pa kun/ rgyal bas bla med rgyud du gsungs shing*/ snyoms 'jug gi sgrib pa sbyong dgos pa de phyir las kyi phyag rgya bsten pa'i gnad kyis bcing dgos la/ de'i tshul 'dir ni rgyas par ma bris so// lnga pa tha mal gyi gnas skabs rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ ngo bo dang*/ dag pa dang*/ spang gnyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ sad pa'i gnas skabs tha mal dus kyi shes pa'i ngo bo ni/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes nyon yid kyi 'du byed kyis/ le'u dang por sngar bshad rkyen bzhi nyer sbyor bas/ mig sogs rnam shes drug po rnams// dbang po drug dang 'brel byas te// gzugs sogs yul drug rnams su snang zhing*/

yul dbang pos spyod pa na/ bde sdug btang snyoms tshor ba gsum dang*/ des chags dang zhe sdang gti mug bskyed cing*/ de'i bag chags de ma thag pa'i yid kyis khyer/ kun gzhi'i steng gzhag yang 'du byed pas/ 'khor ba mtha' med 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ tha mal gyi shes pa 'di nyid sgrib pa dag pa ye shes gsum yin ste/ nyon yid dag pa ni mi g.yo mnyam nyid kyi ye shes de/ kun rtog ste/ drug pa yid kyi rnam shes dag pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes dang*/ sgo lnga'i rnam shes yul dang bcas pa rnams rnam par dag pa ni bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so// gsum pa la gnyis/ spangs gnyen 'bras bu dang bcas pa/ gnad 'ching ba dngos so// dang po ni/ gnas lugs kyi don la sgrib pa rags pa rnams ni mthong spangs kyis spongs shing*/ phra ba rnams ni bsgom spangs kyis spongs te/ spong byed kyi gnyen po theg chen gyi chos dang bdag med pa gnyis dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang*/ snying rje ste sbyong byed rnam pa bzhi bo/ des sbyang bya sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi dri ma rnams sbyangs nas/ sprul skus 'gro don mdzad pa ste/ dbang shes lnga dang*/ drug yid kha phyir lta'i cha dag pa las sprul sku dang*/ 'du byed drug yid g.yo ba dang*/ rmi lam gnad gcig pa'i phyir/ rmi lam dang 'dra ba'i drug yid kha nang lta'i cha dag pa longs skur brjod de/ sad pa'i gnas skabs sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu sku gnyis yin/ de dag gi tshul rgyas par mdo dang rgyud de chos rnams thams cad du/ gsungs phyir 'dir ni bsdus pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyu mtshan de phyir sad pa'i gnas skabs kyi rtog pa thams cad 'dzin med zhen bral gang shar bzo med du skyong ba/ de lta bu'i tshul gyi chos kyi phyag rgya bcing bar bya'o// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar sbyang gzhi gnas skabs bzhi dang 'brel pa'i 'khrul pa rnams dang*/ sbyong byed ma 'khrul ba gnyen po ye shes lam rim dang*/

phyag rgya bzhi dang sogs kyi sbyang 'bras sku bzhi ste/ rim par 'brel pa'i snga ma dang*/ phyi ma rten dang brten pa yin no// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las/ rnam shes dang ye shes gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'brel pa bstan pa ste drug pa'o// de ltar gnas skabs bzhis bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi chos thams cad nang rang sems kyi rol pa las gzhan du ma dmigs pas na dus 'khor las gsungs pa ltar gyi 'jig rten gyi khams/ nang rdo rje'i lus la rdzogs pa'i tshul ston pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas ji ltar nang gi lus la/ phyi rol 'jig rten gyi bkod pa rnams ji bzhin gnas pa ni/ sems kyis bsdus pa'i khams gsum nang gi rdo rje'i lus kyi bdag nyid du rdzogs pa yin de/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la dgu/ gnas gzhan sogs bstan pa/ 'byung ba rim brtsegs/ ri rnams/ gling bdun/ nang gi 'byung ba lnga/ mtsho bdun/ gza' la sogs pa/ me gsum/ skye gnas dang dus sbyor sogs sbyar ba'o// dang po la gnyis/ gnas gzhan nyi shu dang sbyar ba/ 'dod pa bcu gcig dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ dus 'khor las sor mo nyi shu rtsa bzhi ni zung gi khru'o// gsungs pa ltar lus khru bzhir phye ba'i dang po/ spyi bo nas ni sor bzhi po/ gzugs med gnas bzhi te de 'og tu// sor ni bcu drug tu gzugs khams bcu drug nyid/ de 'og 'dod lha drug mir bcas pa'i gnas/ gnyis pa ni/ lte ba nas ni rkang mthil bar ste/ lte ba nas sum mdo'i bar sa yi dkyil 'khor/ lha min klu dang yi dwags dang ste/ gseg ma sa'i dmyal ba'i gnas dang*/ brla chu'i dkyil 'khor ste/ bye ma chu'i dmyal ba'i gnas dang*/ 'dam gyi chu'i dmyal ba'i gnas so// rje ngar ni me'i dkyil 'khor ste/ me dang*/ du ba mi zad pa'i dmyal ba gnyis/

de man chad rlung gi dkyil 'khor ste/ ngu 'bod dang*/ mun pa chen po'i dmyal ba gnyis/ rkang mthil ni rdo rje dmyal ba ste// dmyal ba brgyad kyi gnas rim gsungs so// gnyis pa 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang sbyar ba ni/ yang na rkang lag so so'i tshig gsum so so na rim pa ltar/ rlung me chu yi dkyil 'khor yin// brang ni sa yi dkyil 'khor ste// gsum pa ri rnams dang sbyar ba ni/ sgal tshigs rnams ni/ ri rab de bzhin ri bdun ni// brla dang rje ngar de 'og bol gong ni rus// dpung pa lag ngar lag pa dang*// sen mo'i bar du rim pa ltar// sngon po man+dhar mtshan mo// nor bu byed dang bre bo dang*/ kha ba can dang rdo rje'i ri ste ri bdun po yin no// bzhi pa gling bdun dang sbyar ba ni// de dag gi bar gyi mtsho gling drug gi nang na bad kan dang*// rgyu ma tshil snyigs mchin pa sha rnams rim bzhin/ zla ba dang gcig dkar po dang gnyis/ ku sha dang gsum/ mi 'am ci dang bzhi/ khrung khrung gling dang lnga/ drag po'i gling dang drug rnams rim pa bzhin tu sbyar ste/ rkang lag dum bu bcu gnyis ni// dzam bu gling sogs gling phran bcas pa yin// lnga pa nang gi 'byung ba lnga dang sbyar ba ni/ de bzhin lus kyi sra ba'i cha sa khams brlan pa'i cha chu dang drod kyi cha me dang dbugs rlung sogs/ khams bzhi lus kyi bu ga nam mkha' yin// drug pa rgya mtsho bdun dang sbyar ba ni/ khu bzhag dang klad pa dang*/ skyes par bad kan/ bud med la 'o ma dang mchil ma rdul// dri chu nang gi rgya mtsho bdun/ rim bzhin phyi'i sbrang rtsi mar zho 'o ma chu/ chang dang ba tsha'i rang bzhin no// bdun pa gza' la sogs pa rnams dang sbyar ba ni// dbang po sna bug gnyis/ rlung gza' nyi zla gnyis/ mig gnyis me gza' mig phur dang bzhi/ kha dang dri chu'i sgo/ chu gza' lhag sangs dang drug tshangs bug dang 'og sgo/ sa'i gza' spen pa mjug ring dang brgyad/

rna ba gnyis/ nam mkha'i gza' sgra gcan dang dus me bcu ste/ sgra gcan dang dus me mgo mjug yin la/ bsdom pas gza' dgu'i rang bzhin te/ nang du so so gnyis ni/ phyir rgyu skar nyer brgyad dang dbyu gu bzhi/ nang du khams 'babs ba'i rtsa stong phrag don gnyis ni/ phyi rol gyi lung ba dang*/ chu bo stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis yin pa'o// nang du rgyu ma phyi rol sprin dang*/ nang gi rlung ni/ phyi rol gyi rlung*// snying ga'i sgra ni thog yin te// lto ba'i sgra ni 'brug tu gsungs/ brgyad pa me gsum dang sbyar ba ni// snying ga drod bskyed klog gi me/ mgrin par zas 'gugs 'dren byed pa'i me/ lte ba na zas sreg bzhu byed pa'i me/ de rnams phyi rol gyi glog dang nyi drod sreg byed me/ dgu pa skye gnas dang dus sbyor sogs dang sbyar ba la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ rgyas bshad kha 'phang ba'o// dang po ni/ gzhan yang lus kyi pags pa drod dang ba spu/ phyi rol gyi me dang rlung gi rang bzhin no// lus skyes srin bu skye gnas bzhi yin te/ shig sgong skyes/ khong pa'i srin bu drod gsher skyes/ khu ba las byung ba'i srin bu ni mngal skyes/ nang du lus la gnas pa'i srog chags phra mo gzhan ni brdzus skyes so// phyi'i char ni lce chung las 'bab ba'i bdud rtsi ste/ phyi'i thun brgyad nas skad cig bar gyi ni/ dus sbyor thams cad sngar bstan pa'i/ rtsa rlung thig le sems bcas phyi nang gi sbyar bshad zin rnams ltar yin gsungs so// dbu mar srog rlung de dkar dmar gyi drangs mar sbyor ba na/ rim bzhin phyir zla nyi 'dzin par snang ba dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ de sogs rnam bshad du ma rnams ni// phyi nang gzhan gsum dag pa ye shes kyi dbyings su// sbyor phyir dpag tu med pa gsungs/ gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de sogs phyi nang gi rten 'brel rtogs pa na/ kun rdzob dang don dam yul yul can rnams phan tshun thabs dang shes rab sbyor tshul shes pas// sna tshogs yon tan 'gyur phyir ro// de rnams kyi tshul 'dir ni mdor bsdus cung zad brjod pa yin no// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni// zab mo nang gi don rnam par bshad pa las/

snod la sbyar ba bstan pa ste bdun pa'o// de ltar thos bsam gyis lus dngos po'i gnas lugs gtan la phab zin nas/ de dang 'brel ba'i lam rim pa gnyis las/ dang po bskyed rim kun brtags kyi rnal 'byor gyi tshul 'chad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de ltar phyi nang sbyar bshad bstan zin pa de nas sems can kun tu rtog pa yi ngo la/ bden pa med bzhin kun brtags kyi lha rnams bsgoms pa'i don gyi dgos pa ni/ las dang po pa rnams la lha sku sogs la sems 'dzin pas zhi gnas bskyed la/ phyi nang gi chos rnams dkyil 'khor gyi don tu sbyor shes pa dang*/ 'bras bu la dbang 'byor ste/ gzhan don gzugs sku du ma ston nus pa'i phyir// dpa' bo gcig nas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mtha' yas pa'i bar/ gsungs pa'i nges pa rnams tshul 'di lta bur shes dgos ste/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ lha'i grangs kyi nges pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi nges pa/ thabs shes kyi rang bzhin/ bskyed rdzogs kyi nges pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rnam rtog rim par nges pa sbyong byed/ rnam rtog 'tshol bar skye ba sbyong byed/ thun mong pa'i bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ rtsa dbu ma de la brten pa'i kun gzhi yang dag don dam/ ye shes kyi rlung dang thig le nyag gcig ni/ 'khor 'das kun khyab kyi yon tan dang*/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi khyab bdag yin phyir/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed kyi dgos pas lha dpa' bo gcig pa he ru ka'i sgrubs thabs gsungs pa'o// 'bras bu sku gnyis/ lam thabs dang shes rab gnyis dang*/ sbyangs gzhi steng 'og gi khams dkar dmar bden gnyis dang*/ de sogs gnyis chos rnams sbyong phyir yang yum mam/ gtso 'khor gnyis pa bstan pa'o// lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ rtsa ba spros bral/ 'khrul pa ma rig gnyen po rdzas sngags rlung gi thig le rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum// steng 'og bar gsum yi ge 'bru gsum/

zla nyi sgra gcan gyi rlung gsum sogs gsum chos rnams sbyong phyir lha gsum pa dang*/ zhal gsum pa sogs gsungs ste/ nam mkha' ye shes kyi khams kun la khyab par phyes te sa sogs khams bzhi/ dga' ba bzhi/ phyag rgya bzhi/ dbang bzhi/ lam bzhi/ sku bzhi sogs bzhi ldan gyi dag pas/ gtso 'khor dkyil 'khor bzhi par gsungs shing*/ zhal bzhir bstan pa/ khams kyi khyab bya bzhi// ye shes lnga dang phung po lnga/ rtsa 'khor lo rtsa ba'i rlung lnga dang khyab byed ste khams lnga bcas/ sbyang gzhi lnga ldan gyi phyir/ sbyong byed lha lnga bstan te/ de yi sgrub thabs rgyud du mar gsungs pa sogs khams bzhi yi steng*/ nam mkha' dang*/ ye shes kyi khams bcas khams drug rnam shes tshogs drug sogs drug chos rnams kyi phyir/ lha drug pa dang*/ nyon tshogs drug ste/ yid dang bcas bdun sbyong phyir lha bdun pa/ lha dgu sogs rim par sbyang gzhi'i grangs dang mnyam pa'i sbyong byed kyi lha bstan ste/ tshogs brgyad sogs phyir lha brgyad pa dang*// snying ga'i rtsa 'dab brgyad dbu ma'i yar mar gyi rtse gnyis bsdoms pas bcu/ rlung bcu/ sa bcu/ stobs bcu/ de sogs dgu dang*/ sbyang gzhi la dgyes rdor lha dgu yum bcas bcu pa dang*/ gzhan yang lha bcu pa dang*/ gnyis pa ni/ phung po lnga khams lnga rnams spyir lha bcu dbang po yul/ gzugs nas ye shes bar drug khams drug gnyis kyis bcu gnyis/ de bzhin 'gro ba sogs las byed pa drug dang*/ de'i dbang po rkang pa sogs drug dang bcas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor ni/ lha lnga dgu dang bcu gsum dang*/ nyer lnga so gnyis so bzhi pa/ so bdun rigs brgya du ma'i bar du 'gyur ro// gsum pa ni/ rtsa rlung thig le 'khor lo'i grangs su sbyar ste/ sbyang gzhi rnam rtog gi grangs bzhin/ sbyong byed de dang mnyam par bstan pa ste/ lha'i grangs dang*/ gtso bo'i zhal dang phyag mtshan sbyang gzhi de rnams dang mtshungs par bstan to// gnyis pa dkyil 'khor gyi nges pa ni/

de bzhin rdo rje'i lus la dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs pa'i tshul bshad pa ni/ phyi rol ji bzhin pa sogs 'byung ba rim brtsegs dang*/ sin+dhu rdo rje'i thig zlum po dang*/ dbyibs dang bcas pa bsdus pa lus la sbyar ba'i tshul ni/ kho bos dkyil 'khor snang bar bshad/ gsum pa thabs shes kyi rang bzhin la gsum/ thabs shes kyi rnam grangs spyir bstan pa/ thabs shes kyi rgyud kyi khyad par/ thabs shes su 'gyur tshul zhib tu bshad pa'o dang po ni/ de ltar bstan pa thams cad kyang*/ phan tshun thabs dang shes rab dang*// g.yas g.yon lus sems dkar dmar dang*/ rten gzhal yas dang brten pa lha ma lus pa// mdor na 'khor 'das thams cad thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ shes rab gtsor bstan shes rab rgyud// thabs gtsor bstan pa pha rgyud de// kun kyang gnyis med rang bzhin yin ste/ rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud rnams kyang*/ brjod bya gtso che chung gi dbang gis pha ma'i rgyud dang*/ gnyis med kyi rgyud du grags pa las/ thams cad thabs shes gnyis med du gsungs so// gsum pa ni/ thabs shes kyi tshul rgyas par bstan na/ mig ni thabs te gzugs shes rab// gzugs ni thabs gyur mig shes rab// ro ma thabs te rlung shes rab// rkyang ma shes rab rlung ni thabs/ skyes bu thabs te sems shes rab// bud med shes rab sems ni thabs// dbus ni shes rab phyogs ni thabs// don dam thabs te kun rdzob ni// shes rab sogs ji skad bshad pa de bzhin dang*/ de lugs bzlog pa yi tshul gyis thabs shes su sbyor ba yin ste/ thabs shes su sbyor tshul phyi nang gzhan gsum snang srid 'khor 'das thams cad ste/ de sogs dpag med shes par bya zhing*/ gzhan yang kha dog rnams yon tan ro dri sogs kyi rim pa rnams/ rlung gi skabs du ji skad bstan pa bzhin rnams kyang phan tshun thabs shes su sbyor tshul rgyud kun tu mtha' yas pa gsungs so// bzhi pa bskyed rim gyi nges pa ni/

de bzhin bskyed rdzogs gnyis la sbyar na/ dbyibs rnams ni/ sku rlung dang brjod pa sngags te/ rlung sngags bskyed rim dang*/ yid ni thig le ni rdzogs rim brjod/ de bzhin thog par skye ba bskyed rim bstan pa ste/ 'chi ba rdzogs rim nyid yin no// kun brtags dbyibs la sogs pa/ bskyed rim zhes bya ste/ gzhan dbang yid kyi thig le dang*/ 'brel ba rnam bcas bsdus nas nā da sogs la sems 'jog pa ni rdzogs rim du bshad ste/ kun rdzob bden pa bskyed rim ste/ don dam gyi bden pa dang ldan pa rdzogs rim bshad/ bden gnyis la 'jug pa'i thabs rnams bskyed rims sangs rgyas kyi ye shes kyi yon tan thams cad bskyed par byed ste/ bden gnyis dbyer med kyi shes rab sangs rgyas kyi snying po rdzogs rim gsungs so// gsum pa mjug bsdub ni/ thabs shes bskyed rdzogs de la sogs pa thams cad kyang*/ phyi dang nang dang gzhan gyi sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed bstan pa'i rim pas/ mthar thug sangs rgyas kyi ye shes gcig rgyu sbyor bar byed pa'i tshul ni/ rtsa ba tsam mdor bsdus brjod pa yin ste/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos thams cad ji ltar e waṃ thabs shes su bshad pa bzhin ste/ phyi nang gi chos bden gnyis kyis bsdus pa'i shes bya thams cad dngos po 'dzin med kyi ngang du spyad par bya'o// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don rgyas par bshad pa las/ kun brtags kyi lha 'byung ba'i tshul bshad pa ste brgyad pa'o/// /de ltar kun rdzob kyi 'khrul pa rnams rags pa bskyed rim gyis bcings nas sbyang tshul bshad zin pa dang*/ de las gzhan pa'i 'khrul snang rags pa dang*/ phra ba lhan skyes zung 'jug gi lam gyi sbyang gzhi/ sbyang bya/ sbyong byed bcas 'chad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas 'khor 'das kyi chos rnams dag dang ma dag gi cho 'phrul du shar ba thams cad kyi/

sbyang gzhi sbyong byed rnams le'u snga mar gsungs pa de yi/ nges pa 'dir ni bstan par bya// gnyis pa rgyas bshad la drug yang dag pa'i bden pa gnyis bshad pa/ de'i tshul ma rtogs pas 'khrul pa'i log rtog spang ba/ spang gnyen gyi rtsa ba/ bye brag tu rgyud sde'i gnyen po'i nges pa mdor bstan pa/ rgyas par bshad pa// de nyid rgyud kyi lha thams cad dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ sems can khams ni sangs rgyas kyi/ snying po dri med gang yin pa de nyid// gdod nas dag pa don dam gyi bden pa dang*/ don dam ye shes kyi 'od du shar ba kun rdzob ste/ bden gnyis ldan te/ 'di ni gsang 'dus rgyud ye shes rdo rje ru// kun rdzob gzung 'dzin snang ba ste// bden pa de ni med bzhin tu snang ba dpe chu zla lta bu gang yin pa de ni kun rdzob kyi bden pa'o// don dam stong nyid bco brgyad kyis bstan pa'i gnyis med ye shes kyi yul du gyur pa de don dam gyi bden pa'o// bden gnyis zung du 'jug pa gnyis med ye shes phyin ci ma log par rtog pa ni gnas lugs mngon tu gyur pa zhes brjod do// tshul de nyid rtog par byed pa'i rnam par rtog pas bskyed pa'i gzung 'dzin gyi/ gnyen po ye shes ni/ gzung 'dzin gyi rnam rtog sbyong byed yin par bshad de/ de yang sbyang gzhi'i grangs bzhin sbyong byed kyi chos kun gyi grangs de tsam du bstan to// gnyis pa de tshul ma rtogs pas 'khrul pa'i log rtog spang ba la gnyis/ phyi rol pa dang*/ theg pa dman pa'o// dang po ni/ tshangs sogs mu stegs kyi grub mtha' thams cad kyang*/ rnam rtog gis byas pa'i log pa'i shes bya yin/ rgyu rkyen ldan pa sogs 'dod pa/ grangs can pa rtag mthar zhen pa dang*/ tshe snga phyi med 'dzin sogs rgyang 'phen pa chad mthar lhung ba sogs/ log pa'i lta ba sna tshogs pa'i lta ba kun kyang lus sems kyi/

gzung 'dzin la brten 'byung bar gsungs so// gnyis pa theg pa dman pas btags pa'i log rtog spang ba la gsum/ nyan thos sde gnyis kyi 'dod pa spyir dgag gnas ma bu pas btags pa'i bdag bye brag tu dgag spang gnyen gyi rim pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rang sde nyan thos gnyis kyi 'dod pa/ phyi rol 'jig rten rdul phran las grub par 'dod pa dang*/ mdo sde pa ni/ dbang shes la rdul phran mi snang bar/ gos kyi phag na lag mgo yod pa ltar/ rdul phran gyi rnam par snang ba phag na mo yi tshul du 'dod pa ste/ de gnyis ka'ang kun gzhi 'du byed pa'i yid dang bcas pa'i bag chags kyi rnam 'gyur las yul sna tshogs su snang ba'i yul snang gi cha de ni nus pa ste/ ma rtogs dbang gis gzhan rtog gi 'khrul pa yin gyis/ sems las gzhan tu grub pa med te/ 'on kyang bdag dang*/ gtso bo sogs byed pa po ru 'dod pa'i lta ngan/ dgag phyir phyi rol tu phung khams sogs don rang mtshan pa yod pa lta bur rgyal bas gsungs pa yod/ gnyis pa ni/ nyan thos sde gnas ma bu pa sogs kyis brjod pa med pa'i bdag dang gang zag rtag pa yin par brjod de/ de ni bden pa'i rdzas su grub pa rdul tsam yang med do// gal te grub pa yod na 'bad med thar pa thob pa'am/ yang na thar med skyon 'gyur zhes su bstan to// gsum pa ni/ de sogs sems la bdag tu grub pa'i bden par 'dod pa dang*/ bden med du 'dod pa sogs snang yang*/ snang ba tsam las rang gi grub pa rdul tsam yang med par snang ba yin no// des na de dag gi spang bya'i dbye ba dang*/ de'i gnyen po'i tshul ni/ mkhas pa rnams kyis mtha' yas par gsungs pa bzhin no// gsum pa spang gnyen gyi rtsa ba bstan pa la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa/ chos sgo'i grangs rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ bla med kyi rgyun las spangs gnyen bstan pa'i dus/ 'dir ni yul snang sems gsum sogs thams cad lus 'di la brten cing*/

lus de yang rtsa rlung thig le'i nges pa yis/ sbyang gzhi sbyong byed sogs spang gnyen so sor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ de dag las khyad par rdo rje'i lus ldan pa'i/ skyes bu gcig gi lo brgya'i bar rgyu ba'i ye shes kyi rlung ji snyed pa rnams/ bsdoms na bye ba bdun cu bdun// sa ya bdun dang 'bum phrag drug yod pas sbyang gzhi'i grangs sbyong ba'i/ chos sgo de dang mnyam pa yod pa yin la/ chos sgo brgyad khri bzhi stong du bzhag pa ni/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed rags rim du bgrangs pa'i grangs yin/ bzhi pa bye brag tu gnyen po rgyud sde'i nges pa mdor bstan pa la gnyis/ spyir bstan pa dang*/ so sor bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de la ye shes rlung ji snyed/ rgyu ba bsdoms pa'i grangs de snyed dang ldan pa de rnams/ myang 'das pa'i lam ldan pa yi thabs kyi zin na/ gnyen po'i mchog ste bla med rgyud rnams su/ sbyang gzhi rlung grangs gong ltar dang mnyam par/ sbyong byed kyi rgyud kyang de snyed du gsungs pa yod do// gnyis pa ni/ de phyir lo brgya'i ye shes rlung*// bsdoms pas lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi// lo gsum la zhag ni stong brgyad cu yod pa/ de yang lo gsum ni sku gsung thugs su dbye bas/ sbyang gzhi lo gsum la/ sbyong byed sku gsung thugs kyi rgyud gsum gsung ste/ lo gsum la lho byang gi bgrod pa drug gi dbang gis rigs drug gi rgyud drug du bshad la/ lo rer zla ba bcu gnyis re ste/ zla ba'i dbye ba'i rigs rnams ni// sum cu so drug rgyud du bshad la/ zla ba de rnams kyang g.yas g.yon thabs dang shes rab kyi dbang gis/ phyogs gnyis gnyis su dbye bas/ zla ba'i phyogs don gnyis su 'gyur ba de sbyong byed thabs dang shes rab rgyud rtsa rgyud bdun cu rtsa gnyis yod// 'di ni bde mchog mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho ru/

gtso bo'i phyag bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi grangs dag par gsungs pa yin no// lnga pa rgyas par bshad pa la gsum/ lo gsum gyi chu tshod dang sbyar te bshad pa/ zhag grangs dang sbyar te bshad nas rgyas bshad kha 'phangs pa/ de dag gi don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ a sogs a i ṛ l̥ u ste rtsa ba lnga/ a e ar o al te yon ten lnga/ ha ya ra wa la ste rkyen lnga ste thub tu bco lnga dang*/ de steng ring po bco lnga bsdom pa'i sum cu'i steng*/ thig le dang*/ tsheg drag dang*/ gri gug dang*/ dbyug pa dang*/ thang gshol lta bu ste/ rtsa ba'i dbyangs gzugs gzhan tu gyur pa brjod med kyi yi ge lnga dang*/ oṃ bsnan pas dbyangs ni sum cu drug ka kha ga gha nga sogs sde tshan lnga'i steng*/ sa tha ṣa sha ྈྐ ha ya wa ra la k+ṣaḥ 'di rnams bsnan pas gsal byed grangs kyang de dang mnyam mo// de rnams brjod bya'i don/ rjod byed yi ge'i gtso bor gsungs shing*/ de re re'ang rgyud phran sum cu ste/ dper na/ ka ki kṛ ku kli ste rtsa ba'i dbyangs lnga/ ka ke ka ra ko kal te yon tan gyis bsgyur ba lnga/ ྐྷ kla ka ra kla kh+la te rkyen gyur lnga/ 'di rnams ni ring por bsgyur bas sum cu 'byung zhing*/ kha sogs gsal byed so drug po kun la sbyar bas dbyangs yig dgu brgya yod pa de/ de thabs shes kyis phye bas chig stong brgyad brgya/ dus sbyor gcig gi rlung grangs dang sbyar ba'i yi ge stong dang brgyad brgya yin par bshad/ de bzhin/ zhag gcig la rgyu ba'i rlung nyi khri chig stong brgyad brgya yod pa rnams kyang*/ bshad ma thag pa'i yi ge chig stong brgyad brgya rnams la/ bsgyur byed oṃ a āḥbasgyur ba'i rtsa ba'i dbyangs drug la/ thung ring du phye ba'i bcu gnyis kyis bsgyur bas/ yig grangs nyi khri chig stong drug brgya yi// rgyud kyi yan lag ldan phyir lo gcig gi chu tshod dang*/ nang du zhag gcig gi dbugs grangs mnyam pa ste/

de bzhin/ lo gsum gyi ye shes kyi rlung gis grangs drug khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya po rnams kyang*/ sbyong byed yi ge gong gi nyi khri chig stong drug brgya/ de rnams la sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas/ thig le bar pa'i ring po tshes drag shin tu ring po gri gug gi shin tu thung ngu ste/ de gsum nang gses kyi dbye bas thung ring shin tu ring po rnams so sor sbyar bas/ yi ge drug khri bzhi stong brgyad brgya 'byung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ de bzhin gsal byed sum cu la dbyangs thung ngu drug gis bsgyur bas brgya dang brgyad cu/ de dbyangs ring po drug gis bsgyur bas brgya dang brgyad cu ste/ bsdoms pas sum brgya drug cu rtsa ba'i dbyangs/ lo gcig gi zhag sum brgya drug cu la 'char ba'i yi ge'o// nyin mtshan dbyangs kyang sum cu sum cu bsdoms pas drug cu ste/ rgyu mtshan de phyir dbugs rgyu ba'i dbugs nyi khri chig stong gi grangs kyi dbyangs nyi khri chig stong zhag gcig la rdzogs pa dang*/ phyir lo gcig la chu tshod nyi khri chig stong las/ dbyangs grangs de snyed mthun phyir/ gsal byed kyang phyi nang gnyis su dbyangs de dang mtshungs pa nyi khri chig stong drug brgya re yin la/ zhib tu dbyangs 'char nang du ltos shig gsum pa ni/ de ltar ni bla na med pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs kyi sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed kyi rnam par dbye ba mdor bsdus par bstan pa yin no// drug pa de nyid rgyud kyi lha thams cad dang sbyar ba la gnyis/ ye shes kyi rlung la sbyar ba dang*/ rtsa khams la sbyar ba'o// dang po la lnga/ dus 'khor gyi lha dang sbyar ba/ sdom pa che chung gi lha dang sbyar ba thabs rgyud kyi lha dang sbyar ba/ rgyud gzhan dang sbyar ba/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ de ltar rgyud sde'i rnam dbye bshad nas/ da ni lha'i grangs kyi nges pa dang sbyar na// thabs rgyud shes rab rgyud/

gnyis med rgyud kyi lha grangs dang sbyar nas// de dag gtso bor cung zad brjod do// lo gsum zhag la rtsa bdun gyis bgos na/ zhag brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi ste/ de ni dus 'khor nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi lha grangs te// gong gi cha bdun tu bgos pa'i cha bdun char gyi grangs brgya dang lnga bcu rtsa bzhi rnams yongs rdzogs/ dus 'khor nyung ngu'i rgyud kyi lha grangs brgya dang nga bzhir dag zin pa'i rjes/ gong gi lo gsum gyi zhag rnams cha bdun du bgos pa'i lhag ma gnyis 'byung bas/ de ni thabs shes gtso bo yab yum gyi bdag nyid du dag par gsungs so// gnyis pa ni/ sbyang gzhi lo gsum gyi zla ba cha ni zhag bco lnga ste/ tshul des la gsum la zla ba sum cu so drug yod pa/ de yar mar gyi cha gnyis su phye bas/ grangs cha bdun cu rtsa gnyis te/ de sbyong byed ni/ bdag po dang 'khrig pa ste/ gtso bo yab yum sbyor ba dang bcas rnal 'byor ma'i/ yab rnams bcas sdom pas bde mchog sdom pa chen po nges brjod 'bum pa'i rgyud kyi lha bdun cu rtsa gnyis ru bshad/ de rnams rigs bsdus na dpa' mo sum cu bdun po rnams la/ thabs sam yab gcig dang bcas lus la gnas par gsungs pa/ sdom chung rtsa rgyud bsdus pa'i lha grangs so// gsum pa ni/ zla ba phyed gsum gyi zhag de dag khyad par thabs kyi rgyud kyi lha yi spyad gzhi yin pas/ phyogs gsum gyi zhag zhe lnga po der/ dus sbyor rgyu ba bcu gnyis kyis// dbye ba zhag gi dus sbyor bsgyur bas lnga brgya bzhi bcu ni sbyang gzhi yin/ de la sbyong byed sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i ni/ dkyil 'khor rnam pa gsum la lha zhe dgu'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ de bzhin zhe lnga zhe gsum ste/ bsdoms pas lha grangs brgya dang sum cu so bdun rnams so sor thabs shes zung gis dbye ba rnams kyis so// lha nyis brgya bdun cu rtsa bzhi yin/ de'i lhag mar ni dpal ldan 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor rnam drug gi lha grangs nyis brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi ste/

lha dgu dang lha bcu gsum pa dang*/ bcu dgu pa dang*/ nyer lnga pa dang*/ so gnyis pa dang*/ so bzhi pa rnams bsdoms pas brgya dang so gnyis ste/ de rnams so sor thabs dang shes rab dbye ba yis/ nyis brgya drug cu rtsa bzhi'o// dkyil 'khor snga phyi'i lha bsdoms pa lnga brgya dang so brgyad yin/ de'i steng du rigs bdag mtshon phyir thabs shes rtsa ba gtso bo yab yum dang bcas sbyang gzhi lnga brgya bzhi bcu/ de'i grangs mnyam gyi sbyong byed lha grangs lnga brgya bzhi bcu rnams so// bzhi pa rgyud gzhan dang sbyar ba ni/ de rnams las gzhan yang sangs rgyas thod pa rdo rje bdud rtsi dang*/ dgyes rdor sogs rnams ma rgyud kyi/ sdom pa'i nang du 'dus par gsungs// gshin rje gshed sogs gsang bar bsdu// ngag chos dbyings gsung dbang dus kyi 'khor lo sogs/ dpal ldan rgyu skar dkyil 'khor can rnams dus 'khor du 'du'o// rnal 'byor rgyud kun kyang pha ma rgyud kyi nang du 'dus te// bya spyod de yi yan lag yin te/ der 'du'o// lnga pa don bsdu ba ni/ de rnams ni ye shes kyi rlung la brten nas/ dkyil 'khor lha thams cad 'byung bar bshad do// gnyis pa rtsa khams la sbyar ba la/ bstan/ bshad gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rtsa khams la yang de bzhin rgyud kyi lha rnams sbyor tshul gsungs pa ni/ gnyis pa la bzhi/ dus kyi 'khor lo dang sbyar ba/ 'khor lo sdom pa dang sbyar ba/ gsang ba 'dus pa dang sbyar ba/ rgyud gzhan dang sbyar ba'o// dang po ni/ snying ga dbu ma srog rlung bcas ni dus 'khor lo/ ro rkyang zhabs kyi rang bzhin te/ snying gar khams drug ni sangs rgyas drug rtsa brgyad ni lha mo brgyad/ ye shes kyi rang snang ni sna tshogs yum du brjod/ rtsa ba yan lag rtsa bcu ni// bum pa gshang gnyis/ gci gnyis/ sha gnyis dang*/ rkang gnyis/ khu khrag dag pa gnyis bsdoms pas bcu yin te/ gtsug tor rtsa bzhi ni/

nor bu gaṇ+ḍi shid dang dud rnams so// phung po khams rnams sangs rgyas yab yum/ mi sogs drug dang yul rnams ni/ byang chub sems dpa' lha mor bcas// lag sogs las dbang drug gi khro bo drug de'i byed las drug gi khro mo drug ste/ rkang sogs las dbang khro bo khro mo bcu gnyis/ lte ba'i rtsa rnams 'jigs ma sogs/ gsung gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha mo bdun cu rtsa gnyis kyi rang bzhin yin/ rkang lag tshigs chen bcu gnyis rtsa'i 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab rnams ni/ sku yi dkyil 'khor gnas pa'i tshes lha sum brgya drug cu yin// sor tshigs rnams kyi rtsa 'dab ni klu dang gtum mo ste/ ba spu bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i rtsa khams ni dkyil 'khor gyi 'byung po bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i rang bzhin no// 'dod pa'i rtog pa so drug dang*/ mi 'dod pa'i rtog pa so drug kun// mchod pa'i lha mo so drug 'dod phyir 'dod rnams so drug dang bcas pa'o// de ltar dkyil 'khor lha rnams thabs shes kyis phye na/ stong phrag brgyad cur 'gyur zhing*/ de bzhin rtsa khams rnams kyang so sor thabs dang shes rab kyi// dbye bas stong dang brgyad cu 'byung ba'o// gnyis pa ni// dpal ldan 'khor lo sdom pa che chung gi lha dang sbyar na ni/ rtsa gtso mo gsum bdud bral bcas pa ni gtso bo yab yum gnyis dang*/ snying gar rtsa brgyad ni yum bzhi mchod pa bzhi dang brgyad/ lus kyi rtsa chen nyer bzhi yul nyer bzhi'i rnal 'byor ma// rab gtum sogs yin de na 'bab pa'i khams/ thod pa'i dum sogs dpa' bor gsungs/ khwa gdong la sogs khro bcur mtshungs ste/ rkang lag sogs drug las dbang drug 'gro ba sogs las byed pa drug bcas so// de ni sdom chung gi lha dang sbyar ba'o// rtsa'i gtso mo nyer bzhi po so sor thim dang longs spyod bdag po'i gsum gyi dbye phyir/ rtsa phran don gnyis la/ lha ni bdun cu rtsa gnyis rang bzhin no// rtsa 'khor lo bzhi'i 'dab ma brgya nyi shu pa'i grangs/

de dang mnyam pa'i lha ru rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsungs/ gsum pa ni/ dpal ldan 'dus pa bshad bya ba/ phung po sangs rgyas lnga yin te// khams bzhi reg bcas lha mo lnga// mig gnyis sa yi snying po ste// rna ba phyag na rdo rje'o// sna ni nam mkha'i snying po ste// lce la bzhugs pa 'jig rten dbang*// yid ni 'jam dpal khams rnams la// sgrib sel yin te lus la ni// kun tu bzang po nyid ces bya// rtsa rgyud byams pa nyid yin no// mkhrig ma dang bol gong ma gtogs pa'i yan lag tshigs brgyad dang kha gsang ba// khro bo bcu yi rang bzhin te// lte bar las kyi rigs skyes pa// mkhyen dang gtum sogs lha mo ni// drug cu rtsa bzhi gsungs pa yin// rdo rje dbyings phyug sogs snying gar dgu// rdo rje'i rigs su gsungs pa ste// pad+ma'i sgron ma sogs bcu drug /mgrin par pad+ma'i rigs kyi rang bzhin la// spyi bor rab tu sad la sogs// 'khor lo la rigs ldan ma sogs lha mo sum cu gnyis sogs// rgyas par rdo rje phreng bar gsungs/ bzhi pa ni/ de sogs dkyil 'khor du ma gsungs pa rnams/ rkyang pa dpa' bo gcig pa dang*/ phyogs re cha ldan pa/ gtso 'khor gnyis pa dang*/ gsum pa sogs nas mtha' yas pa'i bar gsungs pa thams cad 'dir 'dus te/ dper na dgyes rdor lha dgu ni/ snying ga'i 'khor lo rkyang pa'i sbyong byed yin pa bzhin/ dkyil 'khor thams cad lus kyi rtsa rlung gi sbyong byed du bzhag pa yin/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ de dag gi don le'u 'di dag gi brjod bya/ mdor na rtsa ni sku yin te// rlung ni gsung sngags dang yi ge'o// thig le thugs gnyis med ye shes phra mo'i rnal 'byor rdzogs rim mo// de bzhin sbyin sreg dang*/ 'khrul 'khor sogs las rnams kun// nang gi sbyong gzhi sbyong byed yin// 'dir ni phyogs tsam brjod pa'o// de bzhin phar phyin theg par gsungs pa'i sa dang lam dang gzungs/

ting 'dzin rab 'byams lha dang sngags sogs gsungs pa thams cad lus sems nang gi sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed kyi dbye ba la/ brten nas thams cad gzigs pas gsungs/ gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa las/ chos kyi sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed bstan pa ste dgu pa'o/// /de ltar sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi tshul gyis gnad bcings nas/ lam mngon tu 'gyur ba'i tshul bshad pa la gnyis/ le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan bstan pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de ltar rtsa rlung thig le gsum// sems kyi cha las snang ba ste// de phyir 'di don gnad 'ching ba// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam rim kun las khyad par 'phags/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ thun mong pa'i lam dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i lam mo// dang po la gsum/ nyan thos kyi lam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi lam/ pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam mo// dang po ni/ tshul ji ltar 'phags na/ nyan thos kyi gang zag bdag med rtogs shing rang zhi ba tsam/ de thob pa'i lam myur ba srid pa ste/ skye ba lan gsum gyis thob bar 'dod ste// rgyun zhugs nas bzung 'gor na'ang skye ba lan bdun gyi mthar yin no// de ni rang don zhi ba tsam/ gnyis pa ni/ de las rang rgyal byang chub ni/ bskal pa nyi shu nas thob cing*/ bse ru lta bus ni bskal pa brgya yis 'grub bo// gsum pa ni/ sems can thams cad phan byed pa/ byang chub sems dpa' ni bskal pa grangs med gsum/ gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i lam la gsum/ sngags lam khyad par 'phags pa bstan pa/ rgyud sde bzhi'i dus kyi khyad par bstan pa/ lam dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ de dag las khyad par 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa 'di ni thabs kyi khyad par gyis/ pha rol phyin pa'i lam de las/ gnyis pa ni/ bya spyod mtshan bcas mtshan med tshul gyi thabs mkhas tsam/ ldan yang dus tshe lo brgya pa'i dbang gi mi tshe drug cu nas sangs rgyas 'grub ste/

rnal 'byor rgyud ni phyag rgya bzhi sogs kyi thabs kyis mi tshe bcu drug nas sangs rgya ba yin/ de las thabs khyad par 'phags pa rdo rje theg pa bla na med pa tshe gcig gis/ brtson ldan nges par sangs rgyas 'grub par 'gyur ro// gsum pa lam dngos bshad pa la lnga/ tshogs lam/ sbyor lam/ mthong lam/ sgom lam/ mthar phyin pa'i lam mo/ dang po ni/ rdo rje theg pa la'ang*/ dang por dbang thob bskyed rdzogs don rnams ni/ phyin ci ma log legs shes mos pa lam byed du sgrub pa tshogs lam gsum ste/ gnyis pa ni/ de'i steng rtsa rlung thig le'i gnad shes nas/ de'i nyams myong gi ye shes rgyun chad med pa/ kun bzang spyod pa de la gnas pa'i drod kyi rtags bde gsal mi rtog sogs thob nas/ mthong lam gyi nye rgyu sbyor lam nyid la gnas pa yin/ drod thob pa de tshe/ de bogs 'don pa'i ched spros bcas/ spros med brtul zhugs spyod pa nye rgyu yis mtshams sbyar nas// sbyor lam bgrod nas mthong bar sbyor/ sbyor lam 'di yi man ngag gi mtshan gzhi ni rnam rtog so sor sdud pa dang*/ sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa/ bsam gtan bzhi ldan gyi lam gtso bor yin te/ lus dben sku rdo rje'i lam gyis rtsa yi byed pa bcings pas/ rtsa ni sbyong bar byed pa'i lam zhes kyang bshad la/ bsam gtan gyi yan lag bzhi rdzogs pa yis/ rgyu yis spyan dang*/ mngon par shes pa lnga yi rgyu thob gsungs/ sbyong ba 'dis ni rtsa dag pa sku rdo rje sprul pa'i sku yi dkyil 'khor du zhugs pa'o// gsum pa ni/ sbyor lam de thob nas rlung rnam par dag pa'i phyir srog rtsol dang 'dzin pa'i sbyor ldan pas ni/ sbyor ba de la brten nas/ thig le 'pho med du bcings pas/ mi rtog ye shes mngon tu gyur ba'i phyir/ mthong lam la ni sbyor bar byed de/ de yang rnal 'byor pas rlung sbyor la brten thig le rtag tu 'pho med du 'dzin pa'i stobs kyis ni/

rlung sems dbyer med bde chen rdo rje sems dpa' yang dag 'jug cing 'grub pas/ rlung gi rnal 'byor la brten nas/ 'bras bu rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes thob pa zhes bya'o// bzhi pa bsgom lam la gnyis/ lam gyi ngo bo dang*/ mthong sgom sogs kyi rlung 'gag lugs so// dang po ni/ mi rtog ye shes de thob nas/ nyams len gyi spyod pa ni spros med rjes thob sgyu ma lta bu dang*/ shin tu spros med kyis/ mnyam gzhag mi rtog pa'i spyod pa la brten nas/ bde ba dang*/ dkon mchog gsum dang*/ lha/ gtong ba/ tshul khrims/ phar phyin bcu ste/ rjes dran yan lag drug gi ting 'dzin du mar sbyang byas nas/ thugs rdo rje 'gyur med kyi ting 'dzin gyi ye shes la sbyor ba ni/ bdud dang*/ theg dman gyi phyogs las rnam rgyal gyis 'grub ste/ gzhan don tshogs kyi spyod dang bcas las/ sgom lam mthar phyin par grub bo// gnyis pa mthong sgom sogs kyi rlug 'gag pa'i tshul ni/ dang po sor bsam la brten nas/ rtsa 'gags pa'i stobs kyis/ dus sbyor dang po brgya phrag bco brgyad kyi/ rlung dang rtog pa lhan cig 'gag de ni 'jig rten pa yi lam tshogs sbyor gyi lam yin/ srog rtsol dang*/ 'dzin pa la brten nas/ dus sbyor gnyis pa'i rlung dang*/ rtog pa brgya phrag bco brgyad dang*/ thig le ska ba rnams lhan cig tu/ gsang bar 'gag pa mthong ba'i lam/ theg chen gyis dang po thob/ gnas skabs de yis ma rig pa 'gag pa/ de bzhin sa thob rim gyis skye shi 'gag pa sogs rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs ldog tu 'gag go /de nas rjes dran gyi stobs kyis dus sbyor gsum par/ de'i rlung dang*/ rtog pa dang*/ thig le bcas gsang 'khor de nyid du dag pa ste/ sa gnyis pa thob/ lte bar de bzhin dus sbyor bzhi pa dang lnga pa'i rlung dang*/ thig le srog gsum dag nas/ sa gsum pa dang*/ bzhi pa thob/ dus sbyor drug dang bdun pa'i rlung thig srog gsum snying gar dag ste/

sa lnga pa dang*/ drug pa thob/ dus sbyor brgyad dang dgu pa ni rlung thig srog gsum mgrin pa la dag ste/ sa bdun pa dang*/ brgyad pa thob/ dus sbyor bcu dang bcu gcig pa'i rlung thig srog gsum spyi bor dag pas/ sa dgu pa dang*/ bcu pa thob par bshad/ lnga pa mthar phyin mi slob pa'i lam bshad pa ni// de nas gtsug tor dus sbyor bcu gnyis pa'i rlung thig srog gsum 'gag pas/ nyon mongs kyi rlung thig thams cad/ ye shes kyi rlung thig tu dag pa/ de tshe sangs rgyas thob par gsungs/ rten 'brel bcu gnyis lugs zlog tu 'gag pa dang*/ mas brtan dga' ba bcu drug yongs su rdzogs pa yin la/ stong nyid bcu drug dang*/ snying rje bcu drug dang*/ ye shes kyi ngo bo dbyer med mthar phyin gyis 'grub bo// lo brgya'i ye shes kyi rlung bsdoms pas lo gsum zla phyed gsum gyi rang bzhin dag pas ye shes sku nyid 'grub pa yin no// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar sbyang bya rtsa rlung thig le rnam gsum ji lta bu'i tshul gyis/ sbyor drug ste/ rtsa dag par byed pa sor bsam gnyis/ rlung dag par byed pa srog 'dzin gnyis/ thig le dag byed rjes ting gnyis te de rnams kyis rtsa rlung thig gsum gyi byed pa bcings pa'i lam mthar phyin 'bras bu'i sangs rgyas pa yin/ de lta bu'i tshul sa lam dang sbyar ba'i dbye ba dpag med 'dir ma brjod/ sbyang 'bras sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i ye shes rim pa thams cad kyang*// snga ma'i sbyang gzhi rtsa thig rlung gsum dang mtshungs 'bras bu sku gsum mam/ rdo rje gsum thob bo// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni// zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa las/ lam dang rim pa sbyar ba ste bcu pa'o/// /de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pa dang*/ lam dang*/ sa yi rnam bzhag rgyas par bstan nas/ de dag de kho na nyid kyi dbyings las ma 'das pa'i phyir sdud pa'i rim pa 'chad pa la gnyis/

le'u'i gzhung dang*/ mtshan no// dang po la gsum/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de nas rtsa rlung thig le rnams/ bsdud pa'i rim pa gsal bshad bya/ ye shes rnal 'byor grub pa ni/ dang po skye ba'i tshul dang mthun par/ mthar rim gyis sdud pa'i nges pa med de sems la dbang thob phyir/ gnyis pa rgyas par bshad pa la bzhi/ rtsa sdud pa'i rim pa/ rlung gi 'chi ltas/ thig le 'gag pa'i rim pa/ zhar la gang du 'pho ba'i nges pa'o// dang po la gsum/ rtsa phal pa sdud pa'i tshul/ 'khor lo bco brgyad sdud pa'i rim pa/ rtsa nyer bzhi po sdud pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ tha ma la rdo rje'i lus 'di la/ mngal du bdun phrag bzhi'i rjes dbu ma chags pa nas bzung*/ phyir btsas nas zla ba bzhi bar gyi lo gcig tu 'gyur ro// skyes nas lo gcig bar du ni/ lus kyi rtsa thams cad skyed par byed pa ste/ lo gcig po 'das pa de nas zhag re rtsa gnyis gnyis/ nus pa bskams par bshad pa yin te/ de ltar na/ lo brgya lon tshe rtsa stong phrag bdun cu gnyis// bsdud pa rags pa'i rim pa'o// zhib par lo ni dgu bcu drug dang*/ zla ba phyed dang bcu gcig bar du/ phra ba'i rtsa kun sdud pa ste/ de'i bar du rtsa drug khri dgu stong bdun brgya dang*/ lnga bcur bsdud gyur lo grangs de'i rigs la/ nyin re rtsa gnyis re sdud do// gnyis pa 'khor lo bco brgyad sdud pa'i rim pa la gsum/ nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcu spyi'i don dang*/ 'khor lo rnams sdud tshul rgyas par bshad pa/ de'i don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ rtsa phra mo bsdus zin pa de 'og lo gsum phyogs gsum la/ rtsa 'khor lnga dang*/ dbu ma'i yar mar gyi rtsa 'khor gyi rtsa tshigs chen/ tshigs phran gyi 'khor lo'i rtsa ba'i rtsa nyer bzhi sogs rtsa chen/ nyis stong nyis brgya lnga bcu dag go /gnyis pa ni/ tshigs chen bcu gnyis kyi sum brgya drug cu'i rtsa/

zhag ni gsum gsum rtsa re re skams/ sor tshig rtsa yang de dang mnyam ste/ 'dra bar bsdud do// lte ba'i drug cu rtsa khyim ni/ dus sbyor gyi rlung gi nus dang mtshungs par lo gsum gyi nang du bsdud/ spyi bo zhag ni phyogs gcig zhag bco lnga la bsdud ste/ mgrin par rtsa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdud de phyogs gnyis bsdoms bzla gcig nang bsdud cing*/ gsang rtsa mgrin pa dang mtshungs pas logs su mi bgrang ngo*// snying ga'i rtsa brgyad zhag brgyad du bsdud de/ de ni gong gi zla ba gcig de'i nang gi zhag brgyad du rtsa rnams 'dor/ gsum pa ni/ de ltar 'khor lo lnga yi rtsa brgya drug cu/ gtsug tor rtsa bzhi dang bcas 'khor lo de rnams kyi dbu ma'i cha ma gtogs pa/ gzhan rnams zla gcig gi nang du bsdud pa yin no// gsum pa rtsa nyi shu rtsa bzhi sdud tshul la gnyis/ dngos dang*/ thun mong gi bsdu ba'o/ dang po ni/ rtsa ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi po/ rtsa chen nyer bzhi po re rer yang*/ rtsa drug cu drug cu re yod pa rnams dbu ma'i cha ste gtso bo nyer bzhi la thim dang*/ longs spyod bdag po'i dbye bas rtsa don gnyis po ma gtogs/ gzhan rnams ni/ lte ba'i 'khor lo dang mtshungs lo gsum bsdud/ rtsa chen nyer bzhi la thim dang longs spyod bdag po yi/ sgo nas gyes pa'i rtsa ba bdun cu rtsa gnyis po'ang*/ phyogs gsum nang du bsdud pa yin/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar dbu ma'i cha ma gtogs pa'i 'khor lo rtsa chen rnams/ bskams te rlung rnams mi rgyu ba// de nas zhag gcig nas 'pho'o// gnyis pa rlung gi 'chi ltas la lnga/ spyir rlung bcu sdud pa'i rim pa/ dbu ma'i dus dang dus ma yin par 'chi ltas/ g.yas pa nyi ma'i 'chi ltas/ g.yon pa zla ba'i 'chi ltas/ de dag gi nges pa bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rlung gi bsdud rim pa stan pa ni// rlung bcu mngal du zla bcu nas rdzogs te// skyes nas lo brgya yi dus su 'chi ba'i nges pa gang gi dbang du btang na/

lo ni bcu bcu rim pa ltar/ nor rgyal gyi rlung gi nus pa lha sbyin la bsdud pa sogs rim par 'grel te/ rtsangs rus sbal/ klu dang khyab byed mnyam gnas dang*/ gyen rgyu thur sel srog rlung gi /stobs rnams gcig la gcig thim par/ 'gyur zhes rdo rje phreng bar gsungs/ gnyis pa dbu ma'i dus dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ltas la gnyis/ 'phel ba'i rim pa dang*/ lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi 'chi ltas dngos so// dang po la bzhi/ khungs smos pas bstan pa/ rlung bcu ma nyams pa'i dus/ 'chi ltas 'phel tshul rgyas bshad/ 'pho ba'i nges pa dngos so// dang po ni/ rlung bsdud cing*/ dbu ma'i 'chi ltas 'phel tshul/ rgyas par dus kyi 'khor lo las/ gnyis pa ni/ skyes bu tshe lo brgya pa gang*/ mngal du rtsa dbu ma chags pa nas bzung*/ skyes nas zla gsum bar/ lo gcig tu brtsi ba'i bar rlung rnams kyi/ dus sbyor bcu gnyis kyi rlung gi grangs kun mang nyung med par mnyam par rgyu'o// gsum pa ni/ de ltar lo gcig po de'i rjes/ nyi ma lho byang gi bgrod pa gnyis song rjes kyi de nas bgrod pa gsum pa'i zla ba drug gi ring la/ nyin rer rgyu ba re re 'phel nas mkha' yi rlung gi mtshams su ru rlung gcig rgyu ba 'phel ste/ dus sbyor gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i sum drug cu rtsa gcig rgyu'o// bgrod pa bzhi par 'phel 'grib med/ rtsa dbu ma chags pa nas brtsi ba'i lo gnyis pa yin kyang*/ btsas nas 'chi ltas 'phel ba'i lo dang po yin/ lo gnyis pa la bgrod pa lnga par gong ltar/ sa rlung du rgyu ba gcig dang*/ g.yas kyi thob skal du gcig ste/ g.yas par rlung gnyis 'phel ba yin// de ltar re mos bgrod pa re re 'phel pa dang*/ bgrod pa re re mi 'phel ba bsdoms pas phyogs gsum gyis mchong ba'i lo bdun na/ chu srang gcig rlung rgyu ba 'phel bar 'gyur de nas ni// g.yon dang g.yas su rim pa bzhin/

res mos kyi lo re chu srang re re 'phel/ rim par 'phel bas lo drug cu rtsa bdun lon nas ni/ gong du 'phel rnams bsdoms pa chu tshod gcig gi rlung rgyu bar 'gyur ste/ sna g.yon nas nam mkha'i rlung bzhi brgya dang nyi shu rgyu/ de rjes nas bgrod pa re re bzhin/ chu tshod re re'i rlung gi rgyu ba 'phel ste/ lo ni sum cur bgrod pa re rer dbyu gu re re 'phel ba ni/ g.yon dang g.yas pa rim pa bzhin/ bgrod pa gcig la g.yon nas// mkha' rlung chu tshod gcig 'phel ba dang*/ de'i 'og gi bgrod pa gcig la g.yas nas sa rlung gnas der 'byung ba sogs/ 'grod ba re rer g.yas g.yon res mos kyi 'phel ba'i mthar lo dgu bcu go drug dang*/ zla ba ni/ phyed bcu gcig lon nas g.yon tu ni/ nam mkha'i rang bzhin zhag gcig rgyu ba/ bzhi pa 'pho ba'i nges pa dngos ni/ de nas lo gsum phyogs gsum na/ 'pho bar 'gyur ba sngon rjes bsdoms pas lo brgya rdzogs pa yin no// gnyis pa lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi 'chi ltas dngos la gsum/ mtshams sbyar dang bcas pa'i mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad don bsdu'o// dang po ni/ de ltar lo go bdun par 'chi ltas 'phel tshul bshad nas/ da ni lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi nang du/ dbu ma'i 'chi ltas 'phel tshul gyi nges pa ni/ lo gsum phyogs gsum la/ zla ba so bdun dang phyed bcas la/ zhag gi 'phel tshul ni/ zla ba so bdun phyed bcas la/ zhag stong dang*/ brgya/ nyer lnga yod pa las/ de rnams kyi ring la 'chi ltas kyi rlung rim par 'phel ste/ mthar 'chi ltas kyi rlung zhag gi grangs su longs par 'phel bar 'gyur ba'i zhag grangs so gsum yin te/ de las dang po zla ba so bzhi dang zla phyed bcas kyi bar zhag grangs la/ 'chi ltas 'phel bas rim par zhag re re 'phel bar 'gyur ste/ mthar zhag sum cu'i bar du longs par 'gyur ste/ ji ltar 'phel tshul ni/ zla ba so bzhi phyed bcas kyi bar/

zla ba drug rer 'chi zhag lnga re 'phel bas/ zla ba sum cu nas 'chi zhag nyer lnga dang*/ de'i mthar zla ba phyed lnga la rgyu ba'i rlung gis/ 'chi zhag lnga 'phel ste/ bsdom pa zla ba phyed so lngar 'chi zhag sum cu 'byung ngo*/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'chi ltas 'phel bas khyim bcu gnyis stongs pa'i tshul dang*/ khyim stongs nas tshor ba gsum gyi rlung zad de 'pho ba'i nges pa'o// dang po ni/ 'chi ltas zhag sum cur 'phel tshul khyim bcu gnyis kyi rtsa dang sbyar na// lte ba'i khyim bcu gnyis kyi rtsa drug las/ g.yon du khyim drug gi nam mkha' nas rlung me chu sa rnams kyi rlung gi rgyu ba rim pa ltar 'phel bas/ zhag gsum gsum gyis ni nang nas rtsa drug drug skams shing gcig dang*/ gsum sogs mi mnyam rgyu bas 'chi ltas zhag bco lnga 'phel bas/ khyim drug gi 'pho chung gi rtsa sum cu stong la/ de bzhin g.yas khyim drug nas sa chu me rlung nam mkha'i rlung rnams gnyis bzhi sogs mnyam pa ru/ gnyis dang bzhi la sogs sa rlung nas/ gong bshad ltar chu me rlung mkha'i rlung rnams bsdud rim gyis zhag drug re la rtsa gsum re 'gag cing skams pas/ 'chi zhag bco lnga 'phel nas khyim drug gi 'pho chung gi rtsa sum cu stongs par 'gyur la/ gnyis pa ni/ de ltar zla ba phyed so lngar 'chi ltas zhag sum cu 'phel nas de rjes zla ba gsum po la/ ji ltar 'phel na/ zla ba gsum gyi dang por g.yon nas zhag gcig gi 'chi ltas kyi rlung 'phel nas/ zhag sum cu la zhag so gcig gi rlung rgyu ba na zla ba'i rlung thams cad zad pas na snying stobs zad de/ g.yon khyim drug gi rtsa rnams stong ngo*// de'i gnyis pa'i zla bar g.yas nas 'chi ltas kyi rlung 'phel bas/ zla gcig gi zhag sum cu la zhag du 'phel zhing rgyus te/ nyi ma'i rlung thams cad zad pas na rdul zad byed de/ g.yas khyim drug stong ngo*// de ltar rtsa ba'i rtsa 'pho chen gyi rtsa zla rer drug drug 'gag ste skams pa/

de rjes zla ba gsum par/ sna gnyis nas rgyu ba'i 'chi ltas kyi rlung 'phel nas/ zla ba gcig gi zhag sum cu la/ zhag so gsum gyi rlung rgyus pas/ rlung kun dang*/ sgra gcan gyi khams zad nas/ spyi mgrin snying gsang gi rtsa rnams skams shing*/ phung khams skye mched rnams yul la ji ltar sbyor ba med par/ mun pa chen po zad byed rlung ste/ srog rlung nyi khri chig stong rnams zhag gcig la rgyu zhing*/ de nas pha rol du 'pho bar byed do// gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de ltar lo gsum phyogs gsum gyi zhag stong dang*/ brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga po la/ so gnyis phyed bcas kyis bgos pa'i thob nor gyis/ dbu ma'i 'chi ltas nges pa yin/ gsum pa g.yas pa nyi ma'i 'chi ltas la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do// dang po ni/ de ltar dus kyi 'chi ba dbu ma'i 'chi ltas bstan nas/ de nas dus min nyi ma yi// 'chi ltas nges pa 'di lta ste// gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'chi bslu nus pa'i 'chi ltas 'phel tshul dang*/ mi nus pa'i 'chi ltas 'phel tshul lo// dang po ni/ g.yas su zhag gcig rgyu ba ni// lo gsum phyogs gsum na 'chi'o// 'chi ltas lo gcig la 'phel nas zhag lnga rgyu lo gsum tshe yin te/ glang khyim gyi rtsa lnga 'gags pa'i rtags so// yang lo gcig 'phel nas bcu rgyu gnyis yod tshe yod cing*/ 'khrig khyim gyi rtsa lnga 'gags pa'i rtags yin no// de lo gcig la 'phel nas zhag bco lnga rgyu na lo gcig tshe yod la/ karka ṭa'i khyim gyi rtsa lnga 'gags pa'i rtags yin/ de nas zla rer zhag re 'phel ste/ zla ba drug na sna g.yas su zhag nyi shu rgyu na zla drug 'tsho zhing*/ seng ge'i khyim gyi rtsa lnga 'gags/ zla ba gsum du zhag nyer lnga rgyu na zla ba gsum 'tsho zhing*/ bu mo'i khyim gyi rtsa lnga 'gags so// de rnams lo zlar 'chi ltas kyi zhag lnga tshan tu 'phel ba ste/ khyim lnga stong par 'gyur pa yin/

de nas zhag re rer 'chi ltas kyi zhag re res khyim re 'dor/ sna g.yas nas nyer drug rgyu bas zla gnyis tshe yod de srang khyim gyi rtsa lnga stongs/ sna g.yon nas nyer bdun rgyu bas zla gcig thub cing*/ sdig khyim gyi rtsa lnga stongs/ gnyis pa 'chi ba bslu mi nus pa'i 'chi ltas 'phel nas 'pho bar bstan pa ni/ khyim bdun 'das nas rgyas pa ste// de nas sus kyang bzlog mi nus shing*/ zhag ni so gsum na 'chi ba ste/ 'chi ltas zhag bco lnga par 'phel bas gzhu khyim gyi rtsa lnga stongs pa sogs rim par zhag rnams 'phel bas bcu dang lnga dang gsum/ khyim bzhi/ gzhu/ chu srin/ bum pa/ nya bcas khyim so so'i rtsa lnga lnga stongs te/ zhag gsum du rgyus pas khyim bzhi 'dor byed bsdoms khyim bcu gcig stongs nas/ nyi ma'i rlung gi stobs zad de 'og tu/ zla ba zad par byed pa'i rlung*/ g.yon nas zhag gnyis rgyu bar byed// khyim ni bcu gnyis pa sdig khyim gyi rtsa lnga yang stongs/ de nas dbu mar sgra gcan khams srog rlung zhag gcig rgyu nas/ rnam shes pha rol 'gro bar byed/ bzhi pa g.yon na zla ba'i 'chi ltas la gnyis/ mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad do/ dang po ni/ g.yon gyi zla ba'i rtags bshad pa/ gnyis pa ni/ g.yon nas zhag gcig rgyu ba ni/ lo gsum phyogs gsum nang 'pho'i rtags/ de nas zla ba drug pa'i bar zla ba gnyis re la/ 'chi ltas zhag re 'phel bas zla ba drug pa g.yon nas zhag gsum rgyu na/ de nas zla ba sum cu'i tshe/ yod cing*/ lte ba'i khyim gcig ste/ lug khyim gyi rtsa lnga skam shing stongs pa yin/ de nas zla ba re re bzhin/ 'chi ltas zhag ni re re 'phel bas/ zla ba gsum gyis khyim gyi rtsa lnga re 'dor/ g.yon rlung zhag grangs 'phel ba bzhin/ 'tsho ba'i zla ba 'bri ba yin// de bzhin tu 'chi ltas kyi zhag rim gyis khyim rnams stongs shing 'tsho ba'i zla ba nyung du 'gro/ gang tshe zhag ni so gsum rgyu// nges par zhag ni gsum na 'chi// khyim ni bcu gnyis stongs pa yin// de nas zhag gnyis nyi ma'i khams kyi rlung rnams/

zad par byed pas g.yas nas rgyu// de 'og dbu ma sgra gcan khams srog rlung zhag gcig rgyus nas/ rnam shes gzhan du 'pho ba yin// lnga pa de dag gi nges pa bstan pa la gsum/ nyi zla'i 'chi ltas so sor 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ dus dang dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ltas nges pa'i rgyu mtshan/ glo bur du rtsa rlung 'gag pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ de ltar nyi zla'i rtags 'byung ba yi tshul ni/ lte ba'i mi mnyam pa lug sogs kyi/ khyim nas thog mar 'chi ltas kyi rlung sna g.yon nas rgyu ba/ zla ba'i 'chi ltas gtso bo ste/ glang sogs mnyam pa'i khyim rnams la// rlung sna g.yas nas 'byung nyi ma gtso bo yin no// gnyis pa ni/ snga ma lo brgya thub pa nas// skyes nas zhag gcig las mi thub pa'i bar gyi tshe ring thung ni rlung rgyu bas byed la/ rlung de rtsa kun nas rgyu na 'tsho ba dang*/ dbu ma rkyang pa nas/ rgyu na zhag gcig las mi 'tsho ba ste/ tshe ring thung dag gis rtsa mang nyung gi gnas la rlung rgyu ba'i rim par gsungs pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ gang tshe dug dang mtshon dang nad// drang pos rtsa rnams gcig char 'gag /rgyu des glo bur 'chi bar gsungs la/ de ni ji ltar lte ba dus sbyor 'byung ba zla nyi sgra gcan bcas kyi rlung cig char du 'gag pa bzhin/ snying gar thun brgyad dang*/ mgrin par rgyu skar/ spyi bor zla rkang gi rim pas tshigs chen tshigs phran gyi 'khor lo gzhan kyang mtshungs/ 'khor lo lnga dang tshigs kun la/ 'byung lnga'i rlung re re la/ dbyu gu bcu gnyis bcu gnyis ni/ bskyed sdug kyi rim pa yod pa de rnams kyi rlung*/ zhag drug rgyus nas zad pa yin no// de rnams kyis rlung gi 'chi ltas bstan pa'o// gsum pa thig le 'gag pa'i rim pa la gnyis/ lo dgu bcu go bdun gyis stobs 'dor ba dang*/ lo gsum gyi 'chi ltas dngos so// dang po la gsum/ rten rtsa rlung sogs 'grib byed pa'i tshul dang*/

brten pa khams 'phel 'grib byed tshul/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ de nas thig le 'gag pa'i tshul ni/ lo gcig nang gi khams 'phel nas// rlung gi nus pa phyir shor bas/ zhag re la dkar nag rtsa 'grib pa snga ma rtsa dang rlung gi skabs bzhin no// gnyis pa ni/ de nas skyes par lo ni bcu drug dang*/ bud med la lo bcu gnyis bar// thig le 'phel te de nas ni// dkar ba 'grib cing 'dor bar byed// de nas khrag ni lo bcu drug par 'phel pa yin// so gnyis nas ni de yang 'dor// de nas rlung dang me dang chu sa'i khams kyi stobs rnams/ lo bcu drug re nas re re 'grib pa ste/ gsum pa don bsdu ba ni/ rags par rtsis na/ lo dgu bcu go bdun pa/ khams kyi stobs kun 'dor na lo gsum na/ 'chi ba'i nges pa shes par bya/ dgu bcu go bdun pa 'di 'ang dbugs grangs kyi lo yin gyi/ phyi rol gyi lo ni ma yin no// gnyis pa lo gsum gyi 'chi ltas dngos bshad pa ni/ nges par 'chi ba'i ltas ni/ lte ba'i rtsa gcig chad pa dang*/ sna bug g.yas g.yon gang rung gi zhag gcig dus sbyor nyams pa dus mnyam/ de'i rtags gci ba 'gyur ba na zla drug 'tsho ste/ de bzhin yon tan 'dzin pa'i rtsa rnams rim par nyams nas// rna ba'i rlung sgra dor zhag drug ste/ lce yi ro dor zhag lnga yin// mig dbus ri mo zhag bzhi'i tshe// sna zhom dri dor zhag gsum mo// reg bya dor ba zhag gnyis yin// chos khams khu ba nyams pa ni// zhag gcig nas ni pha rol 'gro ste/ pha las thob pa'i dkar cha 'og tu ltung ba ste/ ma las thob pa'i dmar cha gyen du 'gro ba yin la/ dkar dmar gnyis snying gar sbyar ba'i dbus su gzhi la phung khams skye mched thams cad bsdus nas/ gzhi'i 'od gsal la gnas shing myong ngo*/ rlung rnams sna sgo nas 'gro ste/ bzhi pa zhar la gang du 'pho ba'i nges pa bar do 'byung tshul dang bcas pa ni/ de nas phal pa rnams gzhi'i 'od gsal ngo ma shes te/

rnam shes kun gzhi ni/ srid pa pha rol du 'gro ste/ de yang tshangs bu gnas song na ni gzugs med de/ thig le las ni ste/ smin mtshams kyi dbyings rnam par dag pa'i sgron me'i thig ler 'phos na lha mo che ste/ gzugs khams bcu drug /lte ba las ni 'dod khams lha rigs drug mig las 'dod pa'i mi dbang po ste/ rgyal po'i rigs/ sna las gnod sbyin gnas su skye// rna ba las ni grub pa'i lha'i rig 'dzin/ srid pa'i sgo ni khu ba'i lam las yi dwags bshad// chu yi lam las dud 'gror 'gyur// 'og sgo las ni dmyal ba brgyad/ rnam shes phyir 'phos ma thag de nas bar do 'byung ba yin/ gsum pa mjug bsdu ba ni/ de lta bu'i sdud rim de rnams mdor bsdu na// snang ba thim pa sprul sku/ mched pa thim pa longs sku/ kun gzhi 'od gsal du zhugs shing thob pa thim pa chos sku ste/ gsum thim pa ni/ sku gsum rang bzhin nyid yin te/ de ltar ma shes/ sems 'od gsal ba la snang ba dang de sgrib byed la mun pa yi/ sems 'od gsal 'gyur med dang*/ sgrib pa'i mun pa glo bur ba 'bras rung du yod par ma shes shing*/ tshogs drug yul bcas bden med stong pa dang*/ kun gzhi'i rnam shes yid bcas grub pa med pa'i stong pa chen po rnams kyi don// ma rtogs 'khor pa'i 'khor lor 'khyams shing*/ dri ma de nyid lam gyis sbyangs pa na rim gyis dag pa'i mthar/ ye shes mngon tu gyur te/ shin tu rnam par dag pa sangs rgyas kyi sa thob pas rnam par grol ba'i mya ngan las 'das pa chen po thob bo// gnyis pa le'u'i mtshan ni/ zab mo nang gi don snang bar byed pa las/ rtsa rlung thig le bsdus pa'i tshul bstan pa ste bcu gcig pa'o/// /de ltar gzhi lam 'bras bu'i sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras sogs rgyas par bstan nas/ spyi don gsum pa de nyid bsdud pa'i sgo nas sngags kyi sde snod kyi tshul bshad pa dang*/

lung gi chos rnams kyang der bsdu ba'i tshul dang*/ bsngo ba dang bcas te bstan bcos mthar phyin pa'i dgos pa brjod pa la gsum/ mjug bsdu ba'i sgo nas rig 'dzin gyi sde snod bshad pa dang*/ phrin las la bsngags shing bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa/ rtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul lo// dang po la lnga/ spyi'i don bsdu ba/ sde snod gsum so so dang sbyar ba/ de dag shes pa'i dgos pa spyi dang khyad par/ 'bras bu'i rang bzhin bsdu ba/ 'di gang las rnyed pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyal bas rgyud sde bzhi rnams thams cad du/ sems las don gzhan pa med kyang*// phyi rol thun mong snang ba dang*/ phung khams skye mched/ nang du rtsa rlung thig le dang*/ gzhan du kun brtags dkyil 'khor gyi lha dang sngags sogs gsungs pa rnams ni/ dri ma dang bcas pa'i rtog pa thams cad sbyong byed du gsungs pa dang*/ sbyangs 'bras dri med ye shes rnams ji lta ji snyed kyi mkhyen pa gnyis thob par gsungs te/ de lta bu'i chos thams cad don dam gyi gnas lugs de kho na nyid dang*/ kun rdzob ming tshig yi ge sogs dang*/ spros bcas 'jig rten dang*/ de 'das pa theg pa che chung gi sa dang*/ lam sogs dang*/ spros med don dam gyi gnas lugs gcer mthong du gsungs pa la/ de rnams kyi gsungs tshul lo// gnyis pa la gsum/ mngon pa/ mdo sde/ 'dul ba dang sbyar ba'o/ dang po la gsum/ phyi dang*/ nang gi mngon pa/ de dpe don sbyar bshad don bsdu dang bcas pa'o// dang po ni/ phyi rol du 'di ltar snang ba'i 'jig rten la sogs pa kun tshangs pa dbang phyug sgam po/ phywa sogs byed po gzhan med pa/ de thams cad rten cing 'brel bar snang ba sems rang gi snang ba ste/ phyi rol tu grub pa med kyang*/ rtog pas btags pa ldan pa min pa'i 'du byed kyis bsdus pa'i/ snod bcud phra rags ming tshig dang*/ yi ge phyogs dus la sogs pa/ thams cad grub tshul/

gsungs pa phyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mngon pa rnams ste/ gnyis pa ni/ sngar bshad pa ji ltar phyi yi mngon pa bzhin nang rdo rje'i lus na gnas te/ rtsa dang lus dbyibs 'jig rten min la/ rlung gis ngag dang dus kyi tshad dang yi ge bskyed// thig le gza' dang rgyu skar dang*/ chu bo me sogs sbyar ba'i nges pa bstan pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ ji ltar na mig btsums gzugs mi mthong*/ phye bas snang bar 'gyur ba dang*/ de bzhin/ mig btsir na zla ba gnyis mthong ltar/ phyi'i mngon pas ni/ rten gyi nang rtsa rlung byang sems kyi gnad 'ching ma shes pas/ srid zhi mnyam nyid la dbang byed pa'i ye shes mthong ba min la/ rtsa rlung thig le'i rten bcings lam gyi ye shes mngon sum du mthong ste/ bskyed rim yan lag bcas don sems las gzhan phyi rol tu med kyang gzhan snang la/ sprul pa du mar dbang 'byor ba'i phyir/ kun brtag lha dang dkyil 'khor ston pa/ de'i phyir rdo rje theg pa'i nang don gyi mngon pa yin no// gnyis pa mdo sde dang sbyar ba ni/ phar phyin tu sems kyi bslab pa sogs lam rim gzhan tu bshad pa dang*/ lha sgom pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor sgrub pa yang*/ nang gi sa dang lam dang pha rol phyin/ gzungs dang sngags bcas byang chub phyogs chos so bdun dang*/ zad par zil gnon la sogs pa/ rang gzhan gyi don bsgrub pa'i ting 'dzin dang 'brel ba'i phyir zab dang rgya che ba du ma ston pa'i phyir/ rdo rje theg pa nang gi mdo sde dang pha rol phyin par brjod do// gsum pa 'dul ba dang sbyar ba ni// phyi rol gyi 'dul ba lus ngag bsrung sdom dang*// rang bzhin kha na ma tho ba bcas sdom par ldan pa'i 'dul ba gang yin pa de ni// nang du rang dang gzhan don la// ma rmongs thabs mkhas khyad par gyis nyon mongs ye shes bsgyur byed pa'i ni/ rgyu mtshan de phyir rdo rje theg pa nang gi 'dul bar gsungs so// gsum pa de dag shes pa'i dgos pa spyi dang khyad par ba bstan pa ni/

de ltar theg dman gyi 'dul mngon mdo sde'i sde snod gsum po de ni phyi don gyi tshul ston pa/ de'i gnas tshul shes pas/ nyan rang 'bras bu thob byed de/ bla med kyi byang chub ni ma yin no// de rnams las 'phags pa bsam pa dang*/ spyod pa rgya che ba zab mo'i mdo 'dul mngon pa rnams kyi tshul/ spyod byed byang chub sems dpar 'gyur ste/ dus grangs med du ma'i mthar sangs rgyas kyi byang chub mngon tu byed par 'gyur ro// de dag las lhag pa rdo rje theg pa'i khyad chos/ thabs mkhas kyi tshul gyi lus sems kyi gnas lugs nang don rgyas par shes nas// sangs rgyas snying po'i tshul ji bzhin bden gnyis gzhi 'bras dbyer med kyi don rtogs nas/ gzhi dang 'bras bu dbyer med du rtog pas lam du byed pa ni// bla med sangs rgyas myur du ste// dus mi tshe gcig gam/ bdun dang*/ bcu drug la thob par byed do// bzhi pa gzhi lam 'bras bu'i rang bzhin bsdu ba la gsum/ gzhi dus su bsgribs pa'i tshul/ lam dus su sbyang ba'i tshul/ 'bras dus su dag pa'i tshul lo// dang po ni/ 'di ltar snang ba thams cad ye shes rang bzhin nyid las ma dmigs te/ 'on kyang kun gzhi'i 'od gsal de nyid rang ngo ma shes te/ nyon yid g.yo bas gzung 'dzin tu 'khrul pa'i dri ma des rang rig ye shes de sgrib nas 'khor ba 'khrul rtog gzung 'dzin gyi /shes pa glo bur bar skyes nas/ de ltar nyon mongs kyi 'du byed des khams gsum mngon par 'du byas nas/ yod pa'i gnas lugs ma mthong med pa gzung 'dzin gnyis su mthong ste// rnam rtog 'dam du bying gyur pas// byis pa 'khor ba'i nang du bying*// gnyis pa ni/ phyi nang gzhan gsum ye shes chen po'i dbyings su// dbyer med du rtogs pas don la sangs rgyas kyi rang bzhin yin te/ kun rdzob tu gzung 'dzin gnyis su snang ba rnams// chu zla lta bur don du med bzhin snang ba sems kyi rang mdangs las shar ba'i gdangs su gzigs shing*/

don dam bden pa stong nyid bco brgyad po rnams/ yul yul can dbyer med gcig tu bden gnyis dbyer med du gzigs pas na/ gsum pa ni/ nyon mongs shes bya snyoms 'jug gi sgrib gsum dang bral so so rang rig pa'i ye shes nyid kyis/ chos dang chos can ji lta ji snyed mkhyen cing gzigs pa'i ye shes rnam pa gnyis su gsungs so// lnga pa bstan bcos 'di gang las rnyed pa la gsum ji ltar bsdus pa'i tshul/ de'i khungs bkod pa/ rang bzo ma yin par bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ rgyu mtshan de lta bas na rdo rje'i theg pa ru/ gsungs pa'i lus sems nang gi gnas lugs rtogs bya'i phyir/ 'di ni rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dgongs don gyi phyogs tsam bsdus pa yin la/ gnyis pa ni/ rgyas par bstan pa dpag med rnams kyang*/ rgyal sras sa la bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis bstan pa yi/ rgyud 'grel rnams la blta bar gyis shig 'on kyang de rnams ni ches zab pas rtogs dka' bas/ de rnams kun la 'jug pa'i sgo lta bur gyur pa/ gsum pa ni/ zab mo nang gi don bshad pa/ 'di ni rang bzo ma yin te// thams cad mkhyen pa bcom ldan 'das/ rgyal bas gsungs pa kho na bris shing*/ 'di lta bu yang byang chub sems dpa' gsang ba'i bdag po mkhas rnams kyi/ rnam 'grel mthu la rab brten nas// rdo rje theg pa'i nang gi don/ phyin ci ma log pa kho bo dpal karma pa rang byung rdo rjes phyin ci ma log par rnyed pa de/ rjes 'jug rnams la phan phyir cung zad bstan pa yin no// gnyis pa phrin las la bsngags shing bsngo ba smon lam dang bcas pa la gsum/ bstod pa/ bsngo ba/ bzod gsol lo// dang po la bzhi/ sku/ gsung*/ thugs/ phrin las kyi gsang ba la bstod cing 'dud pa'o// dang po ni/ brtsams pa mthar phyin pa'i don gyis sangs rgyas kyis mdzad pa'i yon tan la bsngags shing*/ dge ba bsngo ba ni/ bdud bzhi dang*/ ma rtogs/

log rtogs/ phyogs rtogs sogs mi mthun pa dang*/ phas kyi rgol ba kun las rnam pa kun tu rab tu rgyal bar gyur ba'i rgyal ba/ lhun grub skye 'gag med cing*/ 'dus ma byas pa/ gzhom gzhig 'pho 'gyur thal ba'i chos sku nam mkha'i sku can ye shes lnga yi bdag nyid nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ltar phyi nang gi mun pa 'joms shing*/ ye shes kyi snang ba tshad med par rgyas pa'i ye shes chos kyi nyi ma ltar gsal ba las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten kun tu gzugs sku gnyis kyis bkod pa 'khor ba ji srid ston cing gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ lha yi rnga sgra lta bu'i gsung ni 'bad rtsol dang*/ rnam rtog gis 'du mi mdzad par yang*/ nam mkha'i khams mnyam 'bad med gang 'dul der ston gyi// chos sgo rab 'byams gsungs rnam pa thams cad pa'i dbyangs gcig gis/ so so'i khams dbang dang 'tshams par ston cing*/ 'gro ba kun gyis legs par sos par mdzad/ gsum pa ni/ thugs ni yid bzhin nor ltar 'bad pa med cing*/ mnyam pa nyid dang*/ so sor rtog pa dang*/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes lhan cig tu// spros pa mi mnga' bzhin tu spros ldan rnams la/ sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pas/ so so'i yid bzhin re ba skong*/ bzhi pa ni/ sems can nyon mongs pa can rnams kyi don tu/ 'khor ba ji srid du sems nyon mongs can de rnams dang lhan cig 'khor ba'i 'dam gyi grong na 'jug kyang*/ 'khor ba'i nyes pa'i skyon gyis khyod la gos pa rdul tsam yang med pa/ de phyir rang byung rgyal ba khyod la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis pa bsngo ba ni/ de ltar rdo rje theg pa bla med kyi gsang ba/ zab mo nang don bshad pa las/ dge ba'i mthu yang ci yod pa// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun// yon tan de lta bu dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas/ ye shes sku nyid thob par shog /gsum pa bzod par gsol ba ni/ cung zad 'gal bar gyur srid na// mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bzod bar mdzod// gsum pa brtsom pa mthar phyin pa'i tshul la gsum/

rdzogs tshig bstan pa/ brtsams pa'i rgyu mtshan/ gnas dang dus smos pa'o// dang po ni/ zab mo nang gi don gsal bar byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa rgyud thams cad kyi snying po phyung ba dum bu bcu gcig pa/ rang byung rdo rje'i ming can gyis bla na med pa'i rgyud 'brel ji lta bar nang gi don shes par 'dod pa rnams kyi don du bstan pa'o/// /gnyis pa ni/ mkhas par rloms pa dang*/ bsgoms nas nyams myong dang*/ mngon shes shar bar 'dod pa kun gyis kyang phyogs re las ma go bar 'dug pas 'dir bsdus te bstan pa yin no// gsum pa ni/ dben gnas bde chen steng du khyi lo zla ba bdun pa la mdzad pa'o/// /bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan tu shog /de lta bu'i don la spro ba brtas te ched du brjod pa ni/ za~Xb mo~X rdo~X rje~X'i grong khyer nyams dga' bar// 'jug pa'i blo can skal pa mchog ldan rnams// na~Xng gi~X nor bu'i sgron me 'di longs la// rang rig do~Xn gyi ye shes rnyed par mdzod// ces so// zhes pa'i mchan 'di'ang rang byung chos kyi rgyal po'i smon lam 'dzin pa'i skyes rabs bco lnga par grags pa'i rig 'dzin gyi btsun pa dpal ldan kun bzang bstan pa'i nyi ma chen po phrin las mkha' khyab rdo rje phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sder 'bod pas btab pa'i yi ge gnyis par 'god pa po ni karma thub bstan 'jam dpal tshul khrims grags pas bgyis pa nges don sgrub brgyud snying po'i bstan pa dar rgyas yun du gnas pa'i rgyur gyur cig// /sarba maṅga laṃ/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// /
